pfeifen-huber-no-18.z: This is one of Pfeifen Huber's numbered English-style house blends; no sufficient sources documenting its composition and character could be found.

mcclelland-no-925-nine-2-five.z: No. 925, known among smokers as "Nine 2 Five," was an unflavored Latakia blend in McClelland's numbered bulk series. What sets it apart from other English blends is that it contains essentially no Virginia: an air-cured-leaf Cavendish base combines with Latakia and Oriental leaves. The aroma on opening the pouch is sweet and earthy despite the lack of Virginia, so it's often mistaken for a VaPer, according to records. In the smoke, Latakia's smoke dominates, but the Cavendish base softens the blend and keeps it away from the sharpness of full English mixtures. Nicotine load stays at a medium-low level. Suited to those seeking an unflavored but non-heavy smoke, and can serve as a middle step for those still getting used to Latakia. Production ended when McClelland closed in 2018.
mcclelland-no-925-nine-2-five.o: Leaves a faintly earthy sweetness alongside a wood-smoke and dry-spice aroma.

cornell-diehl-bag-piper.z: Not enough independent sourcing could be found to document the content and character of the Cornell & Diehl blend Bag Piper.

watch-city-cigar-queequegs.z: Named after Queequeg, the pipe-smoking harpooner from Moby Dick, this is Watch City Cigar's Burley-based house blend; no sufficient source could be found regarding its composition.
watch-city-cigar-queequegs.o: No record could be found regarding the room note.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-skandinav.z: The aromatic version of the Skandinavik series; no sufficient primary source describing the blend's composition and flavoring could be found.

orlik-tobacco-company-a-s-jock-scott.z: A mild-character blend records describe as made of Virginia leaves pressed, heated, and then rubbed out; not enough independent source material confirming its details could be found.

wilke-pipe-tobacco-old-english.z: Wilke Old English is a record not found in the maker's current listings, and no independent source could be found regarding its composition.
wilke-pipe-tobacco-old-english.o: According to the records, no reliable information exists about the room note.

affordable-pipes-guys-english-blend-25.z: Guy's English Blend #25 is described as the heaviest English mixture in American seller Affordable Pipes' bulk blend line. Roughly half of the blend is Latakia; a small amount of Perique and other leaves join it. It's an unflavored blend. Such a high Latakia ratio means the smoky, sooty side dominates the entire blend; flavor intensity and the room note it leaves are top-tier. It suits experienced smokers who don't find the Latakia load excessive, looking for dark, sharp English mixtures; it's a structure that would be heavy for those just getting used to Latakia.
affordable-pipes-guys-english-blend-25.o: Fills the room with heavy soot, tar, and burnt wood.

barclay-rex-burley-light-brandy-blend.z: One of the shop blends from the New York tobacconist Barclay Rex; although its name points to Burley and cognac flavoring, no source documenting its composition could be found, leaving the profile blank.

argento-duo.z: Duo takes its name from the equal meeting of two tobaccos: Burley grown in Argentina and local criollo leaf. This pairing gives a nutty, earthy body rather than a dried-fruit one; the coffee touch added over it deepens the taste more than sweetening it. The cut is ribbon, distributed in 50-gram pouches. The blend is built entirely from Argentine tobaccos, so instead of the lemony sweetness of Virginia-heavy blends, Burley's dry, bready character dominates. It carries flavoring, but in a measured way; it suits smokers avoiding heavily syruped aromatics who also don't want a completely unflavored tobacco.
argento-duo.o: Leaves a room note of roasted coffee bean and nutty tobacco.

black-cat-cigar-company-hampshire.z: One of the bulk house blends from Black Cat Cigar Company; no manufacturer recipe for its content could be found.
black-cat-cigar-company-hampshire.o: No verified information on the room note could be found.

affordable-pipes-night-crawler.z: One of the house blends from the American seller Affordable Pipes; no accessible source describing its content could be found.

mccranies-friars-1804.z: Friar's 1804 is one of McCranie's aromatic bulk blends; no independent source could be found describing its contents.

house-of-windsor-argosy-black.z: This is one of House of Windsor's discontinued aromatic blends; no reliable source about its content and character could be found.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-mick-mcqu.z: Mick McQuaid is, according to records, a traditional blend released decades ago by P. J. Carroll & Company of Dundalk, Ireland. It is built on Virginia leaf pressed into a plug. Production later passed to Scandinavian Tobacco Group. Pressing and aging deepen the blend's sugars; the taste oscillates between sour fruit and a dark, toasted foundation. It is not light on nicotine. Suited to those wanting to get to know the old-style Irish and English pressed-Virginia tradition.
scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-mick-mcqu.o: Leaves a dark, sourish, lightly smoky tobacco scent.

iwan-ries-three-star-green.z: This is a blend from the Three Star line prepared over the counter by the Chicago-based tobacconist Iwan Ries & Co.; no independent source detailing its content and character could be found, so the profile is left incomplete.
iwan-ries-three-star-green.o: No reliable information about the room note could be found.

charatan-mild-ready-rubbed.z: No sufficient independent sources could be found regarding this blend released under the British pipe maker Charatan.

orlik-tobacco-company-a-s-perle-blended.z: A plain Danish blend in Orlik's Perle line, Virginia-and-burley based; not enough independent source material detailing its composition could be found.

bufflehead-emperor-goose.z: One of the discontinued blends from the Bufflehead shop; no source documenting its composition and character could be found.

briarworks-international-unsweet-tea.z: No sufficient independent sources documenting the content and character of the blend named Unsweet Tea under the BriarWorks International brand could be found.

clan-shaw-scotsman.z: No reliable, independent sourcing could be found regarding Clan Shaw Scotsman, so a detailed profile could not be compiled.

john-b-hayes-tobacconist-scottish-moor.z: One of American tobacconist John B. Hayes' counter blends; no verifiable information on its contents could be found.
john-b-hayes-tobacconist-scottish-moor.o: No verifiable information on its room note could be found.

park-lane-tobacconist-trout-brook.z: An aromatic mixture among Park-Lane Tobacconist's house blends; not enough source material describing its composition and character could be found.

consolidated-j-2-caramello.z: Not enough independent sourcing could be found to document the content and character of the Consolidated blend J-2: Caramello.

hu-tobacco-aus-dem-krater-nr-3.z: Aus dem Krater Nr. 3 is an unflavored Virginia-Perique blend presented in ready-rubbed flake form. The maker's description states that malty-sweet red Virginia leaves are brought together with spicy, fruity Perique. Thanks to its natural sweetness and the spicy layer from the Perique, it carries a complex flavor structure; in terms of strength it stays on the light side. It's aimed at those wanting to experience the unflavored Virginia-Perique structure in flake form.
hu-tobacco-aus-dem-krater-nr-3.o: Leaves a peppery tobacco aroma along with dried-fig and plum sweetness.

samuel-gawith-christmas-mixture-2014.z: No sufficient source documenting the content and character of Christmas Mixture 2014, according to records a flavored blend produced at Samuel Gawith's factory in Kendal, could be found.

rattray-red-rapparee.z: Red Rapparee is a broken-flake blend where red Virginia leaf is spiced with a generous amount of Oriental tobacco, with only a very small amount of Latakia added. Red Virginia's sugary taste is quickly balanced by the Oriental leaf's sweet-firm spiciness; in the smoke, a deep spice trace reminiscent of cinnamon and orange peel can be distinguished, along with a sharpness recalling black pepper. Nicotine is above medium. In the first half of the smoke, Latakia stays like a cooling supporting player; toward the end the Oriental leaf comes fully forward and the body firms up. Though usable during the day, its filling structure suits it more to long after-dinner sessions; it is a straightforward choice for smokers looking for spicy English blends.
rattray-red-rapparee.o: A sharp, smoky, spicy wood-smoke aroma fills the room.

sutliff-tobacco-company-burley-delight-2.z: 212 Burley Delight is a broken-flake-cut blend carried predominantly by burley, with a small amount of Virginia added alongside it. Among the golden-brown leaf are unbroken flake pieces. On the palate, burley's nutty, bready character stands out, accompanied by Virginia's sweetness and a light cocoa direction. Strength and flavor intensity are medium, with no pronounced topping. Suited to smokers wanting to move from flavored tobaccos to plain leaf, or seeking a balanced burley for all-day smoking.
sutliff-tobacco-company-burley-delight-2.o: Leaves a scent of roasted nuts and a faint trace of cocoa.

deadwood-tobacco-house-blends-deadwood-g.z: This is one of the aromatic shop blends sold under its own name by the tobacconist in Deadwood, South Dakota; no independent source describing its profile could be found.
deadwood-tobacco-house-blends-deadwood-g.o: No reliable record could be found for the room note.

paul-olsen-christmas-2015.z: A seasonal Christmas blend the Poul Olsen shop released for 2015; not enough source material describing its composition could be found.

niall-of-nine-blood-of-many.z: One of the blends prepared in very small batches under the Niall of Nine signature; not enough independent source material documenting its composition and character could be found.

james-barber-special-brew.z: Listed as one of the James Barber tobacconist's house blends; no source could be found on its contents and character.

gawith-hoggarth-co-american-blend-black-.z: Gawith, Hoggarth & Co. has produced tobacco in the English town of Kendal since 1887; the American Blend series is the firm's American-style, bulk-sold aromatic line. Black Cherry is the cherry-flavoured member of this line: black cavendish and flue-cured Virginia dominate the base, joined by some burley, and the blend is presented as a ribbon cut.
gawith-hoggarth-co-american-blend-black-.o: Leaves an aroma of ripe cherry syrup and sweet cavendish.

mcclelland-christmas-cheer-2008.z: Christmas Cheer 2008 is the release prepared from the 2008 crop in McClelland's annual unflavored Virginia series. The series' method stays the same every year: select orange-red flue-cured leaf is pressed into cake, matured, sliced, and tinned as broken flake. In the smoke, without any flavoring, the leaf's natural sweetness stands out along with a bready base; nicotine dose is medium. The series' well-known sharp tin note is present in this release too. Since releases are made from a single crop, character differs between years and continues to shift with cellaring. Suited to smokers interested in unflavored Virginia and aging. The brand closed in 2018.
mcclelland-christmas-cheer-2008.o: Leaves a tangy, vinegary sweetness along with a toasted-bread aroma.

chief-catoonah-tobacconist-alans-inspira.z: The entry has been left incomplete as no reliable source could be found for Chief Catoonah Tobacconist's Alan's Inspiration blend.

ilsted-own-mixture-no-99-sweet-taste.z: No.99, known by the subtitle "Sweet Taste," is a Danish-style aromatic in which Virginia leaves are joined by black Cavendish, with some Burley added to establish balance. Its coating consists of coffee and cream, so sweetness and milky softness lead the profile. The Cavendish gives a moist, cool smoke, while the Burley leaves a dry body that keeps the blend from becoming too syrupy. It's aimed at smokers looking for a sweet-scented, lightly nicotine aromatic.
ilsted-own-mixture-no-99-sweet-taste.o: Leaves an aroma reminiscent of milky coffee and caramelized sugar.

dobies-dobies-four-square-circles.z: Not enough sourcing could be found to document the character of Dobie's Four Square-Circles, a blend from Dobie's.

mike-russ-the-mind-meld-chocolate.z: A blend from a very small-scale series referred to as a chocolate-leaning aromatic; no reliable source describing its composition could be found.

davidoff-sweet-mixture-no-4.z: Sweet Mixture No. 4 is the fourth blend in Davidoff's limited Sweet Mixture line, limited to five thousand tins. The Swiss-origin brand's pipe tobaccos are produced in Germany. The blend is built on Mexican-origin burley and black cavendish; these leaves are noted as undergoing double fermentation. Double fermentation gives the tobacco a mature, fruity sweetness that comes from the process rather than a topping. Because of the burley share, nicotine is medium and the smoke carries a dry body. It suits smokers wanting to stay away from heavy syrupy aromatics and take their sweetness from the leaf itself.
davidoff-sweet-mixture-no-4.o: Leaves a warm scent evoking mature fruit sweetness and baked bread.

gq-tobaccos-christmas-blend-2013.z: GQ Tobaccos's limited holiday blend released specially for the year 2013; there is no sourcing documenting its composition.
gq-tobaccos-christmas-blend-2013.o: No record of its aroma could be found.

dobies-dobies-four-square-virginia.z: This blend, the unadulterated Virginia branch of the Four Square series, is a continuation of the tradition begun in 1922 by George Dobie & Son in Paisley, Scotland. After the brand passed to Godfrey Phillips, the Paisley factory closed in 1956, and blending moved first to Denmark, then to the United States.
dobies-dobies-four-square-virginia.o: Leaves a scent of dry grass with a light bready sweetness.

tabac-manil-bouchons-de-semois.z: Bouchons de Semois, a pipe tobacco from Tabac Manil; no sufficient primary source documenting the content and character of this blend could be found in the records.

elephant-castle-blue-mosque.z: No sufficient independent sourcing could be reached to document the composition and character of Blue Mosque, a pipe tobacco from Elephant & Castle.

leavitt-peirce-pound-cake.z: Pound Cake is one of the light aromatic blends Leavitt & Peirce sells in bulk at its Harvard Square shop. Per the shop's description, the mixture rests on matured Virginia leaves and its flavor profile is set to evoke a sweet cookie. Casing level isn't heavy; Virginia's own sugar and the flavoring work in the same direction. Body is light, smoke is soft; nicotine load is low, allowing long smokes. Of interest to those avoiding heavy syrupy aromatics but still wanting a sweet profile, and to those transitioning from aromatics to natural Virginia. A current branch of the shop's house-blend tradition dating back to 1883.
leavitt-peirce-pound-cake.o: Leaves a sweet room note reminiscent of buttery sugar cookie dough.

motzek-curly-strang-cut.z: Since neither the manufacturer's own description nor two independent reliable sources could be found for the Motzek blend called (Curly) Strang Cut, its composition, cut, and character could not be documented here.

1776-tobacco-co-briar-creek-natural.z: One of 1776 Tobacco Co.'s unflavored blends; per records it brings together red and lemon Virginias with a Burley body and Oriental leaf, but since the composition rests on a single source, the profile could not be completed.

backwoods-blue.z: Backwoods is a brand producing machine-blended, everyday-use tobaccos in pouch packaging for the US market. Blue is the entry positioned on the fuller side within the brand's pouch series; per records it has a Virginia- and Burley-heavy body, cut as a ribbon suited to packing straight from the pouch. Its flavoring level is kept low, letting the tobacco's own dryness and nutty aftertaste come forward. Its body is plainer than the sugary structure of full aromatics, and mellower than English mixtures. It suits smokers looking for a tobacco they can smoke straight from the pouch with no long preparation, and those who smoke pipes cheaply and regularly during the day. On the Virginia-Burley axis, it offers a medium fullness in nicotine.
backwoods-blue.o: Leaves a dry, lightly sweet tobacco room note reminiscent of roasted hazelnut.

w-o-larsen-1864-perfect-mixture.z: No reliable source could be found regarding this blend bearing the W.O. Larsen name, so its details could not be recorded.

clan-shaw-camp-fire.z: Not enough independent sourcing could be found to document the content and character of the Clan Shaw blend Camp Fire.

p-lorillard-briggs-mixture.z: No reliable source could be found for the P. Lorillard pipe tobacco called Briggs Mixture, so a detailed profile could not be produced.

samuel-gawith-2015.z: No reliable source could be found for Samuel Gawith's aromatic blend known as 2015.

ferndown-mild-brown.z: Mild Brown is a member of the limited tobacco line prepared for the British pipe maker Ferndown; not enough sourcing describing its composition could be found.
ferndown-mild-brown.o: Records do not contain enough information for a description.

billow-the-billow-bulkan.z: Recorded as a lounge blend built on red Virginia, Oriental leaf, and Cyprus Latakia; details could not be verified with independent sources.
billow-the-billow-bulkan.o: No verified information on the room note could be found.

connoisseur-pickwick.z: No independent, reliable sourcing could be found regarding the Connoisseur blend Pickwick.

faders-chaucer.z: Fader's is a line of house blends offered under its own name by a long-established Baltimore tobacconist; no verifiable source could be found regarding this blend's composition and character.

radfords-sunrise-flake.z: Radfords Sunrise Flake is reportedly an old English tin product; there is not enough source material describing the blend's composition.

mac-baren-fireside-danish-blend.z: Recorded as a light, burley-forward blend that Mac Baren prepared in Svendborg in the early 1980s for its distributor Fireside; because it was short-lived, no detailed secondary source could be found.

straus-tobacco-stadium.z: Stadium is one of the counter blends from Straus Tobacconist in Cincinnati; records indicate the shop was founded in 1880 and that most of its house blends were named after Cincinnati neighborhoods and landmark buildings. Since no independent source on the blend's composition and character could be found, this record is kept at listing level only.

esoterica-tobacciana-pembroke.z: Pembroke is Esoterica's classic English mixture Margate flavored with French cognac; it is ribbon cut and produced by J. F. Germain & Son in Jersey. While the latakia soot and oriental spice remain fundamentally intact, the cognac adds a grapey, faintly alcoholic sweetness to the blend. It suits smokers familiar with unadulterated English mixtures but wanting a measured topping over them; the flavoring is not enough to cover the leaf's smoky character.
esoterica-tobacciana-pembroke.o: Woody soot scent is mingled with a note of grape and boozy fruit.

john-aylesbury-sir-johns-virginia.z: Sir John's Virginia is a Virginia blend in John Aylesbury's Danish-style classics line. It's prepared from three separate bright Virginias cut to different widths; its casing carries a measured honey note. The maker rates its strength at two out of five. It's offered in a 100-gram package, supplied through Kopp Tobaccos. The varied cut widths give the burn a graduated quality; on the palate, Virginia's natural sugar stands out alongside a light honey sweetness. Nicotine is low. Suited to smokers new to Virginia blends or seeking a light, sweet tobacco for all-day smoking.
john-aylesbury-sir-johns-virginia.o: Leaves a sweet aroma reminiscent of honey and dry hay.

black-cat-cigar-company-amaretto.z: One of the bulk aromatic house blends from Black Cat Cigar Company in Pennsylvania; no manufacturer recipe for its content could be found.
black-cat-cigar-company-amaretto.o: Leaves a sweet room note reminiscent of almond liqueur.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-jock-scot.z: Jock Scott is Scandinavian Tobacco Group's Danish-produced pouch-tobacco line known for its Scottish-evoking name. Creamy Malt is the whiskey-flavored version of this line and is sold in 40-gram pouches. The blend's body is built by black cavendish; burley's dry base and Virginia's sweetness are added. It is ribbon cut, easy to light. The top note gives a malty, creamy sweetness without fully covering the leaf's own taste. Aimed at those seeking a notably flavored blend with measured nicotine.
scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-jock-scot.o: Leaves a scent carrying malt and creamy sweetness, with whiskey's grainy edge behind it.

dream-castle-tobacco-company-black-caven.z: Not enough sourcing could be found to document the composition and character of Black Cavendish, a pipe tobacco from Dream Castle Tobacco Company.
dream-castle-tobacco-company-black-caven.o: Not enough records exist for the scent it leaves in the room.

sutliff-tobacco-company-whiskey-cavendis.z: Whiskey Cavendish #11 is a whisky-top-note blend among Sutliff's bulk aromatics. Its base is built from soft Burley, sweet-tart Virginia, and roasted-then-steamed Green River Burley; this last leaf goes through the Cavendish process, giving the blend a dark color and a rounded sweetness. A bourbon-character whisky flavoring is applied on top. The aroma is intense straight from the pack, but what carries through to the taste is more measured; oak and grain notes intertwine with the tobacco's nutty base. Nicotine is light to medium. Records indicate the blend was previously sold as Dutch Masters Whiskey Cavendish, and before that as Old Grand Dad Whiskey Cavendish. It suits smokers who like alcohol-themed top notes and want an aromatic that isn't overly sugary.
sutliff-tobacco-company-whiskey-cavendis.o: Leaves a scent of oak barrel, grain, and a light sweet alcohol note.

lane-limited-macanudo.z: One of the aromatic pipe tobaccos Lane Limited produced under a cigar brand's name; not enough sources could be found for the blend information.

nat-sherman-545-broadway-nougat.z: Nat Sherman's nougat-themed numbered aromatic house blend; no independent source describing its composition could be found.
nat-sherman-545-broadway-nougat.o: True to its name, it is noted to leave a sweet, almond-and-sugar-leaning aroma reminiscent of nougat.

house-of-windsor-field-stream.z: Field & Stream is a semi-aromatic blend prepared by adding a small amount of black Cavendish to mild white Burley and sweet light Virginia leaf. Keeping the Cavendish proportion low prevents the sweetness from masking the tobacco taste; because of this, the blend sits somewhere between an aromatic and a plain American mixture. Nicotine is moderate and the burn cool. It was one of the well-known products in House of Windsor's over-the-counter line; records mention it as the blend US President Gerald Ford smoked for many years. Since the company ceased operations, the original product isn't made; match blends are offered instead. It suits those looking for a lightly flavored Burley-Virginia mixture suited to everyday smoking.
house-of-windsor-field-stream.o: Leaves a lightly sweet aroma in the direction of nuts and dry hay.

wellauer-co-wellauers-english-blend.z: No reliable source could be found regarding this blend registered under the Wellauer & Co name, so its details could not be recorded.

city-cigar-company-trafalgar-park.z: Trafalgar Park, a house blend from the tobacconist City Cigar Company, is referred to in available records as English-style; not enough sourcing could be found to document its content.
city-cigar-company-trafalgar-park.o: No reliable information about the room note could be found.

mcgahey-the-tobacconist-princetown-peach.z: Princetown Peach is an aromatic McGahey blend taking its name from the village of Princetown in Dartmoor. A body built from Virginia, burley, and cavendish leaves is given a peach flavoring, adding a fruity sweetness without erasing the tobacco's own taste. It is sold in bulk in a ready-rubbed ribbon form.
mcgahey-the-tobacconist-princetown-peach.o: Leaves an aroma of ripe peach and sweet tobacco.

sentimiento-nacional-2003.z: A blend from Sentimiento Nacional, the boutique operation run by Argentine blender Antonio Petti in Buenos Aires; no reliable source documenting its content and character could be found.

robert-mcconnell-latakia-flake.z: Latakia Flake is a blend made by pressing and slicing Cyprus Latakia together with dark-fired Kentucky and black Cavendish. Since most English blends are presented as ribbon cut, turning a Latakia-heavy mixture into flake makes this product unusual within its category. Latakia sits at the center of the blend; its smoky, incense-like layer stays dominant throughout the smoke, Kentucky provides an earthy body and nicotine contribution, and black Cavendish softens the sharpness with a light sweetness in the background. No flavoring is applied. The pressed structure offers a slow, cool smoke. It suits experienced smokers looking for a high-Latakia, full, intense blend.
robert-mcconnell-latakia-flake.o: Fills the room with an intense campfire soot and incense aroma.

motzek-moro-cake.z: No independent source documenting the composition and character of the Motzek blend called Moro Cake could be found.

magne-falkum-mf-20th-century.z: Remembered as a Falkum blend said to contain Latakia; since no sufficient source documenting its composition and character could be found, the record is left incomplete.
magne-falkum-mf-20th-century.o: No reliable record of the room note could be found.

holger-danske-black-bourbon.z: Black & Bourbon is one of the Cavendish-based aromatics in the Holger Danske line. Double-fermented black Cavendish is combined with toasted American Burley leaf; the top flavoring is dissolved in bourbon whiskey and applied to the tobacco. This method aims to distribute the flavoring into the leaf rather than leaving a syrupy layer on the surface. As a result, toasted sugar, oak, and a lightly nutty base appear in the smoke. Records indicate the product was later also sold under the name B.B. The Holger Danske line is produced by Mac Baren following Denmark's aromatic pipe tobacco tradition. Nicotine is moderate and the burn cool; because of this it's suitable for those new to aromatics and smokers looking for a whiskey-Cavendish pairing.
holger-danske-black-bourbon.o: Leaves a toasted sugar tone over a sweet oak-barrel and whiskey aroma.

larus-brother-company-inc-edgeworth-arom.z: Edgeworth Aromatic was sold as the red-labeled arm of the Edgeworth family Larus & Brother Company launched in 1903. Per period promotional texts, the blend was built on Burley leaves and buttery yellow Virginia flake, with Latakia, Perique and Oriental leaf added to shape the flavor. This structure brings it closer to a lightly cased American mixture than a classic syrupy aromatic. Body is medium; Burley's nutty, bready base comes forward, with Latakia and Oriental leaf leaving a fine spice and wood layer in the background. Products under the Edgeworth name were carried on for a while by other manufacturers after Larus closed in 1974, and were eventually discontinued. Of interest to those seeking Burley-based, lightly sweetened old-style American blends.
larus-brother-company-inc-edgeworth-arom.o: A fine smokiness can be heard beneath the roasted-nut and buttered-bread scent.

captain-black-regular-white.z: Captain Black Regular, in its white package, is the brand's best-known and most widely distributed blend in the world. It contains black Cavendish alongside light-colored Virginia and Burley leaf that has not been converted to Cavendish; the cut is ribbon. It is very light in nicotine and low in tobacco flavor; the defining element is a mixed sweet casing built mainly around vanilla. Because moisture is high, it burns wet if filled without airing. The room note is distinctly sweet and bakery-like, and lingers in a space for a long time. It is the product most smokers encounter first when seeking a light, sweet, easy-smoking starter blend rather than tobacco character.
captain-black-regular-white.o: Leaves a vanilla-cake-dough and sweet bakery aroma.

w-o-larsen-kentucky-gold.z: No independent source sufficient to complete a record could be found regarding W.O. Larsen's Kentucky Gold blend, so this entry remains incomplete.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-balkan-sa.z: Listed as a lightened version of the Balkan Sasieni family; the main blend is built on Macedonian and Black Sea Oriental leaf, North Cyprus latakia, and golden-red virginias, but no sufficient independent source confirming this version's proportions and production status could be found.
scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-balkan-sa.o: Leaves a light wood smoke and dry hay scent.

gawith-hoggarth-co-brown-pigtail-vanilla.z: This is the vanilla-sweetened version of the rope produced by twisting dark fire-cured leaves. The rope's own scent is measured and carries more of a cream-custard association than pure vanilla on its own. Strong Virginia leaf gives fermented dark fruit, earth, and lightly grassy notes, while the vanilla topping softens the sharp edges of this body somewhat. Like the other pigtail ropes, it is prepared by slicing thin, rubbing out, and airing. Its fullness is above medium; despite being in the aromatic class, it is not a light tobacco. It is aimed at those accustomed to the rope format who want a sweet top note over a full body.
gawith-hoggarth-co-brown-pigtail-vanilla.o: A sweet aroma reminiscent more of baked custard than vanilla sits over the smoky tobacco.

d-r-tobacco-ramback-balkan.z: No reliable sources sufficient to establish the composition and character of D & R Tobacco's Ramback Balkan blend were found.

davidoff-light-mixture.z: Light Mixture is Davidoff's light, ribbon-cut blend of Virginia, Burley and Cavendish leaves. It also carries no aroma topping; despite this, the blend's own scent is perceived at a medium level. Its nicotine load is extremely low and its flavor intensity is almost nonexistent. It's a record offering little payoff for smokers seeking flavor development or nuance, appealing only to those seeking the very lightest smokes.
davidoff-light-mixture.o: Leaves a faint, lightly sweetish tobacco scent with no pronounced topping.

city-cigar-company-citys-d-965.z: City's D-965, a house blend from the tobacconist City Cigar Company, is referred to in available records as English-style; not enough sourcing could be found to document its content.
city-cigar-company-citys-d-965.o: No reliable information about the room note could be found.

wellauer-co-nightcap.z: Wellauer & Co's Nightcap is, according to records, one of the blends carrying the Swiss tobacconist house's name; as no sufficient independent source could be found documenting its composition and character, this entry remains incomplete.

comptons-of-galashiels-three-feathers.z: No independent, reliable sourcing could be found regarding the Compton's of Galashiels pipe tobacco named Three Feathers, so the blend's content, cut, and character could not be recorded.

brigham-acadian-blend.z: Acadian Blend is an unflavored Virginia-Perique blend in Canadian brand Brigham's Legend series. It consists of light and medium-brown Virginia leaves combined with a high proportion of perique, offered as a fine shag cut in a 50-gram tin. Per records, the same blend was previously sold in the Mr. B's line under the name Tudor Mixture, with only the label changing. The Virginias give a grassy, earthy, tart fruit taste, while perique adds a spicy layer reminiscent of fig and plum. Nicotine stays between light and medium, and the smoke runs balanced. Suitable for Virginia fans seeking a Latakia-free alternative; being a shag cut, it needs a loose fill and a slow smoke.
brigham-acadian-blend.o: Leaves an aroma where dried plum and hay sweetness is joined by light spice.

gauntleys-of-nottingham-christmas-2015.z: No reliable source could be found on Gauntleys Of Nottingham's Christmas 2015 blend.

mr-bs-cambridge-blend.z: Reportedly a blend classified as English-style in Canadian Brigham's Mr. B's line; no independent source describing its composition could be found.

tabac-benden-meermin.z: Meermin is a Dutch Blend Tabac Benden prepared drawing on the Dutch tobacco tradition. The blend's starting point is the Dutch method of maturing Cavendish through resting rather than obtaining it quickly with steam and heat: the tobaccos are pressed and stored for a while in large, square cake form, then re-cut just before packaging. This method brings out the leaf's own sweetness without needing a heavy external casing; the smoke is soft, low in nicotine, and rounded. A dark Cavendish tone proceeds together with Virginia sweetness. It suits smokers who want to steer clear of heavily flavored tobaccos yet still look for a soft, sweet smoke.
tabac-benden-meermin.o: Leaves a sweet, lightly baked scent of darkened leaf.

hearth-home-ten-to-midnight.z: Ten to Midnight is a dark, full-bodied Balkan blend in which matured bright Carolina and Virginia leaves are combined with a generous amount of Turkish and Oriental varieties, and then heavily loaded with Cyprus Latakia, all pressed into a firm cake. The cake is prepared by rubbing it out by hand. As its name suggests, it's built for late-night smoking; flavor intensity is at a level that won't fade next to heavy drinks like whiskey or port. It's aimed at smokers familiar with Latakia-forward blends; for those coming from light English mixtures it presents a noticeable jump.
hearth-home-ten-to-midnight.o: Leaves a heavy aroma reminiscent of wood fire and incense that settles into the room.

gatlin-burlier-cades-cove-cavendish.z: Cade's Cove Cavendish is one of the house blends the Gatlinburlier tobacconist in Gatlinburg, Tennessee, prepares at its own counter. It takes its name from the Cades Cove valley within the Great Smoky Mountains. It consists of a combination of light and dark cavendish leaves and carries a lightly sweet top note. According to the shop's records, it has been the best-selling blend for over thirty years. With its low nicotine level and pronounced sweet aroma, it is aimed at smokers seeking an aromatic tobacco or those new to the pipe.
gatlin-burlier-cades-cove-cavendish.o: Leaves a sweet aroma reminiscent of freshly baked cookies.

davids-blend-black-tan.z: This is one of the cavendish-based shop blends from David's Fine Tobaccos; no verifiable description of the blend's composition could be found.

peter-stokkebye-irish-slices.z: This is a Peter Stokkebye blend reported to be Virginia-based; no sufficient first-hand sources documenting its content and character could be found.
peter-stokkebye-irish-slices.o: No sufficient information for a room note could be found in the records.

pipesandcigars-com-the-cavendish-in-the-.z: This is a blend offered under the American retailer pipesandcigars.com's name; no verifiable source could be found on its content and character.

tinder-box-captain-spice.z: Tinder Box is the name of an American tobacconist chain founded in 1928 that sells blends prepared for its own shops under its own name; Captain Spice is one of these house blends, though no sufficient independent source describing its composition and character has been found.

james-fox-old-year-mixture.z: No reliable source could be found to document the contents and character of James Fox's Old Year Mixture.

ken-byron-ventures-mr-christians-stoved-.z: A blend released as part of Ken Byron Ventures' small-batch production; no independent, verifiable source could be found on it.

kohlhase-kopp-und-co-kg-flame-1919-2024.z: Flame 1919 is Kohlhase & Kopp's 100-gram limited edition tin for 2024. The name references 1919, the year the family's group of companies was founded; the business begun by founder Martin Wess has stayed in family hands for over a century since. Tobacco production is carried out at their facility near Hamburg. The blend places cube-cut Virginia and cube-cut Burley alongside cavendish and perique; the weight is on Virginia, with perique adding a small but noticeable spice-and-plum axis. Casing is measured, so a lightly flavored Virginia character comes forward more than an aromatic one; honey and nutty tastes are balanced by Burley's dry body. The cube cut burns slowly and packs easily; suited to smokers who are Virginia-based and don't want heavy casing.
kohlhase-kopp-und-co-kg-flame-1919-2024.o: Leaves a warm room note reminiscent of honeyed bread and roasted hazelnut.

cornell-diehl-jamaican-rum.z: Jamaican Rum is one of Cornell & Diehl's classic aromatics, working an island-rum flavor into a cavendish base. The ribbon-cut blend, built from black cavendish, burley, and Virginia leaf, is coated in the rum flavoring for which it is named. Nicotine load is low, flavor intensity is high; the rum note stays out front through the smoke, merging with cavendish's sugary sweetness. It suits smokers who enjoy aromatics and want a light bowl with a pronounced taste, as well as those new to the pipe.
cornell-diehl-jamaican-rum.o: Leaves a sweet, lightly boozy aroma reminiscent of rum and cane sugar.

lane-limited-choco-blend-no-88.z: Not enough independent sources could be found documenting the contents and character of American blender Lane Limited's blend called Choco Blend No.88.

b-b-tobacconists-llc-becks-rasputins-rev.z: A limited-run tobacconist's blend; no source documenting its composition could be found, leaving the profile blank.

the-country-squire-tobacconist-parsons-b.z: No reliable source could be found on The Country Squire Tobacconist's Parson's Blend pipe blend.

hearth-home-chatham-manor.z: Chatham Manor is a light aromatic in Hearth & Home's Mid-Town series. Its composition rests on white Burley and Virginia leaf; this pairing gives the tobacco a nutty base and a measured sweetness. A light vanilla-and-bourbon top note is applied over it. The topping dose is kept low enough not to mask the tobacco's own taste; the character runs mild and even. It is on the light side for nicotine and burns cool. Suited to smokers who avoid heavy syrupy aromatics but aren't ready to move to fully unflavored blends, as well as those new to the pipe.
hearth-home-chatham-manor.o: Leaves a sweet, lightly woody aroma reminiscent of vanilla and bourbon barrel.

faders-o-s-s.z: Not enough independent sourcing documenting the composition and character of O.S.S., one of the house blends of the Baltimore-based Fader's tobacconist, could be found.

hu-tobacco-balkan-passion.z: No sufficient independent source verifying the content and character of Balkan Passion, one of the small-batch blends prepared by the German maker HU Tobacco, could be found.

charatan-four-leaf.z: Four Leaf is a blend prepared in the Charatan line as the counterpart to Dunhill's Aperitif. As its name suggests, four separate leaf groups are brought together: Virginia, Oriental, Latakia and Burley. The cut is ribbon. Because the Latakia share is kept limited, the smoke stays in the background; the Oriental's dry spice and Virginia's sweetness come to the fore, while Burley gives the blend a round body. Nicotine is in the low-to-medium range. Suitable for smokers seeking a soft English blend with restrained Latakia that can be smoked during the day.
charatan-four-leaf.o: Leaves a lightly smoky, dry, faintly sweet room note.

vauen-no-2-oriental-blend.z: No. 2 Oriental Blend is the current equivalent of the blend Vauen previously offered under the name Coriander. Golden, reddish and brown Virginia leaves are used in varying cut widths; two separate types of black Cavendish along with Burley give the blend a soft base. The oriental suggestion in the name comes from the flavoring rather than the tobacco composition: fresh coriander and honey notes give the blend a spicy-sweet edge. Nicotine is kept low. Suited to aromatic smokers after a spice line outside the usual vanilla and fruit flavorings.
vauen-no-2-oriental-blend.o: Leaves a scent of fresh coriander and light spice atop a honeyed sweetness.

milan-tobacconists-milestone.z: Milestone is among Milan Tobacconists' non-aromatic house blends. It is built by combining rested golden and red virginia leaves with select burley. According to the maker's description it carries nutmeg, caramel, and a sweet spice trace underneath. Body stays at medium, with sweetness coming from the leaf's own sugar. Suitable for smokers looking for unflavored virginia-burley constructions, particularly the bready and lightly spiced side.
milan-tobacconists-milestone.o: Leaves a dry, sweet aroma in the direction of baked bread and caramel.

samuel-gawith-lakeland-light.z: No sufficient source documenting the content and character of Lakeland Light, according to records a pure Virginia blend produced at Samuel Gawith's factory in Kendal, could be found.

ken-byron-ventures-goblin-mixture-2020.z: Not enough independent sources could be found to fill in the profile of Ken Byron Ventures' Goblin Mixture 2020.

mcclelland-yenice-agonya-grand-orientals.z: Yenice Agonya is one of the Grand Orientals series entries where McClelland spotlights a single-region tobacco. The blend's backbone is Oriental leaf grown in the Yenice district of Çanakkale, with Virginia in a supporting role; the cut is ribbon. On opening the tin, the brand's characteristic tangy aroma is noticeable; the tobacco's moisture is smokable straight away, and a brief airing settles the sweet-tart side. The smoke is extremely mild and cool, moving between Yenice's unobtrusive spiciness and a sweet-tart flavor. It lights easily and resists overheating, though bowls burn down quickly. The ash is soft and the chamber cleans up easily. Suited to hours calling for a light smoke, like the morning, and to those curious about Oriental tobacco taste in its plain form. It shares the same leaf with Yenidje Supreme from the same series, but stays lighter than that blend.
mcclelland-yenice-agonya-grand-orientals.o: Leaves a lightly spiced, tangy-sweet tobacco aroma.

house-of-windsor-black-cherry-t414.z: This is a blend among House of Windsor's T-series bulk aromatics, flavored, as the name suggests, with black cherry; no verifiable source describing its content could be found.

e-a-carey-american-pie-pipe-tobacco.z: An aromatic record referred to as one of E. A. Carey's house blends; since it does not appear in the maker's current catalog, no source could be found describing its composition and character.
e-a-carey-american-pie-pipe-tobacco.o: No reliable description could be found for the room note.

dan-tobacco-bulldog-full-aromatic.z: Referred to as an aromatic blend belonging to Dan Tobacco's Bulldog series; no independent source detailing its composition and character was found.

straus-tobacco-cherry-mild.z: Cherry Mild is one of the counter blends from Straus Tobacconist in Cincinnati; records indicate the shop was founded in 1880 and that most of its house blends were named after Cincinnati neighborhoods and landmark buildings. Since no independent source on the blend's composition and character could be found, this record is kept at listing level only.

peterson-the-royal-yacht.z: The Royal Yacht is a blend of aged leaf that combines the sweetness of bright Virginia with the body of dark Virginia. It is one of the tobaccos that passed to Peterson from the Dunhill line. A small amount of topping recalling plum and raisin is applied; this note creates a similar sense of depth to Perique's without the peppery edge. In terms of nicotine it is considered one of the fuller Virginia blends in the catalog, so it is not suited to smoking on an empty stomach or at a fast pace. It suits experienced smokers seeking high strength and intense flavor in a Virginia blend.
peterson-the-royal-yacht.o: Notes of dark dried fruit and stewed plum are joined by the tobacco's own sharpness.

j-f-germain-son-b-k-flake.z: This is a blend under the J. F. Germain & Son name, produced on the island of Jersey; no accessible source verifying its content and character could be found, so the profile is left incomplete.
j-f-germain-son-b-k-flake.o: No reliable information about the room note could be found.

motzek-salvos-2-0.z: A blend from the Motzek workshop's straight virginia line, referred to as its second version; sufficient independent sources documenting its composition and character could not be found.

peterson-special-reserve-2013.z: Special Reserve 2013 is a limited edition blend released as part of Peterson's Special Reserve series specific to that year; the profile is left incomplete, as no sufficient first-hand sources confirming its content and character could be found.

cornell-diehl-nutcracker.z: Nutcracker is a blend Cornell & Diehl produced as part of its Wintertime Reserve series, released specifically for the holiday season. It is built by combining white burley, dark burley, and cube-cut burley leaves; after adding select Virginia leaves and a pinch of perique, the mixture is pressed and sliced into thin flakes. Its burley-heavy composition makes the blend filling and strong in nicotine; the Virginia component contributes a light sweetness, while perique adds a spicy twist. It suits smokers who enjoy unflavored blends built on the leaf's own taste and who are used to smoking pressed flake. Because Wintertime Reserve blends change from year to year, this release represents a limited-run edition.
cornell-diehl-nutcracker.o: Leaves a nutty, faintly tangy, earthy tobacco aroma.

reiner-blend-no-12.z: There is not enough source material documenting the content and character of Reiner Blend No.12.

cornell-diehl-star-of-the-east-gold.z: Star of the East Gold is the lighter wing of Cornell & Diehl's long-running Star of the East family. The blend's base is built on stoved bright Virginia leaf; equal proportions of Cyprus Latakia and red Virginia are added on top, and Turkish (Oriental) leaf brings out the blend's floral, sweet side. It's tinned ribbon cut, making it easy to pack and light. The resulting flavor preserves the classic English blend's smoky core while making Virginia's breadlike sweetness and the Oriental's dry spice tones more visible. Sitting at a medium point in nicotine and body, it can serve as an entry point for smokers who find dark Latakia blends too heavy but aren't drawn to full aromatics either. It carries a less intense Latakia presence than Star of the East, the family's first member.
cornell-diehl-star-of-the-east-gold.o: Leaves a scent where wood smoke intertwines with sweetish grass and spice.

pipesandcigars-com-scottys-english-stout.z: This is a blend offered under the American retailer pipesandcigars.com's name; no verifiable source could be found on its content and character.

peter-stokkebye-luxury-twist-flake-no-40.z: Luxury Twist Flake is a pure Virginia blend; the leaf reportedly comes from fields in Zimbabwe and the southeastern United States. The leaves are layered with a light casing and twisted like a rope, then this twisted form is pressed tightly in a mold and sliced. The resulting spiral-patterned slices are packed rubbed out. On the palate, Virginia's natural sweetness, recalling bread and dried fruit, leads; flavoring is not perceptible. The body is medium and the burn even. It suits smokers who love pure Virginia taste and don't mind working with slices.
peter-stokkebye-luxury-twist-flake-no-40.o: Leaves a sweet, warm aroma recalling freshly baked bread.

tabak-trennt-tw-64.z: TW 64 is among Tabak Trennt's numbered house mixtures, following the TT 91 blend prepared in 1961. According to the business's history, this series is built from natural tobacco leaves with no chemical additives whatsoever; TW 64 is noted within the series as the mixture where Oriental leaf comes to the fore. The blend is filled to its original recipe at the Walter Wehde tobacco factory in Hamburg and distributed through the Kiel shop. It suits smokers who look for the dry, spicy, and slightly tangy sides of Oriental tobacco and lean toward unflavored mixtures.
tabak-trennt-tw-64.o: Leaves a slightly tangy scent leaning toward dry hay and spice.

jenney-station-the-virginian.z: No reliable source documenting the content and character of Jenney Station's The Virginian blend could be found.

w-o-larsen-limited-edition-2016.z: No independent source sufficient to complete a record could be found regarding W.O. Larsen's Limited Edition 2016 blend, so this entry remains incomplete.

wesleys-no-55-latakia-a.z: Latakia A, among Wesley's house blends, follows the traditional English mixture mold: Virginia, Oriental, and Latakia leaf are used together. The maker states that American Burley is added to this trio to soften the blend's smoke; Burley also evens out the burn.
wesleys-no-55-latakia-a.o: Leaves a smoky, resinous scent reminiscent of a campfire.

cornell-diehl-craig-starks-blend.z: A blend recorded as an aromatic under the Cornell & Diehl name; its content could not be verified, as it does not appear in the manufacturer's current catalog and no independent source could be found.

pipesandcigars-com-portrait.z: Portrait is one of the blends the US-based retailer pipesandcigars.com sells under its own name; there is not enough independent source material documenting its content and character.

lane-limited-black-toasted-cavendish.z: Black Toasted Cavendish is one of Lane Limited's bulk-sold cavendish-based records. The leaf is darkened and toasted under heat and pressure; this process caramelizes its sugar, giving the tobacco its own sweetness so it needs no heavy external casing. Per the product description, the smoke is soft, slow-burning and carries a toasted, creamy taste. Nicotine load is low, flavor intensity is measured. It's a middle option for those who don't want the heavy casing of aromatic blends but still seek a sweet, light smoke; it's also on record as a base tobacco used by those building their own blends.
lane-limited-black-toasted-cavendish.o: Leaves a creamy room note toward toasted bread and light cocoa.

cornell-diehl-carolina-red-flake-w-periq.z: This limited-production flake, the 2020 edition of the Carolina Red Flake series with perique added, could not have its content and character verified, as it does not appear in the manufacturer's current catalog.

flandria-cerf-ardennais.z: Not enough independent sourcing to fill out an entry could be found for Flandria's Cerf Ardennais blend; records place it in the aromatic class.

barclay-rex-maiden-lane-blend.z: Maiden Lane is one of the house blends from Barclay Rex, the tobacconist operating in New York since 1910. It's named after Maiden Lane, the address the shop moved to in 1949; the family business, run by generations of the Nastri family, has relocated several times in Lower Manhattan. The blend brings together Virginia, Burley, Oriental, Latakia, and Perique leaf, built in the style of an unflavored English mixture. Latakia gives a smoky backbone while Perique adds a spicy, peppery edge; Virginia sweetness and Burley's dry body come in between. It offers a medium-strength smoke with high flavor intensity. It's aimed at smokers accustomed to unflavored English blends, looking for a mixture with a pronounced spice accent.
barclay-rex-maiden-lane-blend.o: Smoky Latakia and spicy Oriental notes linger in the room for a long time.

hu-tobacco-raiko-inbetween.z: No sufficient independent source could be found for the RaiKo InBeTween blend under the HU Tobacco name, so its content and character could not be recorded.

gawith-hoggarth-co-mellow-mahogany-ready.z: Mellow Mahogany is a plain Virginia-based broken flake (ready rubbed) tobacco; after pressing, the slices are crumbled ready for sale, so no additional rubbing out is needed before packing. The leaf's natural sweetness is preserved, and a measured Lakeland-style topping sitting on the woody, floral side is applied on top; sources also describe this flavor as giving a creamy almond association. The smoke runs cool and mild; there is a topping, but it doesn't mask the plain Virginia character. Suited to smokers who avoid heavy aromatics but want a lightly flavored English style rather than a fully unflavored Virginia.
gawith-hoggarth-co-mellow-mahogany-ready.o: Leaves an aroma carrying warm wood and a light floral creaminess.

bjarne-the-exclusive-one.z: A member of the aromatic blend line named after Danish pipe maker Bjarne Nielsen; no reliable source on its composition and character could be found.

emerson-southern-forged-gemini.z: Not enough first-hand sourcing was found for the Emerson Southern Forged brand's Gemini blend, so the entry has been left open; records place it in the English family.

motzek-burleys-mix.z: Since neither the manufacturer's own description nor two independent reliable sources could be found for the Motzek blend called Burley's Mix, its composition, cut, and character could not be documented here.

g-l-pease-blackpoint.z: Blackpoint is an English-style blend bringing together several red and light Virginia leaves. Oriental leaf and Cyprus latakia build the smoky, spicy layer; a very small amount of added perique gives a fine sharpness and fruity edge. The latakia proportion is not as dominant as in the Balkan-style Abingdon or Charing Cross; Virginia sweetness stays at the blend's axis. It suits smokers interested in smoky mixtures who want a balanced English mixture where latakia doesn't fully take over.
g-l-pease-blackpoint.o: Leaves a lightly sweet aroma mixing woodsmoke and spice.

ken-byron-ventures-goblin-mixture-limite.z: The 2021 limited release of the Goblin series; no independent source could be found to document its contents.
ken-byron-ventures-goblin-mixture-limite.o: No reliable description of the room note could be found.

e-a-carey-traditional-virginia.z: Traditional Virginia is E. A. Carey's unadulterated blend. Per the maker's description, sweet Virginia leaves are set on a soft burley base and the mixture is pressed into flake; the pressing brings out virginia's sugar while preserving the leaf's natural character. The maker states no preservatives or flavoring agents are used in the blend. The nicotine load is moderate, and the flavor body runs dry and nutty-sweet. It's a record suited to smokers seeking unflavored tobacco who like rubbing out or curling the flake before packing. It remains on the brand's current blend list.
e-a-carey-traditional-virginia.o: Leaves a scent of dry hay and baked bread.

davids-blend-black-raspberry.z: Black Raspberry is a fruity aromatic among the shop blends of David's Fine Tobaccos, also distributed in 50-gram pouches. The firm runs a wide list of bulk shop blends alongside its custom-mix service; this blend represents the fruity wing of that list. Raspberry topping is applied over a sweet, black-cavendish-forward base. Nicotine stays low to medium, and the smoke is cool and sweet. It suits smokers seeking pronounced fruit taste and a strong room scent rather than tobacco character, for short smokes during the day.
davids-blend-black-raspberry.o: Leaves a scent of sweet red berry and sugared preserve.

smokers-pride-rich-taste.z: Rich Taste is one of the Smoker's Pride brand's economical machine-blended tobaccos sold in bags; sufficient sources on its composition and character could not be found.
smokers-pride-rich-taste.o: Records did not describe the room note.

gawith-hoggarth-co-kendal-drumadoon.z: No reliable sourcing describing the composition and character of this Kendal blend, said to have a Virginia body, could be found.

consolidated-b-24-black-natural.z: Not enough independent sourcing could be found to document the content and character of the Consolidated blend B-24: Black Natural.

radfords-luxury-blend-with-latakia.z: Radford's Luxury Blend is a blend with English-mixture character, built from Virginia and Burley leaf with Latakia added. Its cut comes ready-rubbed ribbon; seller data lists strength as medium-to-strong and flavor intensity as medium. Latakia's smoky, sooty tone is the blend's defining feature; Virginia sweetness and Burley's earthy texture stay beneath that tone. It is a product for those looking for an unflavored, smoky, distinctly full mixture. UK seller records list the product as discontinued.
radfords-luxury-blend-with-latakia.o: Leaves a dry, sharp trace dominated by wood smoke and soot.

mcclelland-acadian-ribbon.z: Acadian Ribbon is a Virginia-Perique mixture McClelland released in late 2005 as a 50-gram tin under the Blakeney's Best umbrella. What sets the series apart is the toasting process applied to the Virginia leaf. Toasted golden Virginia builds the body; a pronounced Perique share, staying cool and mild, is added to it. Among the medium-thick, long-cut ribbons are also flake pieces, a structure that eases packing and burns without trouble. Its taste is nutty, sweet, and close to caramel; body is light-to-medium. Falls within the territory of those seeking Perique's spice over a mild base.
mcclelland-acadian-ribbon.o: Leaves an aroma of caramelized fruit and light spice.

thepiperoom-com-gandelf-of-delf.z: No independent source documenting the composition of the ThePipeRoom.com house blend Gandelf of Delf has been found; the brand's own site is no longer online.
thepiperoom-com-gandelf-of-delf.o: No reliable record of the room note has been found.

john-cotton-john-cottons-double-pressed-.z: A pipe tobacco blend released under the John Cotton name; not enough independent sources could be found to document its contents and character.
john-cotton-john-cottons-double-pressed-.o: No source could be found on the room note.

watch-city-cigar-watch-city-slices.z: No sufficient source could be found regarding this house blend from Watch City Cigar, so its details could not be recorded.

tinder-box-peach-melba.z: Tinder Box is the name of an American tobacconist chain founded in 1928 that sells blends prepared for its own shops under its own name; Peach Melba is one of these house blends, though no sufficient independent source describing its composition and character has been found.

moonshine-pipe-co-xxx-blend.z: XXX Blend is a Latakia-based English-Balkan-style mixture. Latakia is joined by Smyrna Turkish tobacco, virginia, and a small amount of burley; a light Kentucky bourbon casing is applied to shape the room note. Due to its pronounced Oriental proportion it leans toward the Balkan style; the burley and bourbon casing, however, set the blend apart from classic Balkan mixtures. Aimed at smokers looking for a spicy, layered English mixture where Latakia doesn't take over the body.
moonshine-pipe-co-xxx-blend.o: A subtle whiskey sweetness layers over the smoky wood aroma.

motzek-type-5-english-art.z: One of the Latakia-containing English-type blends from the Motzek workshop; sufficient independent sources confirming its composition and character could not be found.

tinder-box-after-dinner.z: A mixture among the Tinder Box chain's older house blends, its name alluding to an after-dinner smoke. It does not appear in the chain's current catalog, and since no source describing its composition has been found, the record is left incomplete.
tinder-box-after-dinner.o: Records describe it as leaving a sweetish aroma evoking coffee and dessert.

g-l-pease-abingdon.z: Abingdon is one of G. L. Pease's full-bodied, Balkan-style blends. A generous measure of Cyprus latakia is balanced with red and lemon-yellow Virginia leaves; rich Oriental leaf is added on top to build the blend's spicy layer. Where Orientals stand sharper and more upfront in the brand's blends like Ashbury and Charing Cross, they step back a bit in Abingdon; the result is a structure more evenly distributed among Virginia, Oriental, and latakia. It is designed for smokers accustomed to latakia who want a bold but not scattered, dark and smoky smoke.
g-l-pease-abingdon.o: Fills the room with a heavy woodsmoke, pine tar, and leather aroma.

vauen-auenland-broken-flake.z: No sufficient independent source documenting the composition and character of the Vauen blend called Auenland - Broken Flake has been found.
vauen-auenland-broken-flake.o: No recorded recipe has been found.

missouri-meerschaum-orchard-mist-2021.z: Orchard Mist 2021 is a limited-production blend prepared by resting select burley and virginia tobaccos for ninety days in peach brandy barrels. After resting, the tobacco is pressed and sliced into a rubbable cake form; records indicate the release was limited to 1,800 tins. Because the fruity element comes from barrel aging rather than a direct sauce, the tobacco's own taste is preserved. Prepared for smokers who follow seasonal special releases and want something between an aromatic and an unflavored blend.
missouri-meerschaum-orchard-mist-2021.o: Leaves a fruity, lightly alcohol-toned aroma reminiscent of peach brandy.

sutliff-tobacco-company-match-briggs-pip.z: Match Briggs Pipe Mixture is a Virginia-burley mixture modeled after House of Windsor's blend called Briggs Mixture. Bright Virginia leaf and soft white burley are brought together with no pronounced casing; the blend therefore rests on the tobacco's own taste. Its body is light and nicotine is low. It suits smokers looking for a plain, unpretentious classic American drugstore blend that can be smoked all day, and those wanting to start with unflavored light mixtures.
sutliff-tobacco-company-match-briggs-pip.o: Leaves a plain scent of dry hay and nuts.

heupink-bloemen-stad-ootmarsum.z: This is the blend bearing the town's name from Heupink & Bloemen Tabak, which has operated in the Dutch town of Ootmarsum since 1839; no sufficient source about its composition and character could be found.
heupink-bloemen-stad-ootmarsum.o: No reliable record of its aroma could be found.

gawith-hoggarth-co-black-bogie-unscented.z: Not enough independent sourcing was found for this study on Gawith, Hoggarth & Co.'s Black Bogie Unscented blend, so its content, cut, and character information have been left blank.

planta-veermaster.z: Veermaster is a cube-cut aromatic from Planta built on Cavendish and dark Virginia. Opening the tin gives an intense orange, cherry, and vanilla note; airing it reduces that intensity noticeably. Nicotine is very light and flavor light. Because of its cube-cut structure it needs a patient light and is prone to overheating; kept to a steady, slow rhythm it burns evenly. In the first part of the smoke, fruit and vanilla dominate; further in, the tobacco's own bitterness and sweetness emerge, and in the final third a spicy note recalling black pepper joins in. It suits those interested in aromatics carrying an intense casing.
planta-veermaster.o: Leaves a sweet, fruity, bakery-like aroma dominated by vanilla, orange, and cherry.

pipesandcigars-com-spring-training.z: Spring Training is an installment of the monthly bulk-blend line Russ Ouellette prepares for pipesandcigars.com; reports place it among the mailings of the blend-of-the-month club, but there is not enough source material describing its composition.

peretti-thanksgiving-day.z: Thanksgiving Day is a seasonal blend Peretti has reportedly prepared every year since 1939, timed to the Thanksgiving period. It is obtained by flavoring seven distinct tobaccos with dark rum and fruit juice and pressing them; it is presented in hand-breakable four-ounce blocks. The base is Burley; the block structure both lets the flavoring work into the leaf and slows the burn. The profile sits dark fruit and spicy rum, with a light floral top note, over the nutty side of the Burley base. Because it is pressed, the flavoring and leaf continue to meld as it rests in the jar. It suits smokers seeking a full-bodied seasonal tobacco that is aromatic without being drowned in sugar.
peretti-thanksgiving-day.o: Leaves a spicy rum, dark fruit, and lightly floral aroma.

king-smoking-pipes-and-cigars-king-of-en.z: A blend the American retailer King Smoking Pipes and Cigars lists as an English mixture; no independent source could be found for its content and production status.
king-smoking-pipes-and-cigars-king-of-en.o: Reportedly close to the smoky-wood scent left by Latakia-containing English blends.

imigrantes-ind-e-com-de-fumos-ltda-candi.z: This is a cherry-flavored blend in the Brazilian maker Imigrantes's Candido Giovanella line; no independent source describing its content and character could be found, so the profile is left incomplete.
imigrantes-ind-e-com-de-fumos-ltda-candi.o: No room note described in the records could be found.

cornell-diehl-sansepolcro.z: Sansepolcro is a Virginia-based blend released in Cornell & Diehl's limited Small Batch series. Red and bright Virginia leaf are joined by black Cavendish; the blend's distinguishing component is dark fire-cured Kentucky leaf double-fermented in Italy's Sansepolcro region. Tobacco growing in this region, per records, dates back to the 17th century. Red Virginia's citrus and breadlike tones combine with the Italian Kentucky's woody, smoky depth; black Cavendish carries a sweetness rounding out the pair. Being a limited run, it isn't in the current catalogue. Prepared for smokers looking for Virginia sweetness alongside a smoky note.
cornell-diehl-sansepolcro.o: A woody smoke layer mingles with a sweet tobacco scent reminiscent of bread crust.

dan-tobacco-wittkittels.z: Wittkittels is one of the all-Virginia blends from the German tobacco house Dan Tobacco. It is ribbon cut and, according to Turkish-language sources, lights easily and burns slowly. It carries no added flavoring; the fruity sweetness on the palate comes from the character of the Virginia leaf itself. Strength and flavor intensity sit between mild and medium, making it a blend that can be smoked over long stretches of the day. It's a fitting example for smokers wanting to get to know unflavored Virginia blends, or for those considering a move from aromatics to straight tobacco. Its room note stands out clearly in settings used to the sweet scent of aromatics.
dan-tobacco-wittkittels.o: Leaves a sour, sharp grassy scent.

ravenwood-fine-provisions-frog-mortons-c.z: Frog Morton's Chalet is a crossover blend in the Ravenwood Fine Provisions line, sitting between an English blend and an aromatic. It contains Cyprus Latakia, Oriental leaf, Virginia, Burley, and toasted Cavendish; the name references a long-discontinued classic series. According to the blender's description, roasted almond and vanilla notes sit atop a smooth, full English base; a light herbal spice from the mild Orientals also accompanies the smoke. It suits smokers looking for Latakia's smoky structure alongside a sweet top note. Being small-batch production, it is not continuously in stock.
ravenwood-fine-provisions-frog-mortons-c.o: Roasted almond and vanilla accompany Latakia smoke's woody aroma.

nice-ash-cigars-black-raspberry.z: An aromatic record among Nice Ash Cigars' house blends, flavored with black raspberry; not enough source material describing its composition could be found.
nice-ash-cigars-black-raspberry.o: No description could be found in the records.

peter-stokkebye-black-and-tan.z: No sufficient sources documenting the content and character of the Danish brand Peter Stokkebye's blend Black and Tan could be found.

sutliff-tobacco-company-episode-vi-speci.z: Specialist Falfa, the sixth episode of the Pipe Force series, was released in Sutliff's Per Georg Jensen-signed limited-edition line at the end of 2023. Select Virginia leaf forms the blend's body; steamed Katerini oriental adds dark forest-fruit and spice, while dark fire-cured Kentucky and St. James perique enrich the base with earth, pepper, and light smoke notes. It is not a light blend in body or nicotine. The perique ratio is kept at a level where it makes itself known without overpowering the other components. A non-continuous edition prepared for experienced smokers seeking a darker, spicier take on the Virginia-perique line.
sutliff-tobacco-company-episode-vi-speci.o: Leaves a peppery-earth scent with a light smokiness.

mac-baren-raw-classic.z: Raw Classic is the flagship product in Mac Baren's Raw series, built on unflavored tobacco. The blend is prepared from high-natural-sugar Virginia and North Carolina leaves; leaf from Brazil's Rio Grande do Sul and Santa Catarina regions is added to give the taste depth. The leaves are hand-selected, hand-destemmed, and naturally air-cured in curing barns using a centuries-old method. The product is presented as containing no flavoring and packaged at a maximum fifteen percent moisture; cut length and thickness are adjusted separately for each batch. Owing to its fine cut, it suits both rolling and pipe use. The taste comes entirely from the Virginia leaf's own sugar and hay-like dryness; aimed not at smokers seeking flavoring but at those wanting the bare tobacco taste.
mac-baren-raw-classic.o: Leaves a dry hay and sweet, untoasted tobacco aroma in the room.

niall-of-nine-aberdeen-extinction.z: One of the blends prepared in very small batches under the Niall of Nine signature; not enough independent source material documenting its composition and character could be found.

swedish-match-caravelle.z: No sufficient primary source documenting the content and character of Swedish Match's Caravelle pipe tobacco could be found.

clan-shaw-brazil.z: Not enough independent sourcing could be found to document the content and character of the Clan Shaw blend Brazil.

radfords-mixture.z: Radfords Mixture is a mixture produced by Pöschl and sold ready-rubbed in bulk in the UK. It brings together aged Virginia, Burley, and Cavendish leaf, with a light flavoring recalling fresh fruit and nuts applied on top. Seller data rates strength, flavoring intensity, and taste at two out of five, and room note at three. These figures place the blend as a light-bodied, lightly flavored everyday mixture; it suits those looking for a middle ground between aromatic and unflavored, as well as newcomers to the pipe.
radfords-mixture.o: Leaves a mild aroma reminiscent of light fruit sweetness and dry nuts.

peter-stokkebye-ps-a.z: This is a pipe tobacco listed under the name PS-A in the catalogs of the Danish brand Peter Stokkebye; the profile is left incomplete, as no independent sources documenting the blend's composition and character could be found.

pipesandcigars-com-warm-up.z: Warm Up is a listing appearing in the monthly bulk-blend line Russ Ouellette prepares for pipesandcigars.com; no source could be found describing its composition, so no detailed specification is given.

alfie-turmeaus-summer-slam.z: One of Turmeaus tobacconist's seasonal house mixtures; no accessible source documenting its content and character could be found.

pipe-republic-broadstairs.z: No reliable sources on Pipe Republic's blend Broadstairs could be found, so its content, cut, and character could not be recorded.

backwoods-mild-n-natural-buttered-rum.z: This is the version of Backwoods' rum-and-butter-flavored pipe tobacco referred to on packaging with the phrase "Mild 'N Natural"; no adequate source could be found to define this version as a separate blend.

magne-falkum-tullagreme-house-no-2.z: Tullagreme House No. 2 is the light-colored member of Tabakhaus Falkum's flake series. It's built solely from select Virginia leaves; no flavoring is applied, only a natural topping is used. The series is pressed by Kohlhase & Kopp. The taste is built on Virginia's own sweetness: it proceeds with an herbal, faintly nutty character and a lively acidity. Nicotine load is measured, suiting daytime use. Suited to smokers wanting to get to know unflavored Virginia flake, or those seeking tobacco to set aside for a long rest.
magne-falkum-tullagreme-house-no-2.o: Leaves a fine aroma reminiscent of dry hay and toasted bread crust.

faders-irish-pub.z: Not enough independent sourcing documenting the composition and character of Irish Pub, one of the house blends of the Baltimore-based Fader's tobacconist, could be found.

the-country-squire-tobacconist-upca-2023.z: UPCA 2023 is the annual blend The Country Squire prepared for the United Pipe Clubs of America, produced for the slow-smoking contest held as part of the Chicago Pipe Show. It is an unflavored mixture built from Virginia and Burley leaf. It carries a measured sweetness from natural sugar; a restrained taste line with bready, oaky, citrusy, tangy and grassy notes is reported. Its body is medium. Being designed to burn slowly makes it suited to the competition setting and to long, calm smokes. It is a limited production tied to a specific year.
the-country-squire-tobacconist-upca-2023.o: Leaves a bready, lightly oaky, dry tobacco aroma.

dan-tobacco-donegal.z: Donegal belongs to Dan Tobacco's "Treasures of Ireland" series, a nod to Irish tobacco tradition. The blend combines sweet Virginia leaf with Burley and fermented black Cavendish, topped with a faint forest-fruit note. The leaf is presented ready rubbed, making it easy to pack, and it burns cool. The Burley gives the blend a dry body and a nutty base, while the Cavendish balances it with sweetness. Suited to smokers who don't want heavy casing but want something softer and sweeter than a fully unflavored Virginia, as well as those wanting a light blend for the evening.
dan-tobacco-donegal.o: Leaves a sweet forest-fruit and baked-bread scent.

tinder-box-morning-water.z: Morning Water is an aromatic mixture noted among Tinder Box's house blends; no verifiable source describing its composition has been found.
tinder-box-morning-water.o: No reliable record of the room note has been found.

cornell-diehl-redburn.z: Redburn is a blend in which white and dark Burley leaf are mixed into red and bright Virginia, supported by a small amount of dark fire-cured Kentucky. A dark rum-and-molasses touch is added to the mixture, then it's pressed into old-style crumble cake; when preparing it, pieces are broken off and rubbed out by hand. Despite having casing, the blend doesn't fall into the aromatic class; rum and molasses stay as a sweetness layer softening Burley's earthy, tangy sharpness. Kentucky leaf occasionally brings a tone reminiscent of barbecue smoke. Full-bodied in both nicotine and body, it suits those looking for a Burley-based, sweet-but-not-sugary smoke.
cornell-diehl-redburn.o: Leaves a nutty, lightly wood-smoky scent accompanied by molasses-and-rum sweetness.

peter-heinrichs-old-kentucky-flake.z: Old Kentucky Flake was a pressed Peter Heinrichs blend built on fire-cured Kentucky leaf. Per the maker's description, Kentucky leaves from the US and African regions are balanced with light-colored Virginia to soften the taste a little; this preserves the smoky, lightly earthy character while leaving a fine sweetness in the background. Nicotine strength and fullness are on the high side; the maker describes it for experienced pipe smokers. Records indicate the blend was discontinued and not continued shortly after release due to a rust problem that developed in the tins; today it exists only as a record found in old stock.
peter-heinrichs-old-kentucky-flake.o: Leaves a woody smoke, soot, and dry-earth aroma.

gauntleys-of-nottingham-private-blend-no.z: No reliable source could be found on Gauntleys Of Nottingham's Private Blend No17.

gawith-hoggarth-co-bobs-chocolate-ready-.z: Not enough independent sourcing was found for this study on Gawith, Hoggarth & Co.'s Bobs Chocolate Ready Rubbed blend, so its content, cut, and character information have been left blank.

brigham-maritime-morning.z: Maritime Morning is the light English mixture in Brigham's Legend series. The series is built on recipes tracing old English classics. In the blend, select Oriental leaf is balanced with light and red Virginias; Latakia is used in a measured proportion. The Virginias form a grassy, tart, lightly sweet base while the Oriental leaf brings a spicy edge; Latakia sits underneath as a fine layer of smoke. Body and nicotine are light. Suitable for those newly discovering English mixtures or seeking a not-too-heavy Latakia blend for the day's first pipe.
brigham-maritime-morning.o: A light wood smoke is accompanied by a spicy, sweetish Oriental aroma.

pipe-republic-isle-of-thanet.z: No reliable sources on Pipe Republic's blend Isle of Thanet could be found, so its content, cut, and character could not be recorded.

faders-annapolitan.z: Fader's is a line of house blends offered under its own name by a long-established Baltimore tobacconist; no verifiable source could be found regarding this blend's composition and character.

lane-limited-punch.z: One of the blends Lane Limited released under a cigar brand's name; not enough sources could be found to describe its composition.

comptons-of-galashiels-mixture-10.z: Not enough sourcing could be found to document the content and character of the Compton's of Galashiels blend Mixture #10.

dein-tabak-torus-blend.z: A small-scale blend of German origin sold under the name Dein Tabak, referred to as an American type; no independent source giving its detailed profile could be found.
dein-tabak-torus-blend.o: No reliable record could be found for the room note.

the-eastern-company-moassel-saloum.z: Moassel Saloum is a molasses-worked shisha tobacco (mu'assel) made by Eastern Company S.A.E., Egypt's largest tobacco producer. The product is usually sold in 250-gram packs and is noted as one of the most widespread mu'assel brands in Egypt. It is counted among the classic, non-fruit-flavored type: here the molasses functions more as a binder keeping the leaf moist and cohesive than as a sweetener, so the tobacco's own taste comes forward. It is not in the same category as pipe blends; it is aimed at those smoking shisha and after an unflavored mu'assel.
the-eastern-company-moassel-saloum.o: Leaves a heavy, sweet aroma reminiscent of boiled sugar molasses.

esoterica-tobacciana-kingsbridge.z: Kingsbridge is among the Esoterica line's ribbon-cut blends that lean toward aromatic without being fully classed as one; retailer listings place it in the virginia family. It is produced by J. F. Germain & Son in Jersey. The topping stays light and does not cover the leaf's own taste; virginia sweetness is joined by the soft, sweetish body of dark leaves. It suits smokers seeking a middle ground between aromatic and unadulterated virginia.
esoterica-tobacciana-kingsbridge.o: Leaves a lightly sweet, fruity and warm tobacco scent.

edwards-supreme.z: No sufficient independent sourcing could be reached to document the composition and character of Supreme, a pipe tobacco from Edward's.

pfeifendepot-no-200-bengals.z: No. 200 Bengals is one of the numbered blends of Gerd Jansens Pfeifendepot; its name and concept take inspiration from the classic Bengal Slices tobacco. It contains dark Virginia, black Cavendish, Latakia, and Perique, presented as broken flake. Latakia lays down the smoky base but doesn't define the blend on its own; the sweet and spicy sides of Virginia and Perique stay prominent, while the black Cavendish adds softness and fullness to the smoke. Nicotine strength is above medium, and it produces a generous amount of smoke. It suits smokers accustomed to Latakia blends who enjoy working with a pressed cut; sold in a 50 gram package.
pfeifendepot-no-200-bengals.o: Fills the room with a heavy scent of smoke, pine wood, and leather.
