dan-tobacco-choo-choo-train.z: A pipe tobacco under the German maker Dan Tobacco Manufaktur; no reliable source on the blend's composition or character was found, so no further detail is given.

orlik-tobacco-company-a-s-rubbed-out-mil.z: This product is understood, from its name, to be a rubbed-out flake-cut, honeyed Virginia blend; not enough source material describing its composition and character could be found.

dreaming-pipes-mount-tai.z: Not enough sourcing could be found to document the composition and character of Mount Tai, a pipe tobacco from Dreaming Pipes.
dreaming-pipes-mount-tai.o: Not enough records exist for the scent it leaves in the room.

the-smoker-wise-fox.z: A house blend called Wise Fox from the American tobacconist The Smoker; it is noted as an American-style mixture, but no verifiable source describing its composition has been found.

mike-russ-the-mind-meld-the-mind-meld-vi.z: The unflavored Virginia blend of the Mind Meld line, ribbon cut; no detailed source regarding its composition could be found.
mike-russ-the-mind-meld-the-mind-meld-vi.o: Leaves an aroma of dry hay and baked bread.

jack-lee-blend-spring-equinox.z: This is one of the Virginia-forward products from the now-closed American blender Jack Lee Blend; no reliable source describing its content could be found.

james-barber-medium-virginia-shag.z: Recorded as a medium-bodied, fine shag-cut James Barber blend made from straight Virginia leaf; no detailed maker's description could be found.

gawith-hoggarth-co-sweet-blackcurrant-tw.z: Sweet Blackcurrant Twist is Gawith, Hoggarth & Co.'s blackcurrant-topped version of its brown Burma base. Fire-cured leaves are twisted into a fine rope; the tobacco arrives as a dense mass that yields small coin-like slices when cut. The pouch aroma is oily and spicy; on the smoke, the earthy, smoky core of the fire-curing is preserved while the sweet topping and inverted sugar worked into the leaf during production add a sweet top layer to the smoke. Since it isn't steam-cooked under pressure, it stays intense in nicotine; it needs to be thinly sliced and smoked slowly. An entry for those wanting a topped but still strong Burma tobacco. Gawith, Hoggarth & Co. is one of the English producers that continues traditional twist (rope) production at its Kendal factory, hand-twisting fire-cured leaves into rope form. Because twist tobaccos don't go through a pressure-cooking stage, they stay intense in nicotine; records indicate these ropes are sold for both chewing and pipe smoking.
gawith-hoggarth-co-sweet-blackcurrant-tw.o: Leaves an aroma combining dark forest-berry and tobacco scents.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-yachtsman.z: No sufficient source separately documenting the content and cut of the non-plug presentation of the Irish-origin Yachtsman name could be found.

telfords-pipes-cigars-parish-4.z: One of roughly forty house blends prepared by Telford's Pipe & Cigar shop in Mill Valley, California; no accessible source describing the blend's composition and character could be found.

watch-city-cigar-none-of-your-business.z: Watch City Cigar's blend called None of Your Business is, according to records, one of the house blends of the Waltham, Massachusetts tobacconist shop; as no sufficient independent source could be found documenting its composition and character, this entry remains incomplete.

gurkha-rare-breed.z: Rare Breed is a Latakia-centered English mixture in the pipe tobacco line of Gurkha, a brand better known for cigars. The ribbon-cut blend is built from red Virginia, white Burley, Turkish-Oriental leaf, and a small amount of Perique, joined by Cyprian Latakia; the tin note leads with a smoky, dark-fruit air. It carries no topping or top note. On the palate, Latakia's measured smoke, the Oriental leaf's spicy-tart edge, and Virginia's light sweetness advance together, while Perique leaves a fruity depth in the background. Since nicotine stays light to medium, it's a suitable option for smokers new to Latakia mixtures as well as those looking for a milder English blend. Offered in sealed 50-gram tins.
gurkha-rare-breed.o: Leaves a room aroma reminiscent of wood fire and barbecue smoke, carrying dark-fruit sweetness underneath.

mac-baren-7-seas-regular-blend.z: 7 Seas Regular Blend is the starting point of Mac Baren's American-style aromatic series. It contains black cavendish, burley and Virginia; presented as a ribbon cut with high moisture in the pack. It's one of the series' most pronounced examples of casing coming to the fore; the intense sweetness largely masks the leaf's own taste. Nicotine level is light. Since tongue bite and gurgling can occur when smoked quickly, slow puffing and airing before packing are needed. Aimed at smokers who want a pronounced flavor casing; it won't meet the expectations of those seeking unflavored tobacco taste.
mac-baren-7-seas-regular-blend.o: Leaves an intense, sugary and sharp sweet room note.

orlik-tobacco-company-a-s-westminster.z: No verifiable source describing the composition of the Westminster blend registered under the Orlik name could be found; it should not be confused with the identically named G. L. Pease blend.
orlik-tobacco-company-a-s-westminster.o: No description could be found in the records.

gawith-hoggarth-co-kendal-gold-lemon.z: Referred to as a lemon-flavored version within the Kendal Gold shag series; no reliable sourcing giving details specific to this version's composition and character could be found.
gawith-hoggarth-co-kendal-gold-lemon.o: Leaves a lemon-peel and sweet tobacco aroma.

tom-eltang-virginia.z: Tom Eltang Virginia is the unflavored member of the series Danish pipe maker Tom Eltang developed together with Cornell & Diehl. Red and bright Virginia leaves form the backbone of the blend; a small amount of Burley is added for a cool smoke. It is ribbon cut, which makes packing and lighting easier. Virginia's natural sugar and grassy sweetness stay in front, while the Burley broadens the taste and slows the burn. According to sources, no sour or vinegary turn appears even near the bottom of the bowl, and tongue bite is limited. The series was designed with smokers in mind who want a plain tobacco that can be smoked all day; it is also a fitting starting point for those new to the world of unflavored Virginia.
tom-eltang-virginia.o: Leaves a lightly sweet tobacco aroma reminiscent of baked bread and dry hay.

wessex-gold-standard.z: Gold Standard is the full-bodied blend of the Wessex series in the classic English mixture mold. According to the maker's description, it's prepared solely from natural Virginia, Latakia, and Turkish (Oriental) leaf, containing no artificial flavoring, with the leaves rested after blending.
wessex-gold-standard.o: Leaves a scent combining smoky Latakia and dry hay.

ken-byron-ventures-uzumaki-2021.z: The 2021 release of Uzumaki is reported to be Virginia- and Burley-forward; no independent source could be found to detail its contents.
ken-byron-ventures-uzumaki-2021.o: No reliable record of the room note could be found.

rattray-summer-edition-2020.z: Summer Edition 2020 is a one-year edition of the summer series produced by Kohlhase & Kopp for Rattray. Cornflower petals are visually mixed into the body built from Virginia, black Cavendish, and Burley leaf. On the flavor side, gold kiwi, nashi pear, and violet notes are used, resulting in a fruity-exotic top note. It is a loose cut, classified according to reports in the medium-strength band. It suits fans of aromatic smokes looking for a light, sweet summer blend; being a limited edition, it is not in continuous production.
rattray-summer-edition-2020.o: A light floral violet note accompanies the sweet kiwi and pear aroma.

schurch-sodalit-114.z: Sodalit 114, signed by Schürch, is left as an undetailed record since no independent source sufficient to fill in its profile could be found.

my-smoking-shop-maple-cavendish.z: A cavendish-based bulk blend flavored with a maple syrup sauce; sufficient sources describing its detailed composition could not be found.

cornell-diehl-apricots-cream.z: Cornell & Diehl Apricots & Cream is an aromatic composed entirely of dark leaves. The base is built from unsweetened black cavendish and some Green River Vanilla leaf; the brand's own cream-based flavoring and apricot liqueur are added on top. The cut is ribbon and the tobacco arrives moist. It offers a low-nicotine, soft, sweet-leaning smoke; leaf character stays in the background, with the creamy, fruity flavoring in front. It suits smokers looking for pronouncedly scented, light, sweet aromatics, as well as newcomers to the pipe.
cornell-diehl-apricots-cream.o: Leaves an aroma in the room reminiscent of creamy apricot dessert.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-erinmore-.z: Erinmore Plug is a blend of Virginia, burley, and black cavendish leaves pressed into plug form. The plug's color is lighter than comparable products; veins ranging from brown to yellow run straight, and the texture is nearly wood-hard. Its scent is fruity, carrying casing notes evoking anise or licorice. The brand is Irish in origin; production is carried out today by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. Being a plug, it is sliced and rubbed for preparation, which gives control over moisture and burn. Suited to smokers with an aromatic leaning who also seek the intensity of pressed tobaccos.
scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-erinmore-.o: Leaves a sweet, fruity scent close to anise and licorice.

kohlhase-kopp-und-co-kg-limited-edition-.z: No manufacturer or retailer record could be found documenting the contents of Kohlhase & Kopp's 2009 annual limited series.

edwards-masterpiece.z: No sufficient independent sourcing could be reached to document the composition and character of Masterpiece, a pipe tobacco from Edward's.

century-century-merchants-folly-krumble-.z: Merchants Folly is among the flagship records of the Century line. Per seller descriptions, old-crop Old Belt red virginia leaf is brought together with steamed cavendish; the blend is topped with a flavoring reminiscent of vanilla and whiskey. It is offered in what is called Krumble Kake form — pressed under heat and pressure yet easily crumbled by hand — and needs to be broken apart and aired before loading into the pipe. Red Old Belt virginia is described with grassy, citrusy notes and dark cooked fruit; cavendish softens and sweetens this base, while the top flavoring remains a layer that does not overtake the tobacco. The pressed structure gives a slow, cool smoke. Suitable for smokers who enjoy Virginia-based, lightly flavored records that reward taking their time.
century-century-merchants-folly-krumble-.o: Leaves a grainy sweetness reminiscent of baked bread together with vanilla and a light alcohol aroma.

dan-tobacco-okapi.z: Okapi is an aromatic blend Dan Tobacco builds on high-natural-sugar Virginia leaf. The leaf is first pressed, then hand-crumbled into a ready-rubbed state; this preparation preserves the flake's slow burn while making it easier to pack. Creamy vanilla and rose essence are used as casing. It's a mild-nicotine tobacco with a soft smoke; since casing is kept moderate, the Virginia's breadlike sweetness still comes through. Suited to smokers wanting a measured aromatic they can smoke all day, staying away from heavy syrupy blends. Distributed in 50- and 250-gram packagings.
dan-tobacco-okapi.o: Leaves a soft vanilla scent with a light hint of rosewater.

4noggins-lord-methleys.z: Lord Methley's is an aromatic combining Virginia, Burley, and black Cavendish. According to the manufacturer, the blend was developed for a real person, Lord Methley, from West Yorkshire, England. The flavoring is built to evoke a berry pie. Virginia's sweetness, Burley's smoothness and nutty base, and black Cavendish's dark sweetness form the profile. Nicotine is low and flavor mild; the maker notes the blend doesn't bite the tongue. With this structure, it suits smokers looking for an all-day-smokable blend with pronounced flavoring but low nicotine.
4noggins-lord-methleys.o: Leaves a sweet aroma reminiscent of a berry pie fresh from the oven.

brebbia-opera-mixture-no-32.z: No sufficient independent sources documenting the content and character of the blend named Opera (Mixture No. 32) under the Brebbia brand could be found.

motzek-type-1-old-english.z: A numbered blend from the Motzek workshop's classic English mixture line; sufficient independent sources documenting its proportions and character could not be found.

davis-and-son-tobacconists-trafalgar.z: This is referred to as a latakia-containing English mixture prepared at the counter of Davis & Son Tobacconists in Wilmington, North Carolina; since no detailed published profile could be found, its composition and ratios remain unclear.
davis-and-son-tobacconists-trafalgar.o: Leaves a woody, incense-like scent from the latakia.

watch-city-cigar-roanoke-ltd.z: This is a limited-run Virginia-based blend from Watch City Cigar, not in the current catalog; no source could be found regarding its composition.
watch-city-cigar-roanoke-ltd.o: No record could be found regarding the room note.

mission-pipe-shop-bills-blend.z: Bill's Blend is one of Mission Pipe Shop's house blends named after a customer; no accessible source documenting its composition could be found.

paul-olsen-curly-44.z: No reliable source could be found for the Paul Olsen pipe tobacco called Curly 44, so a detailed profile could not be produced.

peterson-st-patricks-day-2015.z: St. Patrick's Day 2015 is a limited edition blend released as part of Peterson's St. Patrick's Day series specific to that year; the profile is left incomplete, as no sufficient first-hand sources confirming its content and character could be found.

smoke-king-steeplechase-mixture.z: A mixture counted among the blends Smoke-King sells under its own name; per records it's assessed in the English-type mixture category, but no source documenting its composition could be found.

uhles-christmas-blend-2011.z: Uhle's seasonal Christmas blend for the year 2011; no source documenting its composition has been found.
uhles-christmas-blend-2011.o: No reliable source describing the room note has been found.

sillems-musketeer.z: Musketeer is the Sillem's series' burley-forward aromatic blend, produced by Kohlhase & Kopp in Germany. According to records, the mixture is half cube-cut burley and half coarsely cut black cavendish; this structure gives both a dry, nutty base and a sweet counterpoint. On the smoke, burley's earthy, snack-like, lightly spicy character leads; a baking-spice casing evoking cinnamon joins this base. Nicotine is more pronounced than in light aromatics, and the smoke is dry. Suited to smokers who enjoy measured, burley-based aromatics that are not overly syrupy.
sillems-musketeer.o: Leaves a nutty sweetness mixed into a cinnamon-and-baking-spice scent.

mcclelland-no-5100-red-cake.z: No. 5100 Red Cake is one of the best-known Virginias in McClelland's bulk catalog. Per the maker's description, it's prepared as an English-style Virginia cake, rare in America: the matured cake is sold fully rubbed out, so it needs no further preparation. It has been used both as a medium-bodied Virginia smoked on its own and as a base tobacco for building other blends. Its structure is mild, its taste sweet and matured-Virginia-forward; the brand's characteristic tangy aroma is pronounced here. Since the nicotine dose is moderate, it's also smokable during the day. Considered a foundational tobacco for those wanting an entry into red Virginia character and for smokers who build their own blends. Production ended when the brand closed in 2018.
mcclelland-no-5100-red-cake.o: Leaves the brand's distinctive tobacco aroma, sweet and reminiscent of tangy fruit and vinegar.

robert-mcconnell-latakia-mixture-1848.z: Latakia Mixture 1848 is an English blend in Robert McConnell's Heritage line. It contains bright and red Virginia grades along with a generous amount of Latakia; with no Oriental leaf used, the taste rests on the contrast between smoke and Virginia sweetness. The blend was previously sold under a different name before being reissued under this one, a nod to the brand's founding year. The ribbon-cut leaf lights easily; flavor intensity is high and nicotine medium. It is prepared for smokers looking for an unflavored, classic-style, Latakia-heavy mixture. The Heritage line is produced by the Kohlhase & Kopp blenders in Germany, following old English recipes.
robert-mcconnell-latakia-mixture-1848.o: Leaves an intense smoke aroma reminiscent of wood fire and pine tar.

cornell-diehl-tuggle-hall.z: Tuggle Hall is a ribbon-cut mixture setting Cyprus Latakia and a small amount of Perique over a white Burley base. The maker describes the blend as recalling old-style English mixtures; it's also referred to by catalogue number 965. Burley builds a soft, nutty base, Latakia adds a deep smoky layer, and Perique enlivens the blend with a sweet-spicy sharpness. It's a cool-burning, medium-bodied smoke. Suited to smokers who like Latakia blends but want an earthy base rather than Virginia sweetness.
cornell-diehl-tuggle-hall.o: Leaves a pronounced wood-smoke scent over a nutty base.

paul-olsen-old-school.z: One of the blends from the Copenhagen-based Paul Olsen name; no independent sources documenting its composition and character could be found.

motzek-latakia-revival.z: No independent source documenting the composition and character of the Motzek blend called Latakia Revival could be found.

john-cotton-john-cottons-double-pressed-.z: A pressed Virginia-Burley blend released under the historic Scottish brand John Cotton; no verifiable information on its current production profile could be found.
john-cotton-john-cottons-double-pressed-.o: No verifiable information on its room note could be found.

peretti-125-burley-slices.z: For Peretti's blend called 125 Burley Slices, no independent sources such as the maker's own materials or a reliable product record could be found, so no definitive information can be given about the blend's composition and character.

pipesandcigars-com-anglers-dream.z: Angler's Dream was designed in 2011 for pipesandcigars.com as a tobacco meant to replace traditional counter-sold American blends but built from higher-quality leaf. Its body is made of select Burley leaf, joined by red Virginia and unflavored black Cavendish. Instead of the vanilla, fruit, or liqueur usual in aromatics, a small amount of honey, chocolate, and cinnamon is used. Chocolate works in the same direction as Burley; honey and chocolate are felt mostly in the room note, while cinnamon comes through in the taste itself. It was discontinued for a time due to rising costs, then brought back in bulk form after dropping the tin packaging. It suits smokers looking for a Burley-heavy, lightly flavored everyday blend.
pipesandcigars-com-anglers-dream.o: A light cinnamon accompanies the honey and cocoa aroma.

baraccini-capriccioso.z: Capriccioso is a tinned mixture blended by Scandinavian Tobacco Group under the Italian pipe brand Baraccini. Measured Latakia and Perique are added to a traditional American body built on Burley and Virginia; a barely perceptible dried-fruit sweetness is worked over it. This structure re-creates the tangy-sweet, lightly smoky balance of old-style tinned blends. The burn is cool, and the flavor side is layered: Burley's nutty dryness, Perique's spicy sharpness, and Latakia's woody trace appear in turn. Nicotine is medium. It suits those looking for a balanced tinned blend, neither fully English nor fully aromatic, that can be smoked all day.
baraccini-capriccioso.o: Leaves a lightly woody, smoky tobacco room note carrying dried-fruit sweetness.

park-lane-tobacconist-park-lane-no-15.z: No reliable source describing the composition and character of Park-Lane No. 15, one of the counter blends from Park-Lane Tobacconist in Clifton Park, New York, could be found.

sutliff-tobacco-company-pumpkin-spice.z: One of Sutliff Tobacco Company's seasonal aromatic products; since no accessible source describing the blend's composition could be found, the profile is left incomplete.

mac-baren-amsterdamer.z: Amsterdamer is Mac Baren's pipe tobacco line prepared in the Dutch style. Per the manufacturer's description, the backbone of the blend is Virginia leaves from two continents plus dark fired Kentucky; the loose-cut (fijne snede) presentation eases packing. Though the series name references the Dutch tradition, it's produced in Denmark. Virginia's natural sugar and dark fired Kentucky's smoky, salty-earthy line can be considered the blend's two main axes. It carries no heavy top flavor; the taste comes from the leaves' own character. It sits in the medium band for nicotine. Suited to those seeking an unflavored or very lightly flavored everyday blend with a smoky side.
mac-baren-amsterdamer.o: Leaves a sweetish, dry tobacco room note toward wood smoke.

hearth-home-obsidian.z: Obsidian is a blend made entirely of dark leaf: stoved Virginia, Latakia, toasted black Cavendish, and Perique are brought together in measured proportions. The result is a uniform black appearance like the volcanic glass it is named for. The blend's design goal is for the components to meld so thoroughly that no single one stands out individually; the result is sweet, smoky, and spicy elements advancing together without overriding one another. It is noted for burning cool. Aimed at smokers who love dark-leaf profiles but want a cohesive taste where no single component dominates.
hearth-home-obsidian.o: Leaves a heavy tobacco aroma evoking smoke, dark fruit, and spice.

my-smoking-shop-uncle-bobs-mixture.z: An aromatic house blend prepared at the tobacconist My Smoking Shop's own counter; no independent source about its composition could be found.

iwan-ries-china-black-fire-cured.z: This is a house blend built on fire-cured leaf, part of Chicago's Iwan Ries & Co.'s China Black line; no sufficient source describing its content and character in detail could be found.
iwan-ries-china-black-fire-cured.o: Records indicate the smoky aroma of fire-cured leaf is prominent.

sterling-tobacco-co-pride-of-sterling.z: Pride of Sterling is a house blend in Sterling Tobacco Company's unflavored category. Per the maker's description, it's built from burley, Virginia, and oriental leaves, with no flavoring applied. This three-leaf structure balances burley's dry body with Virginia's bready sweetness and the oriental's light spice; easy settling into the bowl and even burning are counted among the blend's notable traits. Nicotine is medium. Suited to smokers seeking a classic American mixture without added flavoring, for all-day smoking.
sterling-tobacco-co-pride-of-sterling.o: Leaves a plain tobacco scent carrying dry hay and a light spice.

motzek-psog-club-blend.z: A special blend the Motzek workshop prepared for a pipe club; sufficient independent sources documenting its composition and character could not be found.

per-g-jensen-the-helmet.z: The Helmet is a member of the Viking Collection series bearing Per G. Jensen's name, and records describe it as appearing black throughout, bringing together three distinct types of cavendish. Alongside Virginia cavendish, it uses rustica and Katerini oriental leaf darkened by the cavendish process. As a result, unlike classic cavendish tobaccos, the blend relies on the sweetness produced by heat processing rather than a top-note flavoring. Rustica lends the blend an earthy, herbal body along with pronounced fullness, while Katerini, despite being darkened, retains part of its oriental character, providing light sweetness, measured spice, and an even burn. It suits smokers seeking a dark, full-bodied cavendish who choose tobaccos that don't lean on added flavoring.
per-g-jensen-the-helmet.o: Leaves a dark, lightly sweet, herbal toasted-leaf scent.

sutliff-tobacco-company-mixture-no-79.z: Mixture No. 79 is one of the bulk blends from the Richmond-based Sutliff Tobacco Company; sufficient independent sources documenting its composition and character could not be found.

kohlhase-kopp-und-co-kg-seegar.z: Seegar is one of six blends in Hamburg-based Kohlhase & Kopp's Caribbean Blue line. The series consists of Danish-style aromatics named after pirates and privateer-commissioned sailors, built on tropical tastes and scents. Seegar's body is formed by Virginia leaves and cavendish, with a small amount of Cyprus latakia added on top. On the casing side, tonka bean, citrus, rum and caramel come forward. The presence of latakia sets it apart from purely sweet aromatics: a light smoke and woody depth joins the syrupy sweetness. Since it stays measured in nicotine, it's suited to all-day smoking. A blend designed for those who love Danish-style aromatics but want a smoky undertone rather than a purely sweet profile. Kohlhase & Kopp was founded by Michael Kohlhase in 1976 and took its current name in 1979 when Bernd Kopp joined.
kohlhase-kopp-und-co-kg-seegar.o: Leaves a fine woody smoke note beneath caramel and rum sweetness.

planta-image-virginia.z: Planta Image Virginia is a pipe tobacco blend for which there is not enough independent source material.
planta-image-virginia.o: Not enough records could be found on the room note.

tinder-box-highland-whiskey.z: Highland Whiskey is an aromatic Tinder Box blend bringing together flue-cured Virginia leaves of Zimbabwean and Carolina origin with black Cavendish and toasted Burley. Scotch Highland whisky is used as the casing; the blend is loose cut and, per records, rested with balanced moisture. Virginia's sweetness together with Cavendish's sugary softness carries the malt and oak associations of the casing; Burley sets a dry base that keeps the taste from scattering. Nicotine load is low. Suited to smokers who enjoy aromatics but still want tobacco taste to show beneath the casing.
tinder-box-highland-whiskey.o: Leaves an aroma reminiscent of grain whisky and caramelized sugar, with a light malt hint.

sutliff-tobacco-company-moroccan-spice.z: Moroccan Spice is a spice-based aromatic from Sutliff's Private Stock line. Aged Virginia, white burley, and sweet black cavendish are used together; what distinguishes this blend is the application of a spice compound rather than a single sweet topping. On the palate, burley's softness and Virginia's woody sweetness lay the groundwork. Over this comes nutmeg first, followed by cumin and red pepper flake; cinnamon, turmeric, a touch of anise, sesame oil, and saffron form the more distant layers. Nicotine strength is below average, while flavor intensity is high. Suited to those seeking something beyond sweet aromatics and who lean toward spiced smokes.
sutliff-tobacco-company-moroccan-spice.o: Leaves a warm spice scent led by nutmeg and cinnamon.

peter-stokkebye-danish-export-no-81.z: No sufficient sources documenting the content and character of the Danish brand Peter Stokkebye's blend Danish Export (No.81) could be found.

smokers-pride-black-cavendish.z: Smoker's Pride Black Cavendish is the cavendish-based record in the brand's everyday aromatic line sold in large packaging. The body consists of black cavendish darkened through steaming, joined by a light burley share. A soft vanilla-direction flavoring is applied on top, and the blend is prepared in ribbon cut. Nicotine share is low, and the smoke is cool and soft; cavendish's moisture slows the burn. No complex flavor construction is aimed for; a sweet, single-note smoke is offered. Suited to those seeking an economical, easy aromatic for daily pipe use, and to smokers new to the aromatic category.
smokers-pride-black-cavendish.o: Leaves a scent of sweet vanilla and caramelized sugar.

sutliff-tobacco-company-f-g-t-51.z: F.G.T. 51 is an unflavored burley blend Sutliff offers in bulk. The dominant note is nutty; the smoke is dry, smooth, and far from sweet. A notable trait of the blend is that it struggles to stay lit; when smoked slowly it often requires relighting. For this reason it's a record better suited to use as a base or component leaf in homemade blends rather than smoking on its own. Nicotine strength is medium.
sutliff-tobacco-company-f-g-t-51.o: Leaves a dry nut and hay scent.

dream-castle-tobacco-company-black-and-b.z: Not enough sourcing could be found to document the character of Black and Burley, a blend from Dream Castle Tobacco Company.

the-ridge-pipe-tobacco-fire-drake.z: No reliable source could be found on The Ridge Pipe Tobacco's Fire-Drake blend.

cobblestone-cafe-mocha-flake.z: Cafe Mocha Flake is an aromatic blend in which burley, Oriental, and Virginia leaves are pressed into flake. The leaf side gives earthy and floral tones with a light spice, while a Dutch-style sauce carries coffee, tangy-sweet raspberry, and a small amount of vanilla. Rubbing out the slices and airing them for a while evens out the smoke. The blend belongs to Cobblestone's Cafe series. It is aimed at smokers looking for an aromatic sauce paired with a pressed-flake structure, wanting an aromatic that isn't purely cavendish-based.
cobblestone-cafe-mocha-flake.o: A tangy red-fruit aroma layers over fresh coffee and vanilla.

pfeifendepot-merlin-cut-plug.z: No. 090 Merlin Cut Plug is one of the numbered blends of the Hamburg-based house Gerd Jansens Pfeifendepot, produced by KOPP Tobaccos. It is built from hand-selected Brazilian and African Virginias combined with fire-cured Kentucky and Perique; the block coming out of the press is sliced and sold as flake, though the maker describes the cut as flake. On the maker's scale, strength is rated four out of five; it carries no flavoring, giving it a natural character. Kentucky lays down a smoky, earthy base, Perique brings a dark fruit and spice dimension, and Virginia carries the sweet side. It suits smokers on the Virginia-Perique axis looking for an all-day smoke with above-average nicotine strength. It comes in 50 gram and 500 gram bulk packages.
pfeifendepot-merlin-cut-plug.o: Leaves a dark, earthy tobacco aroma recalling a mix of smoke and dried fruit.

consolidated-after-dinner.z: No independent, reliable sourcing could be found regarding the Consolidated blend After Dinner.

exclusiv-sweet-coconut.z: No verifiable source could be found regarding the producer, composition, and character of this pipe tobacco marketed under the Exclusiv name.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-troost-bl.z: Troost is one of the Netherlands' best-known pipe-tobacco brands; the blend called Black Cavendish represents the brand's black cavendish tradition. Steam-processed, flavored dark cavendish leaves build the blend's body; dark-fired Kentucky added alongside gives a smoky, earthy depth. The Dutch-style fine (shag) cut lets the blend light quickly and burn cool. The character stays close to Danish aromatics, though the casing applied on top is not pronounced; most of the sweetness comes from the cavendish process itself. Suited to those seeking a dark, mild smoke without a heavy sugar load, and to those curious about the classic Continental European style.
scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-troost-bl.o: Leaves a sweet-molasses and lightly smoky wood scent.

castello-sea-rock.z: No reliable source could be found for the pipe tobacco named Sea Rock under the Castello brand, so its character, content and production status could not be recorded.

hearth-home-fusiliers-ration.z: Fusilier's Ration is an English blend built from plentiful Cyprian Latakia and pronounced Oriental varieties, topped with bright yellow Virginia. Unflavored black Cavendish is used for body; there is also a light old-style seasoning kept in the background, applied sparingly enough not to mask the tobacco's own taste. The tobacco is offered as a pressed crumble cake meant to be broken up by hand, so it needs crumbling before packing. The blend is a work blender Russ Ouellette prepared as a tribute to the now-discontinued Bengal Slices. The smoke is bright and smoky with a short finish. Suited to smokers familiar with Latakia-forward blends who are willing to prepare cake tobacco; the room note is strong and noticeable indoors.
hearth-home-fusiliers-ration.o: Leaves a heavy, smoky aroma resembling incense and pine-wood smoke.

edwards-colonial.z: Not enough sourcing could be found to document the composition and character of Colonial, a pipe tobacco from Edward's. Edward's is a tobacconist business based in Tampa, Florida.

fribourg-treyer-special-brown-flake.z: Special Brown Flake is a flake obtained by maturing pure Virginia leaves under pressure and slicing them. A light, rum-like top note reminiscent of sailors' rations is applied over it; this topping adds an alcoholic sweet edge to the blend without masking the Virginia character. In the smoke, meadow-like tastes and dark, raisin-like fruit are balanced by a fresh tartness reminiscent of lemon peel. Since it is pressed tightly, it needs to be rubbed out, and it burns slowly; it is a blend prepared for smokers leaning toward flake culture and ripe Virginia sweetness.
fribourg-treyer-special-brown-flake.o: Leaves a lightly alcoholic, sweetish aroma settling over raisins and lemon peel.

gawith-hoggarth-co-brown-flake-aromatic.z: Brown Flake Aromatic is a flake blend prepared by combining hot-pressed, stoved Virginia leaves with Burley. Traditional English sauces based on liquorice root, fig, and tonka bean are applied; this topping combination is one of the typical examples of the Lakeland style unique to Kendal production. The flakes are dark brown, oily, and tightly pressed. In the smoke, the dark, bread-like sweetness of the stoved Virginia joins with Burley's earthy base; the topping sits above it as a floral layer reminiscent of rose and Turkish delight. It burns slowly, carries a medium nicotine load, and the flakes need to be rubbed out and aired. This is a record for those wanting to get to know the Lakeland style's distinctive floral topping; setting aside a dedicated pipe is a common approach given how persistent the scent and taste are.
gawith-hoggarth-co-brown-flake-aromatic.o: Leaves a sweet aroma reminiscent of flowers, rose, and Turkish delight, with the heavy tone of liquorice root spreading through the room.

peter-stokkebye-royal-guard-vanilla.z: This is a pipe tobacco listed under the name Royal Guard Vanilla in the catalogs of the Danish brand Peter Stokkebye; the profile is left incomplete, as no independent sources documenting the blend's composition and character could be found.

charutaria-cruzeiro-ltda-tabaco-blend-pe.z: The entry has been left incomplete as no reliable source could be found for Charutaria Cruzeiro Ltda.'s Tabaco Blend Pêssego (Peach) blend.

drew-estate-gatsby-luxury-flake.z: Gatsby Luxury Flake is a pressed blend in Drew Estate's pipe tobacco line. Sweet Virginia leaves are brought together with cavendish and cut into long flake slices. The taste runs over an earthy base, accompanied by a light sweetness and a dried-fig echo. The body is light to medium. Being flake cut, it requires preparation before packing. Since Drew Estate ended pipe tobacco production, the blend is no longer produced.
drew-estate-gatsby-luxury-flake.o: Leaves a trace of light sweetness and dried fig sitting over an earthy base.

peter-stokkebye-norwegian-blend-no-80.z: Norwegian Blend is a three-component blend built from flue-cured Virginia, air-cured Burley, and sun-cured Oriental leaf; the maker's description calls it American-style. It is a fine shag cut kept at low moisture. Virginia carries natural sweetness, Burley cools the smoke, and Oriental brings a spicy seasoning. It is unflavored, burns evenly and cool, and leaves a light-colored ash. It suits smokers who enjoy the fast smoke of finely cut tobaccos and want a straightforward blend for quick sessions; because of the fine cut, a measured pace is needed.
peter-stokkebye-norwegian-blend-no-80.o: Leaves a woody, lightly spiced, dry tobacco aroma.

cobblestone-burley-plug.z: Burley Plug is a blend from Cobblestone's Brick series, prepared as a crumble cake. Its base is burley; Virginia is added for sweetness, along with dark fire-cured Kentucky for smoke and body. The cake is dark brown, moderate in moisture, and breaks apart easily by hand. On the smoke, unprocessed burley's nutty taste leads, dark Kentucky builds a smoky frame, and Virginia leaves a grassy, hay-like trace in the background. Cobblestone is a brand operated within the U.S.-based Sutliff company. This entry is aimed at smokers looking for an unsauced, burley-heavy, nicotine-rich plug tobacco.
cobblestone-burley-plug.o: Nutty and dry-grass traces mix into the fire-cured leaf's smoky aroma.

holger-danske-original-honey-dew.z: No sufficient independent source could be found for this blend, described as aromatic, from the Danish brand Holger Danske.

mr-bs-wild-cherry.z: Wild Cherry is the earlier name for the cherry-flavored blend in Canadian Brigham's Mr. B's line. Black-cherry flavoring is added to a base of toasted black cavendish along with cavendish and virginia leaves. The blend was discontinued under this name, with the same recipe continuing to be sold as Wild Anatolia; the two entries therefore describe the same tobacco.
mr-bs-wild-cherry.o: Leaves an aroma of ripe black cherry and sweet cavendish.

peterson-de-luxe-mixture.z: De Luxe Mixture is a ribbon-cut aromatic blend built from Virginia leaf and black Cavendish. Its flavoring brings forward vanilla, honey, and walnut notes; a sweet, bready scent is noticeable when the tin is opened. The smoke is light and cool; nicotine strength is low and flavor intensity stays moderate. Cavendish's creamy sweetness forms the blend's backbone, while Virginia leaves a light tartness in the background. It suits smokers seeking a mild aromatic, free of bite, that can be smoked for long stretches during the day.
peterson-de-luxe-mixture.o: Leaves a soft trace recalling honeyed bread and vanilla.

ken-byron-ventures-diogenes-club-2022.z: Named after the club from the Sherlock Holmes stories, this is one of Ken Byron Ventures' annual limited releases; no accessible maker's profile could be found to document the 2022 batch's contents.

thepiperoom-com-gandelf-dark-aromatic.z: No sufficient independent source documenting the composition and character of the ThePipeRoom.com pipe tobacco called Gändëlf Dark Aromatic has been found.

mcclelland-a-m-pipe.z: A.M. Pipe is one of the light English mixtures McClelland sold in bulk. Its name and character connect to the tradition of classic light Latakia blends designed for a morning smoke; records indicate it was offered as a counterpart to Dunhill's Early Morning Pipe. Its contents hold a Virginia body, a measured amount of Latakia, and Oriental tobacco. Since the Latakia proportion is kept low, the smoky side doesn't overwhelm the Virginia's sweetness; the ribbon cut allows easy packing and even burning. Staying in the light-to-medium band for both nicotine and flavor, it's a suitable option for those new to Latakia blends or who don't want a heavy smoke during the day. Discontinued when McClelland closed.
mcclelland-a-m-pipe.o: Leaves a fine aroma mixing light soot and dry hay.

tinder-box-black-cordial.z: Black Cordial is noted as one of the Burley-based house blends sold at Tinder Box stores; no verifiable source on its composition and character has been found.
tinder-box-black-cordial.o: No reliable record of the room note has been found.

imp-meerschaum-magic.z: Meerschaum Magic is one of the four blends IMP USA Inc. introduced in 2013, and the line's highest-Latakia record. Following the company's sale in 2015, tobacco production did not continue. The blend contains a high proportion of Latakia alongside Turkish and Oriental leaf and Virginia; despite this, harshness or tongue bite doesn't come forward in the smoke, and the flavors stay balanced. Latakia's smoky, woody, leather-evoking taste governs the blend, Virginia adds a light sweetness, and the Orientals bring a spicy edge. It suits experienced smokers looking for full-bodied English blends and an intense smoky taste.
imp-meerschaum-magic.o: Leaves a heavy aroma of smoke, tar, and wood reminiscent of a campfire.

d-r-tobacco-cockstrong-premium-pipe-toba.z: A pipe tobacco recorded under the D & R Tobacco brand as Cockstrong Premium Pipe Tobacco; since neither the maker's own marketing nor independent reliable sources could be reached, the blend's composition, cut, and character could not be confirmed for this entry.

cornell-diehl-strathspey.z: Strathspey is a Scottish-style mixture named after the Strathspey region in the Scottish Highlands. Smoky Latakia and peppery Oriental leaf are set over a Virginia-and-Burley base, black Cavendish rounds out the sweetness, and a whisky top note is applied. The smoke moves between peaty smoke and sweet leaf. Its Latakia proportion is measured compared to heavy English mixtures, so body stays medium. The maker considers the blend well suited to pairing with Islay or Speyside single malt whiskies. Suited to those looking for a smoky but sweetened character.
cornell-diehl-strathspey.o: A sweet vapor reminiscent of whisky sits over a smoky scent recalling peat smoke.

smokers-pride-whiskey.z: Sufficient independent sources to fill out the record for the Smoker's Pride blend Whiskey could not be found.

bamboo-soppeng-tobacco-cgw.z: Soppeng tobacco is a finely cut product prepared using a traditional method in Indonesia. Leaves soaked in a type of palm-derived sugar are hung on strings in a manner resembling Latakia production, and smoked from below by burning coconut husks; the flavor passes to the tobacco through this smoke rather than directly. After smoking, the leaves are wrapped in banana leaf, packed into thick bamboo tubes, and rested for at least six months before sale. The product arrives as a jet-black, dried block and needs moistening before lighting. It burns fast and steadily, without gurgling. Despite being fully toasted, the burnt taste stays low; a woody flavor from the bamboo lingers on the palate after smoking. Its satiety and nicotine load are very low, so it can be smoked any time of day; it's aimed at those looking for an experience outside the usual blend categories and light tobacco users.
bamboo-soppeng-tobacco-cgw.o: Leaves a room note of soot, burnt coconut husk, and wood.

kramers-pipe-and-tobacco-shop-father-dem.z: Father Dempsey is a ribbon-cut blend classed in the English family, named after the founding of Kramer's Pipe and Tobacco Shop; not enough sources could be found to detail its contents.

ken-byron-ventures-prince-of-wales.z: A blend Ken Byron Ventures released as part of its small-batch production; no independent and verifiable source could be found about it.

mcclelland-yenidje-supreme-grand-orienta.z: Yenidje Supreme is the blend in which McClelland's Grand Orientals series centers Oriental leaf grown in the Yenice district of Western Thrace (formerly İskeçe, today's Xanthi). Per the maker, Oriental tobacco cultivation in the region began in the 1600s, and the classic Basma seed stock arrived roughly three hundred years ago; the fine-leaved, fine-veined, supple Yenice variety comprises the xanthi-yaka-basma and xanthi-cebel-basma types. The cut is ribbon. Moisture in the tin is low, and the tobacco can be smoked straight from the tin; the brand's characteristic ketchup-like tangy aroma is pronounced and lends the smoke a tart edge. It lights very easily and produces plenty of smoke. The Oriental leaf's spicy-sweet character holds steady without tipping toward heat or bitterness, and the moisture doesn't disturb comfort through the smoke. A light-to-medium-strength, unflavored blend aimed at Oriental-tobacco enthusiasts. Production ended when the company closed in 2018.
mcclelland-yenidje-supreme-grand-orienta.o: Leaves a spicy, sweet, faintly tangy tobacco aroma.

planta-empire-virginia.z: This member of the Empire line was previously sold under the name Aromatic Flake before taking the name Virginia. Sun-ripened Virginia leaf and black Cavendish are pressed to form a soft, sweet body, with a measured fruit casing applied on top. It falls into the Danish-style aromatic flake class; casing intensity, strength, and room note all stay at a medium level. It suits smokers looking to get to know flake cuts who haven't yet moved to heavy Latakia-based mixtures. It was sold in a 50-gram tin.
planta-empire-virginia.o: Leaves a sweetish fruit and baked-tobacco aroma.

peterson-special-reserve-2020.z: This is the 2020 edition of Peterson's annual limited Special Reserve series; the profile is left incomplete, as no sufficient sources giving that year's composition and topping information could be found.
peterson-special-reserve-2020.o: Leaves the sweet aroma typical of aromatic blends.

torben-dansk-no-11-mellow-mixture.z: Torben Dansk No.11 Mellow Mixture is noted as a mellow English mixture in the brand's numbered series; no sufficient independent source describing its composition has been found.
torben-dansk-no-11-mellow-mixture.o: Records describe it as leaving a lightly smoky, dry English-blend aroma.

mcgahey-the-tobacconist-kendals-bright.z: Kendal's Bright is the light-colored Virginia blend McGahey The Tobacconist lists in its Kendal series; sufficient sources regarding its detailed composition and cut could not be found.
mcgahey-the-tobacconist-kendals-bright.o: No detailed record regarding its room note could be found.

kohlhase-kopp-und-co-kg-tt-91.z: TT 91 is one of Kohlhase & Kopp's coarse-cut English-style mixtures. It contains Virginia, burley, latakia and oriental tobaccos; a measured honey-character casing is applied on top. It was distributed in 50-gram pouches and was long available at German retailers. Latakia and oriental define the blend's smoky, dry-spicy side; burley gives an earthy, nutty body, and Virginia a bready sweetness. The honey casing sets it apart from a pure English mixture, moving it into a semi-aromatic space. The coarse cut ensures a slow, cool burn. Since it doesn't appear in the manufacturer's current catalog and shows as sold out in retailer records, it's considered discontinued.
kohlhase-kopp-und-co-kg-tt-91.o: A fine honey sweetness rides atop a woody smoke scent.

milan-tobacconists-virginia-pride.z: Virginia Pride, despite its name, is a Milan Tobacconists blend that contains no Virginia leaf; the maker notes the name instead points to the brand's roots in the state of Virginia. According to its profile, the blend is built from black cavendish and lightly pressed burley leaves, carrying a sweet, nutty character in the direction of vanilla. Its light-to-medium body gives a soft smoke. Suitable for those looking not for the Virginia character the name suggests, but for a soft cavendish-burley-based aromatic. The pressed burley share leaves a dry, filling base beneath the sugared casing.
milan-tobacconists-virginia-pride.o: Leaves a sweet vanilla and nutty aroma.

mac-baren-hh-latakia-flake.z: HH Latakia Flake is Mac Baren's HH-line blend that presents latakia in flake form. It contains light Virginias, Cyprus latakia, spicy oriental leaves and a small amount of burley. The leaves are pressed into a block using a hot-pressing method; using steam in the pressing allows the leaf to mature further. The blocks are cut into thin, short slices, each reportedly weighing about three grams — enough for a single flake to fill one bowl. In the smoke, latakia's smoky note leads, followed by the Virginias' measured sweetness, with the orientals' spice appearing intermittently. In keeping with the series' overall approach, casing is minimized and no top flavor is used. Suited to pipe smokers who enjoy unflavored English-type blends and prefer the slow smoke of a pressed leaf.
mac-baren-hh-latakia-flake.o: Burnt pine wood and smoke are accompanied by a spicy dryness.

buzas-victoria.z: No independent, reliable source could be found for the blend named Victoria under the Buza's brand, so the entry details could not be verified.

friedman-pease-aleister.z: This is one of the short-lived blends of the Friedman & Pease brand, founded in 1998 by Greg Pease and Irwin Friedman and closed about eighteen months later; no reliable source describing its composition could be found.

crofts-5.z: Recorded as one of the numbered Crofts blends, classed as an English mixture; no source confirming its composition was found.

wilke-pipe-tobacco-continental.z: Continental is among Wilke Pipe Tobacco's records notable for its Latakia weight. Cyprian Latakia builds the blend's backbone; it's joined by a significant Turkish-Oriental share, with a thin Virginia layer underneath. This construction, where Latakia and Oriental override the Virginia, brings the blend closer to the Balkan style than a classic English mixture. In the flavor, burnt wood, tar, and soot lead; the Oriental leaf adds spice, dry grass, and a tart floral edge. Virginia only provides a balancing sweetness. Body and flavor intensity are high, and the room note is strong. It suits people accustomed to high-Latakia mixtures who want an intense smoke demanding focus; it's not for those seeking a light everyday tobacco.
wilke-pipe-tobacco-continental.o: Leaves a dense scent of wood fire, tar, and spicy grass.

ken-byron-ventures-b-frogs-voodoo-tour.z: No independent source could be found to document the contents and character of Ken Byron Ventures' B. Frog's Voodoo Tour blend.

cornell-diehl-dark-caramel.z: As its name suggests, this is a caramel-flavored aromatic blend from Cornell & Diehl; it does not appear in the manufacturer's current catalog, and not enough sourcing could be found to document its composition.

robert-mcconnell-pure-havana.z: There is not enough independent source material on Pure Havana, cited among Robert McConnell's cigar-leaf-based products.

l-t-c-forester-blend.z: The L.T.C brand's Forester Blend is recorded as English-type; since no independent source could be found to confirm its content and character, the record is left incomplete.

brigham-enterprises-inc-golden-virginia-.z: A pressed light Virginia flake in Brigham's Mr. B's series, per records manufactured in Germany; no sufficient first-hand source could be found regarding the blend's composition.

lane-limited-cafe-supreme.z: Not enough independent sources could be found documenting the contents and character of American blender Lane Limited's blend called Cafe Supreme.

mcclelland-st-james-woods-personal-reser.z: St. James Woods is a Virginia-Perique blend in McClelland's Personal Reserve series. It's presented as broken flake; the red and stoved Virginias are mature and full in flavor. The Perique share is considerable, and the blend's name itself nods to the St. James parish in Louisiana, the region where Perique is grown. Despite the high Perique share, the plum-and-spice side sits in harmony with the Virginia sweetness; on the other hand, its intensity can feel overwhelming if smoked day after day. Letting the tin rest a few days after opening settles both moisture and flavor. Suited to those wanting a medium-strength, unflavored, intensely sweet-spicy Virginia-Perique. Production ended in 2018.
mcclelland-st-james-woods-personal-reser.o: Leaves a sharp, lingering aroma reminiscent of tart plum and spice.

cornell-diehl-dreams-of-kadath.z: Dreams of Kadath is a multi-component blend in Cornell & Diehl's H. P. Lovecraft-inspired series. Fire-cured Kentucky and burley build an earthy body; Katerini Oriental adds spice, perique adds dark fruit, Virginia adds natural sweetness, and black cavendish adds softness. The leaves are pressed into a dense cake. It offers a flavor slightly above medium body, layered and evolving over time; the spice level is measured. It suits smokers curious about blended structures that don't settle into a single mold, combining Oriental and perique together.
cornell-diehl-dreams-of-kadath.o: Leaves a spicy room aroma combining wood smoke with dark fruit.

consolidated-504-z-b-c.z: No independent, reliable sourcing could be found regarding the Consolidated blend 504: Z.B.C.

affordable-pipes-fog-cutter.z: One of the house blends from the American seller Affordable Pipes; no accessible source describing its content could be found.

mcclelland-mctruffle.z: One of McClelland's aromatic blends sold in bulk; no sufficient source describing its contents and character in detail could be found.
mcclelland-mctruffle.o: Records indicate it leaves a sweet, chocolate-like aroma.

pipesandcigars-com-dr-browns-burley-blen.z: No sufficient sources were found documenting the content and character of pipesandcigars.com's blend Dr Brown's Burley Blend.

gawith-hoggarth-co-kentucky-nougat.z: Kentucky Nougat is an aromatic where African-origin golden Virginias, Burley, and black Cavendish leaf are rounded out with a top essence on the cocoa-and-toffee line. It has also been offered in some markets under the name American Kentucky. The smoke is cool and mild; though the cocoa-caramel tones are pronounced, they don't fully mask the leaf's nutty Burley character. Nicotine is low. Suited to those wanting a sweet but not heavy aromatic, and to anyone looking for a light morning or after-meal smoke.
gawith-hoggarth-co-kentucky-nougat.o: Leaves a sweet, creamy room aroma reminiscent of cocoa and caramel candy.

brigham-enterprises-inc-afternoon-deligh.z: Afternoon Delight is a light aromatic blend in Brigham's Mr. B's line. A small amount of Oriental leaf is added to rested burley and Virginia leaf; the mixture is flavored with a light casing. Burley forms the blend's dry, nutty base, Virginia's sugar adds brightness, and the Oriental leaf adds a fine spicy edge. Since the casing is kept measured, the tobacco's own taste is preserved; nicotine and flavor are light. Suitable for those seeking a soft aromatic to smoke all day and for those avoiding heavily cased blends.
brigham-enterprises-inc-afternoon-deligh.o: Leaves a trace where a light caramel sweetness is accompanied by a dry nut aroma.

davids-blend-black-cavendish-aromatic.z: Black Cavendish Aromatic is among the shop blends sold under its own name by the American tobacconist David's Fine Tobaccos. The firm offers its blends in bulk along with a custom-mix service; as the name suggests, this blend is built entirely on black cavendish. Black cavendish is a dark, moist, sweet tobacco obtained by steaming and sugaring virginia leaf; used alone it gives a low-nicotine, cool smoke. The blend is flavored with a vanilla-forward topping. It's a structure suited to a beginning smoker seeking a sweet, richly scented aromatic that doesn't harshen the tongue.
davids-blend-black-cavendish-aromatic.o: Leaves a sweet vanilla and caramelized sugar scent.

lane-limited-bca.z: BCA is Lane Limited's ribbon-cut blend built from fire-cured cavendish leaves. The leaf is nearly jet black; having gone through the roasting process, its natural sweetness is high. Due to restrictions on flavored tobacco sales in Massachusetts, it's also sold as Boston Blackie at some retailers. Casing is measured: cocoa with soft vanilla build a dark sweetness that doesn't lean toward fruit. It gives a slow-burning, cool smoke that's very light in nicotine. Suited to those wanting an aromatic while avoiding fruity presentations, and seeking a soft blend to smoke all day.
lane-limited-bca.o: Leaves a sweet, dark trace with cocoa and soft vanilla scent.

g-l-pease-stratford.z: Stratford is a Virginia-Perique blend in G. L. Pease's Classic Collection line. Fine, sweet bright Virginias are brought together with ripe red Virginias, and a measured amount of Louisiana perique is added. Built on this untopped interplay of sugar and spice, it is a record aimed at smokers seeking classic examples of the Virginia-Perique family.
g-l-pease-stratford.o: Leaves a sweet, dry-grass aroma with a light spiced-plum note.

sutliff-tobacco-company-wild-honeysuckle.z: Wild Honeysuckle is among Sutliff's floral-themed aromatics. Its base is made of Burley, Virginia, and black Cavendish; a honey and vanilla top note is applied over it. The aim is to carry the scent of the honeysuckle flower it's named for into the tobacco; the black Cavendish rounds out the sweetness while the Burley holds the casing and balances the burn. The cut is ribbon. On the smoke, the taste stays measured relative to the aroma's intensity; honeyed sweetness leads while the tobacco itself stays in the background. Nicotine is light, and thanks to its cool burn it suits long sessions. It is a meaningful option for smokers who like floral, honeyed aromas and are looking for a profile close to discontinued honey-themed blends.
sutliff-tobacco-company-wild-honeysuckle.o: Leaves a sweet, honeyed floral scent reminiscent of honeysuckle.

rattray-sweet-fragrant.z: This is a flavored blend sold under the Rattray name; it is not part of the brand's current product list, and no verifiable source could be found on its content and character.
rattray-sweet-fragrant.o: There is not enough source material to describe its aroma.

boswell-pipes-tobacco-spice-and-nice.z: Spice and Nice is a mixture built by combining generous black cavendish with a small amount of sweet Virginia leaf. Per the manufacturer's description the result is a sweet, soft smoke that is nonetheless not lacking in body. Since its aromatic character is pronounced, its aroma is noticeable when smoked indoors. Nicotine load is low and it burns cool; suits smokers seeking a soft starting point before moving to heavier blends.
boswell-pipes-tobacco-spice-and-nice.o: Leaves a sweet, lightly spiced cavendish aroma.

bjarne-viking-odins-wind.z: A light aromatic blend in Bjarne's Viking line; according to records it carries honey and caramel tones and is discontinued, with no other reliable source on its composition available.

gawith-hoggarth-co-kendal-gold-strawberr.z: Kendal Gold is one of the shag-cut main bodies produced at Gawith, Hoggarth & Co.'s Kendal workshop in Cumbria. Its base is a fine golden-hued cut of flame-cured bright Virginia leaf; the producer states it uses no other tobacco type in this series, only cleanly cut Virginia. The Kendal Gold body is offered with numerous different flavorings, and Kendal Gold Strawberry is this family's strawberry-flavored member. The strawberry flavoring is pronounced in the jar, more measured on the smoke; the Virginia body's citrusy sweetness stays in the background. The fine cut lights easily and needs frequent tamping. Suited to those seeking a light-nicotine fruity aromatic.
gawith-hoggarth-co-kendal-gold-strawberr.o: Leaves a sweet strawberry and candy aroma.

jacks-tobacco-park-avenue.z: No independent source documenting the composition and character of Park Avenue, under the Jack's Tobacco name, could be found.
jacks-tobacco-park-avenue.o: No reliable record of the room note could be found.

planta-bellini-torino.z: The Torino mixture in the Bellini line is built by adding sun-cured spice tobaccos to a triple body of Virginia, Burley, and black Cavendish. Its casing carries peach flavoring along with some grappa; the flavor line is defined by a note recalling Mediterranean fruit and Barolo wine. It has a spicier profile than the rest of the line. It suits smokers looking for fruity but not sugary aromatics carrying a lightly alcoholic casing. It is sold in 50-gram tins.
planta-bellini-torino.o: An alcoholic, grape-like sharpness accompanies the peach sweetness.

h-simmons-mild-mixture.z: H. Simmons's lightly structured English-style house mixture; there is not enough sourcing on its composition and cut.
h-simmons-mild-mixture.o: No reliable record of its aroma could be found.

samuel-gawith-rb-plug.z: A plug in Samuel Gawith's plug-tobacco line, referred to in records as heavily cased; no sufficient source confirming its leaf composition and flavor line could be found.

holts-cigar-company-holts-101.z: This is one of the numbered house blends of Holt's Cigar Company, which has operated in Philadelphia since 1898; no independent source describing its composition could be found.
holts-cigar-company-holts-101.o: No reliable record of its aroma could be found.

cornell-diehl-cube-cut-burley.z: Cube Cut Burley is a single-varietal tobacco for which Cornell & Diehl cuts white and dark burley leaf, sourced from Kentucky, into small cubes at its own facility. The cube cut lends itself to gravity-packing a pipe and yields a slow burn. The flavor profile is dry, nutty, and lightly sweet; tones reminiscent of rye bread and bittersweet chocolate are described, along with a light spice from the dark burley. It can be smoked on its own, as well as used as a base leaf in home blending; it suits smokers wanting to get to know unflavored burley character in its plain form.
cornell-diehl-cube-cut-burley.o: Leaves a plain, earthy room aroma reminiscent of dry grass and rye bread.

wesleys-no-50-oriental-mixture.z: Oriental Mixture belongs to the English-style blend group from Wesley's tobacconist. According to the maker's recipe, it's based on broadly cut, fire-cured light Virginia leaf; dark leaves are added for body, with Latakia and a small amount of Oriental leaf for flavor balance.
wesleys-no-50-oriental-mixture.o: Leaves a scent of wood smoke and smoked leaf.

samuel-gawith-pure-black-cavendish.z: Pure Black Cavendish is the Kendal-based Samuel Gawith house's unflavored cavendish product. The leaf is pressed into a thick cake, heated with steam, and left to ferment; this process caramelizes the sugars, darkening the leaf and giving a natural sweetness. While most cavendishes on the market are flavored afterward, this product contains no casing, so the sweetness comes from the tobacco itself. Its nicotine is low, the smoke cool; smoked alone it offers a plain, straightforward profile. Its main use is as a blending component: it is added in measured proportions to reduce the fullness of an overly harsh mixture and add mildness and volume to the body. Suited to smokers building their own blends and to those seeking a mild starter tobacco.
samuel-gawith-pure-black-cavendish.o: Leaves a light, sweet, mild scent evoking baked bread and molasses.

theodorus-niemeyer-flying-dutchman.z: No reliable source has been found for the Theodorus Niemeyer pipe blend called Flying Dutchman.

peterson-3-years-cask-aged-english-mixtu.z: No sufficient sources documenting the composition and production details of Peterson's 3 Years Cask Aged English Mixture could be found.

boswell-pipes-tobacco-vanilla-cream.z: Vanilla Cream is an aromatic prepared by flavoring American burley, golden cavendish and Virginia leaf with vanilla extract. It is one of the mixtures that has been in the Boswell catalog for more than thirty years. The vanilla casing is perceptible but kept at a level that does not entirely cover the leaf's taste; the burley base gives the blend a nutty body. Nicotine load is low and it burns cool. A direct answer for smokers seeking a classic vanilla aromatic.
boswell-pipes-tobacco-vanilla-cream.o: Leaves a sweet vanilla and lightly creamy aroma.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-park-lane.z: No sufficient primary source describing Park Lane No.7's composition and character could be found.

ohm-turkish-yellow.z: OHM Turkish Yellow is the second of two blends containing oriental leaf within the American-made OHM line. Turkish-sourced oriental leaf is added to an American-origin Virginia and Burley body; the blend is prepared as a ribbon cut and offered in large-gram packaging. It's built from the same leaf family as Turkish Red but positioned a step below it in taste and fullness. On the smoke, the oriental's herbal, dry spice note stays more measured. It suits those seeking the oriental leaf's character at a gentler setting.
ohm-turkish-yellow.o: Leaves a lightly herbal, dry-spiced tobacco scent.

paul-olsen-mr-nielsen.z: Mr. Nielsen is among the My Own Blend special editions, put together by blender Lasse Berg in memory of Steffen Nielsen, founder of The Danish Pipe Shop in Copenhagen. Its base holds mild Virginia and cavendish leaves, joined by oriental leaf and a small amount of latakia. It is topped with red wine, vanilla, chocolate, and almond essences. The blend is a hybrid sitting between modern aromatics and old-style English mixtures: the topping aroma is pronounced, but the latakia and oriental leave a thin smoky-spicy line. Its measured nicotine load makes it suitable for all-day smoking; it can be counted as a stepping stone for smokers moving from aromatics toward English mixtures.
paul-olsen-mr-nielsen.o: Leaves a dark, wine-like scent with a thin trace of wood smoke sensed beneath sweet chocolate and vanilla.

leavitt-peirce-twainberry.z: Twainberry is one of the pronounced aromatics among Leavitt & Peirce's house blends. Per the shop's description, the blend's base is black Cavendish; this processed leaf gives the smoke a soft, vanilla-toned foundation. A measured mixed-berry flavoring is added on top. Body is light, nicotine load is low; the smoke runs cool and soft. Of interest to those seeking a fruity aromatic profile and to newcomers to pipes avoiding sharpness. The blend is sold in bulk over the counter of the Harvard Square shop.
leavitt-peirce-twainberry.o: Leaves a light red-berry note over a sweet vanilla base.

per-g-jensen-harbour-dreams.z: For Per G. Jensen's blend called Harbour Dreams, no independent sources such as the maker's own materials or a reliable product record could be found, so no definitive information can be given about the blend's composition and character.

h-simmons-navy-mixture.z: One of H. Simmons's house mixtures referencing naval tradition; there is not enough sourcing on its composition and character.
h-simmons-navy-mixture.o: No reliable record of its aroma could be found.

ken-byron-ventures-mr-christians-acadian.z: Mr. Christian's Acadian Flek is a blend Ken Byron Ventures releases in small batches; without access to the maker's own description or two independent sources, its contents and character details aren't specified here.

j-f-germain-son-uncle-toms-mixture.z: Uncle Tom's Mixture is one of the ribbon-cut blends in J. F. Germain & Son's lightly aromatic line. Selected Virginia leaves are combined with black Cavendish; per the maker's description, it's a mild, subtly flavored mixture, with the flavoring kept light. The black Cavendish establishes a sweet, full base, while the Virginia adds a light acidity and freshness; nicotine is on the light side. It's aimed at smokers new to aromatic blends, or those avoiding heavily syrupy products and looking for a sweet mixture that preserves tobacco character.
j-f-germain-son-uncle-toms-mixture.o: Leaves a sweet, lightly caramel, woody aroma.

gq-tobaccos-nottingham-lace-rouge.z: Rouge, the red member of the Nottingham Lace series, is prepared with a spirit-based top note over a red Virginia and Cavendish base. Kentucky and Perique take on the role of depth in the blend; records indicate the Perique ratio runs above fifteen percent, making the dark-fruit-and-pepper side pronounced. The top note is a traditional-style topping — not dominant enough to place the blend in the classic aromatic category, and far from Lakeland-style floral toppings. It is an easy-smoking blend with an even burn. The balance struck between the Virginia's bready sweetness and the Perique's dark, fruity spice suits smokers wanting a topped but leaf-focused blend. Despite the high Perique ratio, its strength doesn't run to excess; a measured entry point for smokers familiar with the VaPer line.
gq-tobaccos-nottingham-lace-rouge.o: Leaves a bready warmth alongside a dark-fruit, lightly spirit-touched sweetness.

peter-stokkebye-heather-honey.z: This is one of Peter Stokkebye's blends reported to be Cavendish-based; no sufficient first-hand sources documenting its content and character could be found.
peter-stokkebye-heather-honey.o: No sufficient information for a room note could be found in the records.

sutliff-tobacco-company-eccentric.z: Eccentric is an unflavored English mixture that puts latakia at the forefront of the blend. Its base is red Virginia; oriental leaf from Greece's Katerini region adds a thin spice layer, while a Virginia blended with light burley rounds out the texture. The ribbon cut is offered in 50-gram tins and in bulk. Along the flavor line, smoky wood, spiced bread, musty earth, and herbal incense notes stand out; a citrusy tartness and a light peppery finish sit in the background. Nicotine is light-to-medium, the burn is slow, and it may require several relights. A record for those wanting to smoke latakia blends at medium strength without added flavoring.
sutliff-tobacco-company-eccentric.o: Leaves a scent of campfire smoke, incense, and dry wood.

wessex-denicotea-no-100.z: No sufficient independent source could be found documenting the composition and character of the Wessex blend called Denicotea No. 100.
wessex-denicotea-no-100.o: According to the records, no scent description has been documented.

king-smoking-pipes-and-cigars-king-of-cl.z: A blend offered under its own label by American retailer King Smoking Pipes and Cigars, listed as Virginia-based; detailed content information could not be confirmed.
king-smoking-pipes-and-cigars-king-of-cl.o: Reportedly close to the dry hay and bread scent left by Virginia-forward blends.

ken-byron-ventures-anne-cap-2022.z: No independent source could be found to document the contents and character of Ken Byron Ventures' Anne Cap 2022 blend.

ken-byron-ventures-kings-ransom-rich-dar.z: Not enough independent sources could be found to fill in the profile of Ken Byron Ventures' King's Ransom: Rich Dark English.

elephant-castle-new-world.z: No sufficient independent sourcing could be reached to document the composition and character of New World, a pipe tobacco from Elephant & Castle.

synjeco-flowers-of-ireland.z: Flowers of Ireland is listed among the blends the Swiss shop Synjeco released under its own brand; no sufficient independent source on its content and character could be found.
synjeco-flowers-of-ireland.o: No reliable record of a room note could be found.

old-virginia-tobacco-co-gettysburg.z: Gettysburg is one of the house blends from Old Virginia Tobacco Company, a retailer with stores in Virginia for many years. Virginia leaves and mild black cavendish are given a Colombian-coffee-and-dark-chocolate-direction topping; the cut is loose ribbon and packs easily. The blend sits at the medium-intensity end of the aromatic wing: cavendish sweetness carries the topping while Virginia provides a light tart balance behind it. Nicotine is low and the smoke cool, sketching the profile of an all-day tobacco enjoyed alongside coffee. It suits those seeking coffee-chocolate-direction aromatics and those wanting a stepping stone before moving from aromatics to English blends.
old-virginia-tobacco-co-gettysburg.o: Leaves a scent of freshly ground coffee and cocoa alongside a sweet tobacco base.

hearth-home-ajs-vaper.z: AJ's VaPer is a Virginia-Perique mixture prepared by Hearth & Home blender Russ Ouellette together with Andrew "AJ" Smith. Different red Virginia leaves form the body; a generously proportioned amount of Perique is added on top. The blend's third component is unflavored black Cavendish sourced from Green River, used to soften the bite and increase sweetness. Since no top note is applied, the sweetness in the blend comes from the leaf itself. Perique's contribution of dried plum and black pepper is pronounced, while Virginia carries the bready, sugary side. Suited to smokers wanting to get to know the unflavored VaPer character at a high Perique dose — those looking for a non-aromatic blend with high flavor intensity that doesn't go to a nicotine extreme.
hearth-home-ajs-vaper.o: Leaves a tart dried-fruit and peppery tobacco aroma.

d-r-tobacco-blenders-bench-yenidje.z: Yenidje is an Oriental tobacco named after the Yenice region in Western Thrace; Daughters & Ryan offers this leaf as a single variety in the Blenders Bench line. The leaf comes in compressed clumps and needs to be teased apart into strands before use. Despite being light in nicotine, flavor intensity is high; it carries dry hay, spice, and a subtle incense-like line. Its main use is in blending: added in small amounts to English and Balkan-style mixtures, it brings the Oriental character forward noticeably.
d-r-tobacco-blenders-bench-yenidje.o: Leaves a scent of dry hay, spice, and light incense.

orlik-erinmore-mixture.z: Erinmore is a brand tracing its origin to Murray & Sons in Northern Ireland; production of the blend later passed to Danish Orlik. The Mixture version is ribbon cut and built on black cavendish and Virginia. Its topping runs pineapple-and-citrus-direction, staying light in the tobacco itself while becoming pronounced in the room note. It's described as a blend effortless to pack, burn, and smoke, with a long session. Its taste is distinctive; it's noted as carrying a rarely matched profile that sharply divides opinion among smokers. Nicotine is light, taste light to medium. It's a go-to example for smokers wanting to get to know the aromatic wing and try classic blends. A flake version under the same name also exists.
orlik-erinmore-mixture.o: Spreads a pronounced scent of sweet tropical fruit and citrus through the room.

dunhill-london-mixture.z: London Mixture is Dunhill's medium-bodied latakia blend. Per the tin description, it consists of a combination of latakia, Virginia and Turkish tobaccos; because the oriental share is kept high, the mixture leans toward Balkan style. It's ribbon cut, ready to be packed straight from the tin. On the smoke, latakia's sooty, woody core moves together with the Turkish tobaccos' spicy sharpness, while Virginia builds a sweet base underneath. Though rich in structure, it is soft and finishes without harshening the tongue; it makes a good starting point for those wanting to get to know classic English mixtures. Production under the Dunhill name has ended.
dunhill-london-mixture.o: Leaves a smoky scent combining wood smoke and spicy Eastern tobacco.

mcclelland-legends.z: Legends, released within the Collector series, is a ribbon-cut English blend in which a high proportion of Cyprian Latakia gives backbone to dark-steamed and red Virginias, with Orientals like Mahalla and Drama placed among them. The smoke has a creamy texture; soot dominates while quiet notes reminiscent of plum and currant can be heard in the background. Nicotine is medium, and the flavor is considered full-bodied; aimed at smokers used to Latakia-forward blends. Discontinued when McClelland closed in 2018.
mcclelland-legends.o: A deep soot and smoked-wood aroma remains, with a light fruit tone beneath it.

players-blenders-highland-pipe-tobacco.z: Player's Blenders Highland Pipe Tobacco is a pipe tobacco blend for which there is not enough independent source material.
players-blenders-highland-pipe-tobacco.o: Not enough records could be found on the room note.

low-country-pipe-cigar-santee.z: One of the house blends of South Carolina-based Low Country Pipe & Cigar; described as aromatic, but not enough sources could be found to describe its character.

panama-jack-key-lime.z: Key Lime is the aromatic blend representing the citrus direction in Panama Jack's tropical pipe tobacco line. Its body carries a higher share of Virginia than black cavendish; it is ribbon cut and offered in fifty-gram tins. The flavoring, referencing the Florida key lime it's named for, is built between tart citrus and sweet cream; the tobacco is at a smoking-ready moisture straight from the tin. The smoke is light and cool, with nicotine load low. The leaf taste doesn't come forward; the main trace left in the mouth is lemony sweetness. It's aimed at pipe smokers who love aromatics and want a light-bodied blend smokable all day.
panama-jack-key-lime.o: Leaves a scent of citrus peel and sweet cream.

park-lane-tobacconist-park-lane-no-3.z: No reliable source describing the composition and character of Park-Lane No. 3, one of the counter blends from Park-Lane Tobacconist in Clifton Park, New York, could be found.

lane-limited-tk-6.z: TK-6 is a Lane aromatic where black cavendish forms the weight, supported by burley. It's ribbon-cut, with a cherry sauce added that keeps sweetness measured. The cherry note stays not sharp or acidic but in a soft, cream-like line; behind it is a fine vanilla sweetness and a nutty base from the burley. Nicotine level is low and the body is light; it's a blend that produces plenty of smoke and doesn't burn the tongue when smoked slowly. Suited to smokers who avoid the harshness of cherry-flavored tobaccos and want a soft everyday smoke on the aromatic side. Records indicate it's also sold in bulk under different names at some retailers.
lane-limited-tk-6.o: Leaves a creamy cherry and light vanilla room note.

orlik-tobacco-company-a-s-club-mixture.z: Club Mixture is one of Orlik's classic Danish-style mixtures. Virginia leaves, mild burley, and black cavendish are brought together; it is ribbon cut and packs easily. It's given a caramel-confectionery-direction topping. It burns slowly and smokes cool. Cavendish carries a natural sweetness while burley builds a mellow body behind it; nicotine level is low. It suits smokers seeking a pronouncedly flavored but not overwhelming aromatic, and those wanting a mild blend smokable all day.
orlik-tobacco-company-a-s-club-mixture.o: Leaves a scent of caramel and buttery confectionery on a warm tobacco base.

dan-tobacco-skippers-flake.z: This is a pipe tobacco under the German maker Dan Tobacco Manufaktur; no reliable source about the blend's composition and character could be found, so no detail is given.

sterling-tobacco-co-tom-and-jerry.z: Tom and Jerry is Sterling Tobacco Company's blend in the aromatic category, taking its name from the hot spiced drink of the same name. Per the maker's description, the blend consists of Virginia leaves combined with cool-burning burley. The burley portion keeps the burn cool and lowers the tendency to bite the tongue; the Virginia side carries the sweetness. Flavoring stays full but not heavy, while nicotine is light-to-medium. Suited to smokers who don't want sweetness to completely mask the body in aromatic blends and who seek a soft, everyday mixture.
sterling-tobacco-co-tom-and-jerry.o: Leaves a sweet, lightly spiced scent evoking a warm drink.

smokers-corner-no-15.z: One of the numbered shop blends from the tobacconist Smokers Corner; while records indicate it contains Virginia and perique, no independent source confirming this could be found.

wolfway-myth.z: Myth is Wolfway's Burley-forward American-type blend, composed of Samsun Oriental, Virginia, and a small amount of Latakia. Its unflavored construction lets the natural tobacco taste come forward, with a woody smoky trace in the smoke and a smooth draw that leaves no harshness on the tongue. It suits those looking for an unflavored yet not monotonous everyday blend.
wolfway-myth.o: Leaves a woody, lightly smoky scent reminiscent of a campfire.

sutliff-tobacco-company-maple-street.z: Maple Street is one of the bulk blends from the Richmond-based Sutliff Tobacco Company; sufficient independent sources documenting its composition and character could not be found.

hearth-home-berry-nice.z: Berry Nice is one of the fruity aromatic blends in Russ Ouellette's Hearth & Home series. A blackberry-forward top note is applied over black Cavendish and Virginia leaf. The topping is pronounced — prominent in both the pouch aroma and the smoke — and the blend's sweetness level is high.
