Suited to smokers who want an all-day smoke without sharp spice or latakia smoke. Since Sutliff Tobacco Company ceased production in 2025, the blend is now only available through remaining stock.
sutliff-tobacco-company-highlander-2012.o: Leaves a mild, lightly sweet scent reminiscent of toasted bread and dried fruit.

paul-olsen-dark-pearl.z: A blend from the My Own Blend line that originated at the Paul Olsen shop in Copenhagen; not enough source material describing its composition and character could be found.

hearth-home-derby-club-aromatic.z: Derby Club Aromatic is the blend Hearth & Home prepared as a counterpart to the discontinued American classic Kentucky Club Aromatic. Its composition includes mild Burley, earthy Oriental, sweet Virginia, and a touch of sharp Perique, topped with an old-style top note. The topping is noticeable in the tin and room aroma, while the smoke itself carries Burley's nutty base and Perique's spice. Body stays light to medium and the burn runs cool. Well suited to smokers looking for the style of twentieth-century American drugstore tobaccos — a lightly aromatic everyday blend that hasn't lost its tobacco character.
hearth-home-derby-club-aromatic.o: Leaves a sweetish, lightly spiced aroma reminiscent of old-style pipe tobaccos.

milan-tobacconists-401-burley-mixture.z: One of Milan Tobacconists' burley-centered mixtures. Crosscut light-colored burley leaves are joined by bright Virginia, a small amount of perique, and toasted cavendish; sweetness comes from the leaf composition rather than a sugar sauce. It has a soft, balanced body and a nicotine level kept low. The light plum and spice brought by perique add measured depth to burley's nutty base. Suitable for those looking for a mixture smokable throughout the day that isn't aromatic but also isn't harsh.
milan-tobacconists-401-burley-mixture.o: Leaves a soft tobacco aroma carrying a nutty base with light plum sweetness.

wilke-pipe-tobacco-black-raspberry.z: Black Raspberry is a plain record among Wilke Pipe Tobacco's single-note aromatics: a raspberry-based casing applied to black cavendish leaf. The brand has kept fruity, sweet-cased bulk tobaccos in its catalog since 1872; this blend is a straightforwardly fruit-focused member of that line. Black cavendish, with its sweet, soft base, provides a neutral foundation to carry the fruit casing; nicotine is low and the burn is cool. The raspberry note is clearly felt both in the tin and in the smoke, and it largely defines the blend's character. It suits smokers seeking a fruity aromatic who don't expect the tobacco leaf's own character to come forward, and newcomers to the pipe.
wilke-pipe-tobacco-black-raspberry.o: Leaves a sweet scent reminiscent of red-berry jam.

cornell-diehl-xxv-reserve-dawn.z: XXV Reserve: Dawn is one of two entries in the limited series prepared for retailer Smokingpipes' twenty-fifth anniversary; the blend is a joint effort between the company's founder Sykes Wilford and Cornell & Diehl head blender Jeremy Reeves. Records indicate the project used Virginia leaf specially sourced and rested for twenty-five years. The product is pressed as an unflavored Virginia flake. Its profile is led by the bright, citrusy top notes of light-colored Virginias over a breadlike, naturally sweet base; it's described as fitting for morning hours, alongside a hot drink. Nicotine load is medium. Along with its sibling entry Dusk, it isn't in continuous production, having been released in limited quantity.
cornell-diehl-xxv-reserve-dawn.o: A light sweetness accompanies a scent of baked bread and dry hay.

planta-sunday-blend.z: Sunday Blend is a fruity aromatic mixture Planta offers as a summer edition. Double-fermented black Cavendish takes a pronounced place in the body of Virginia, Burley, and Cavendish; the casing carries mango and passionfruit notes led by orange, with cream in the background. Strength stays measured while the flavoring stays full; the smoke is mellow and even. It suits smokers looking for a light-bodied smoke with sweet, refreshing fruit notes. It is sold in 50-gram tins.
planta-sunday-blend.o: Leaves a cream and tropical fruit aroma with a light sweetness.

mac-baren-amphora-kentucky-blend.z: Amphora Kentucky Blend is a blend whose weight is formed by fire-cured Kentucky leaf, with Virginia added on top. It's presented rubbed out, ready to pack. The smoke and wood character from Kentucky's fire-curing process sits at the center of the blend; Virginia adds a measured sweetness and brightness to this dark base. Casing is not pronounced. It's among the fullest options in the series in terms of nicotine and body, so it's not suited to smoking on an empty stomach or at a fast pace. Suited to those seeking smoky, full, unflavored tobacco character.
mac-baren-amphora-kentucky-blend.o: Leaves the wood-smoke scent of fire-cured leaf.

vauen-no-06-crusted-blend.z: No. 06 Crusted Blend is a mellow mixture in Vauen's numbered aromatic series. Double-fermented black Cavendish, Virginia from various origins, and Burley are combined in a medium loose cut; the varied cut widths give a cool, even burn. It takes its name from the crème-brûlée-like crust sweetness cased on top: vanilla, hazelnut and caramelized sugar notes are pronounced. It sits creamy and round on the palate, not built for sharpness or tongue bite. Aimed at fans of sweet aromatics after a low-nicotine evening smoke.
vauen-no-06-crusted-blend.o: Leaves a scent of burnt sugar cream, vanilla and roasted hazelnut.

gawith-hoggarth-co-bright-cr-plug.z: Not enough independent sourcing was found for this study on Gawith, Hoggarth & Co.'s Bright CR Plug blend, so its content, cut, and character information have been left blank.

cornell-diehl-exclusive.z: Exclusive is one of the blends where Cornell & Diehl pushes the perique ratio to an extreme; per available sources, half the mixture is perique. The remainder is made up of red Virginia and soft cavendish, laying a natural sweetness and roundness beneath the spice. The flavor profile runs along sharp spice, pepper, and dark fruit, though it is noted to smoke cool. It suits experienced smokers looking for perique not as a side ingredient but as the blend's centerpiece; it may prove too much for those unaccustomed to spice at this intensity.
cornell-diehl-exclusive.o: Leaves a sharp, sweetish room aroma reminiscent of plum and black pepper.

meine-mischung-rot.z: Meine Mischung Rot is the cherry-flavored version in the series. A fruity cherry note is added over the natural sweetness of burley and Virginia leaves; since the flavoring level is kept measured, the tobacco's own taste isn't entirely masked. It is prepared with the loose-cut method. Produced in Denmark and distributed in bulk and packaged form in the German market. With its light strength and sweet profile, it's suited to those looking for a long, undemanding smoke.
meine-mischung-rot.o: Leaves a fruity, sweet aroma in the direction of ripe cherry.

ken-byron-ventures-the-dread-planet-2020.z: The 2020 release of Dread Planet is reported to be Oriental-forward; no independent source could be found to detail its contents.
ken-byron-ventures-the-dread-planet-2020.o: No reliable record of the room note could be found.

cup-o-joes-high-peaks-blue.z: High Peaks Blue is a member of the High Peaks line Cup O' Joes sells in bulk. The line entered the Cup O' Joes catalogue after the owners of the shop With Pipe and Book retired and its house blends were taken over. The blend is made of a combination of black Cavendish and golden Cavendish. Nicotine level is very low, texture soft; the sweetness the Cavendish gives comes forward, offering a smoke without harshness or tongue bite. A blend of the kind smokers looking for a light, cased tobacco to smoke all day, and those new to the pipe, tend to reach for.
cup-o-joes-high-peaks-blue.o: Leaves a sweet, sugary Cavendish scent.

lane-limited-sangria.z: Not enough independent sources could be found documenting the contents and character of American blender Lane Limited's blend called Sangria.

ruddells-potomac-plug.z: Recorded as one of the plug tobaccos produced by the Dublin-based Wm. Ruddell Ltd.; no sufficient source describing the blend's composition could be found.

golden-blend-tobacco-co-blue-train.z: Blue Train is an aromatic pipe tobacco sold under the Golden Blend's brand; there is not enough sourcing describing its composition, cut, and character.

panama-jack-mango.z: Mango is one of the aromatic blends in Panama Jack's tropically themed pipe tobacco line. A mango flavoring with both sweet and tart sides is applied to a base built from mild burley and bright Virginia; burley carries the blend's weight while Virginia leaves an herbal, lightly tart background. It is ribbon cut and sold in fifty-gram tins. The smoke is cool and smooth, with nicotine load staying low. The fruit flavoring stays up front while the tobacco's own taste remains a thin base behind it. It suits newcomers to aromatic blends and those wanting a light, fruity everyday smoke.
panama-jack-mango.o: Leaves a scent of ripe tropical fruit and light sugar.

ken-byron-ventures-burley-morning-pipe.z: Not enough independent sources could be found to fill in the profile of Ken Byron Ventures' Burley Morning Pipe.

my-smoking-shop-african-virginia-shag.z: African Virginia Shag is one of the unflavored Virginia blends English tobacconists sell by weight from the jar. As its name suggests, it is built from Virginia leaf grown in Africa and cut into very fine strips, i.e. shag. German maker Planta's product of the same name is found under this name in bulk at British retailers. The shag cut catches light quickly and burns fast, so it calls for slow puffing and a narrower bowl. With no casing, the taste comes directly from the leaf's own sweetness: bready, herbal, and lightly sugary. Suitable for smokers looking for unflavored Virginia who are used to the fast burn of a fine cut.
my-smoking-shop-african-virginia-shag.o: Leaves a dry-herb and sweet-hay aroma.

mcclelland-no-5110-dark-english-full.z: No. 5110 Dark English Full is the English blend McClelland's own catalog promotes as its "fullest mixture." Per the description, it's rich in Latakia, spiced with select Oriental leaf, and softened with stoved Virginia. Sold in bulk, this blend is often mentioned alongside the brand's tinned Frog Morton family. Body and flavor intensity are high; the Latakia smoke becomes the blend's main axis, completed by the Oriental spice and stoved Virginia's dark sweetness. Nicotine dose is above medium. Aimed at smokers used to heavy English mixtures seeking an evening smoke; it may run intense for those new to Latakia. Discontinued when the brand ceased operations in 2018.
mcclelland-no-5110-dark-english-full.o: Leaves a heavy wood-smoke, soot, and dry-spice aroma.

peterson-holiday-season-2015.z: Holiday Season is Peterson's limited-edition, Christmas-themed aromatic tin series released each year; the 2015 edition was presented in a 100 gram tin. A mixture of black Cavendish, Virginia, and Burley is given a blackberry and cognac flavoring. Peterson is an Irish brand, but the blending and production of these special tins is outsourced; records indicate they were made by Kohlhase, Kopp & Co. to a recipe specified by Peterson. The cut is described as ribbon. Because the recipe changes each year, every edition of the series counts as a distinct blend; the 2015 tin was likewise prepared for its release year and never reprinted. It is a notable record for smokers seeking flavored, sweet-profile tins and for those who collect the annual limited editions.
peterson-holiday-season-2015.o: Leaves a blackberry and cognac aroma.

planta-van-halteren-black-and-bright.z: Planta Van Halteren Black and Bright is a pipe tobacco blend for which there is not enough independent source material.
planta-van-halteren-black-and-bright.o: Not enough records could be found on the room note.

mcclelland-no-605-pastry.z: A blend in McClelland's numbered bulk aromatic series, reportedly mild, nutty, and lightly sweet; no sufficient source documenting its composition could be found.

wurster-zigarren-wursters-mixture-no-3.z: This is one of the house-blend line from Wilhelm Wurster Zigarren, a family business operating in Nürtingen since 1919; no independent source could be found describing its composition and character.
wurster-zigarren-wursters-mixture-no-3.o: No description of its room note could be found in the records.

pfeifendepot-vaperizer.z: Vaperizer is a Virginia-Perique blend from Gerd Jansens Pfeifendepot. The name reflects this concept: selected Virginia leaves are joined by a notable pinch of Perique. The tobacco is sold as a 100 gram pressed block, or plug, and needs to be sliced and rubbed out before smoking. The maker rates its strength as medium. Pressing melds the Virginia's sweetness with Perique's plummy, spicy edge; since no flavoring is used, the taste comes entirely from the leaf itself. It is aimed at smokers willing to spend the time preparing a plug and who are seeking an intense Virginia-Perique profile.
pfeifendepot-vaperizer.o: Leaves a tangy-sweet tobacco aroma recalling dried figs and black pepper.

cornell-diehl-red-odessa.z: Red Odessa is the red-Virginia-heavy interpretation of Cornell & Diehl's Odessa blend. Turkish-Oriental tobacco, Cyprus Latakia, and Louisiana Perique are added on top of red Virginia leaf, giving a ribbon-cut, medium-bodied English mixture. Latakia's smoke forms the blend's backbone, Oriental leaf brings dry spice and a resinous tone, and Perique balances red Virginia's breadlike sweetness with a sharpness evoking plum and black pepper. Suited to those looking for a measured English blend that can carry its smoky character at any hour of the day. Since nicotine load stays at a medium level, it can also serve as an entry point for those newly moving into Latakia blends; the room note, however, is distinctly smoky and lingers for a long time indoors.
cornell-diehl-red-odessa.o: A spicy sharpness accompanies a smoky Latakia scent reminiscent of wood fire.

park-lane-tobacconist-old-church.z: No reliable source could be found for the Park brand pipe tobacco called Lane Tobacconist-Old Church, so a detailed profile could not be produced.

peterson-1865-mixture.z: No sufficient information based on the maker's own description or two independent sources could be found for Peterson's blend 1865 Mixture; it is reportedly a mixture containing Virginia and Latakia.

robert-mcconnell-black-flake.z: There is not enough source material documenting the content and character of Robert McConnell Black Flake.

peretti-somerset-slices.z: One of the house blends from L. J. Peretti's shop in Boston; it appears under the burley blends heading in the maker's listing. No published description of the blend's composition and character could be found, so the profile is left incomplete.

smoke-king-christmas-mixture-2016.z: A seasonal house blend Smoke-King released specifically for 2016; since it was prepared in limited quantity and no documented source on its composition could be found, this record is left blank.

mcclelland-no-402-chocolate-cream.z: A blend flavored toward chocolate and cream within McClelland's numbered bulk aromatic series; no sufficient source documenting its composition could be found.

sutliff-tobacco-company-kentucky-planter.z: Kentucky Planter is one of Sutliff Tobacco Company's burley-forward blends; independent sources do not provide sufficient information on its composition and production status.
sutliff-tobacco-company-kentucky-planter.o: Leaves a scent of roasted nuts and dry earth.

cobblestone-english-plug.z: No independent, reliable sourcing could be found regarding the Cobblestone pipe tobacco named English Plug, so the blend's content, cut, and character could not be recorded.

two-friends-heritage.z: Heritage is the member of the Two Friends line connected to classic American blending tradition. Brown Cavendish, unsweetened black Cavendish and select Burley leaf join red and lemon Virginia leaves; it is presented ribbon cut. The light sweetness of the Virginia side and Burley's dry, nutty body form the blend's two axes, while the Cavendish softens the texture. Since the casing load is kept very low, the taste stays plain and unshowy, with nicotine between mild and medium. A record for those after a traditional American blend that can be repeated all day, without flash.
two-friends-heritage.o: Leaves a lightly sweet, loose tobacco aroma reminiscent of dry hay and nuts.

liggett-myers-tobacco-company-good-old-s.z: Good Old Summer-Time is a Virginia-burley pipe tobacco sold by Liggett & Myers, one of the major US tobacco manufacturers, in large eight-ounce tins during the first half of the twentieth century. Virginia leaf gives a grassy, sugary base while burley builds a roasted, earthy, woody one; records indicate old tins also carry a light smoky note from processing or aging. It belongs to the period's class of cheap, everyday American pipe tobaccos and today is found only in collector tins. The brand has long been out of production.
liggett-myers-tobacco-company-good-old-s.o: Leaves a lightly smoky note along with roasted nut and dry hay scents.

tobacconist-reserve-ltd-blend-07.z: Blend 07 is one of the limited tinned blends American maker Sutliff released within its Tobacconist Reserve series. Fire-cured dark leaf, sweet Cavendish and bright yellow Virginia are combined, with a citrus-leaning essence applied on top. The blend's sugar load is carried by the Cavendish, while the Virginia offers a light sweetness and acidity working in the same direction as the lemony essence. Being moderate in nicotine, it suits smokers after an all-day aromatic, particularly those who want a sharper, fresher top note rather than heavy vanilla and fruit essences. It was distributed in small 1.5-ounce tins, and in later years became harder to find through retail channels.
tobacconist-reserve-ltd-blend-07.o: Leaves a citrus aroma reminiscent of lemon peel layered over sweet Cavendish.

stanwell-danish-truffles-mix.z: Danish Truffles Mix is the mixture-cut member of the Denmark-based Stanwell brand's aromatic line built on a Virginia and black cavendish base. The line's cube-cut sibling is called Danish Truffles; the same product has been offered under the name Danish Dice in the EU market. Stanwell tobaccos are today produced under the Scandinavian Tobacco Group, so while the brand originates in Denmark, its production facilities have changed over time. The blend's casing follows a fruity, lightly liqueur-like, orange-leaning direction; the black cavendish base carries this sweetness while the Virginia leaves leave a light sugar-and-tartness balance behind it. Nicotine is low while the flavoring dose is pronounced, making the blend suited to smokers seeking an all-day-smokable aromatic where casing rather than leaf taste is at the forefront. Records indicate it's not found on the market under the Stanwell name and that the line's name has changed.
stanwell-danish-truffles-mix.o: Leaves a heavily fruity scent reminiscent of sweet orange peel and liqueur.

torben-dansk-kentucky-u-s-a.z: Torben Dansk Kentucky U.S.A. is a single-varietal blending component consisting of fire-cured American Kentucky leaf. Sources describe it as carrying a full, smoky aroma that is astringent throughout, with an herbal character. The fire-curing method gives the leaf its smoky taste and high nicotine load. Smoked alone it is strong and sharp; it is mostly used in small proportions to add body, smoke and spice to Virginia- or Burley-forward blends. Suited to smokers used to strong tobaccos and to home blenders.
torben-dansk-kentucky-u-s-a.o: Leaves a smoky, dry and sharp aroma reminiscent of wood fire.

owl-shop-pattersons-mixture.z: Recorded among the Owl Shop's unflavored blends as a mellow English mixture with Turkish leaf and Perique added; no second source confirming its proportions and character could be found.
owl-shop-pattersons-mixture.o: No description could be found in the records.

davidoff-50th-anniversary.z: 50th Anniversary is a limited-edition pipe tobacco Davidoff released in 2018 for its fiftieth year. It's limited worldwide to six thousand numbered tins, with an anniversary emblem used on the tin. The Swiss-origin brand's pipe tobaccos are produced in Germany. The blend's backbone consists of the virginia types Basis Blau 66 and Da Vinci, along with burley, black cavendish and Indian virginia from the Mysore region. Kir royal (a combination of blackcurrant liqueur and sparkling wine) and vanilla are used as flavoring, aiming for a creamy texture on the palate. It's loose cut, and black and gold leaves are seen mixed in the tin. Its nicotine is kept low, suiting those who love sweet, fruity aromatics.
davidoff-50th-anniversary.o: Leaves a sweet scent evoking creamy vanilla and red fruit and wine.

just-for-him-smokers-mystery.z: No reliable sources — neither the maker's own description nor an independent review — could be found for Just For Him's Smokers Mystery, so the profile is left incomplete.

tobacco-lane-chief-paduke.z: A mixture recorded as one of the house blends from the tobacconist Tobacco Lane, noted as Cavendish-forward; no detailed composition information has been found.
tobacco-lane-chief-paduke.o: No source describing its aroma has been found.

cornell-diehl-montford-point-marine.z: Montford Point Marine is Cornell & Diehl's ribbon-cut, unflavored English mixture. It is built on a trio of fire-cured dark burley, perique, and Latakia; the fire-cured leaf gives the blend an earthy, woody thickness, while the perique adds a peppery edge. Latakia smoke sits over this base, carrying the blend into full-bodied territory. Nicotine strength runs high, so it suits smokers accustomed to hearty blends; it may be too much for those seeking something mild. The blend's name references Montford Point, the first training center for Black Marine recruits following Executive Order 8802, which ended racial segregation in the U.S. armed forces; records indicate more than twenty thousand men trained there through 1949.
cornell-diehl-montford-point-marine.o: Leaves a peppery, sharp trace over dark wood smoke and earth.

cornell-diehl-lone-sentinel.z: Lone Sentinel is one of four plug tobaccos in Cornell & Diehl's national-parks-inspired Summit series. Its composition consists of whole-leaf red and orange Virginias and pure St. James Perique; it's a classic Virginia-Perique construction, pressed into a dense plug. During its time under press the flavors merge, producing a smooth, settled smoke. The profile shows Perique's sharp spice, fermented stone-fruit tones, and a fine citrus line layer by layer. With body and nicotine above medium, it's aimed at smokers accustomed to cutting plug and to full-bodied Virginia-Perique blends.
cornell-diehl-lone-sentinel.o: Leaves a scent of fermented dark fruit and spice.

mission-pipe-shop-baclava.z: Baclava is an aromatic house blend from Mission Pipe Shop in San Jose, taking its name from baklava; no accessible source confirming its composition and cut details could be found.

cornell-diehl-peach-brandy.z: No composition description published by the maker or retailers could be found for this Cornell & Diehl blend named Peach Brandy.

d-r-tobacco-blenders-bench-belmont-periq.z: Belmont Perique is the pure Perique leaf sold in Daughters & Ryan's Blenders Bench line. Perique is a tobacco fermented under pressure in Louisiana and is generally used in small proportions in blends. Its flavor is spicy, peppery, oily, distinctly earthy, and woody, accompanied by fermented, malty-sour fruit tones recalling fig, raisin, and plum. Smoked on its own, nicotine and flavor intensity are very high; its main function is being added in small amounts to Virginia blends for spice and depth.
d-r-tobacco-blenders-bench-belmont-periq.o: Leaves a pickled, fermented-fruit and pepper scent.

mcclelland-gkcpc-boston-1776.z: Boston 1776 is an unflavored flake blend made from Virginia leaves. Red, lemon, and orange-toned Virginias are matured for years through natural summer sweating cycles and then pressed into cakes under heavy pressure before being sliced; this process lets the flavors meld and the sugars concentrate. In the smoke, lemony tang, dried fruit, and a bready base can be heard. The blend was introduced in 1993 as a club release, and after 2008 was reissued by McClelland on behalf of the Greater Kansas City Pipe Club under its Club Blends series. A product for those interested in unflavored Virginia and aging; discontinued when McClelland closed in 2018.
mcclelland-gkcpc-boston-1776.o: Leaves a tangy dried-fruit and toasted-bread aroma.

torben-dansk-no-7-english-mixture.z: Torben Dansk No.7 English Mixture is an English mixture containing roughly forty percent Latakia, with the remainder made up of Virginia varieties in different cut widths. Despite the high Latakia share, it is noted as staying mellow to smoke while giving off a very intense room note. The varying cut widths regulate the burn and give a dry smoke. Suited to smokers used to English blends who are after Latakia weight. It is occasionally seen out of stock in sales listings.
torben-dansk-no-7-english-mixture.o: An intense campfire and soot aroma fills the room.

diebels-sportsmens-gallery-folkestone-fl.z: This is a shop blend named for the Diebel's Sportsmens Gallery tobacconist in Kansas City; its name points to a flake tobacco prepared from straight Virginia leaf. No independent source detailing the blend's composition and character could be found.

wilke-pipe-tobacco-wilke-no-193.z: Wilke No. 193 is among the numbered blends the maker calls the 190 series. Latakia and Perique are added to a Virginia and Burley base, and the mixture is rounded out with Wilke's own fermented black cavendish leaf. The maker describes the blend as a light English mixture, a "social English" that can be smoked in company; since the Latakia ratio is kept low, the smoke isn't dominant. It suits smokers wanting to try the structure of English blends without heavy smoke.
wilke-pipe-tobacco-wilke-no-193.o: Leaves a measured scent, lightly smoky and sweetish, reminiscent of dried fruit.

just-for-him-shortcut-to-mushrooms.z: Shortcut To Mushrooms belongs to Just For Him's Middle-earth Pipeweed series and takes its name from the shortcut Frodo and his friends take on their way to Farmer Maggot's farm. It's one of the series' two Latakia-bearing blends: a small amount of Latakia is added to a Virginia base, with a measured flavoring applied on top. This keeps the smoky side in the background, and the smoke runs along a line between an aromatic and a light English blend. Nicotine isn't heavy; suited to those who want to try both styles at once and to those seeking a daytime smoke.
just-for-him-shortcut-to-mushrooms.o: Leaves a sweetish tobacco aroma mixed with a light smoky note.

sentimiento-nacional-general-manuel-belg.z: A Sentimiento Nacional blend named after a figure from Argentina's independence history; no sufficient source documenting its composition could be found.

eric-christie-pipe-tobacco-chicora-mixtu.z: Not enough first-hand sourcing could be found for Chicora Mixture, a blend from Eric Christie Pipe Tobacco, so the record has been left open; according to available listings it is classified in the Scottish family.

w-o-larsen-indigo.z: No independent source sufficient to complete a record could be found regarding W.O. Larsen's Indigo blend, so this entry remains incomplete.

sutliff-tobacco-company-molto-dolce.z: Molto Dolce is one of the bulk blends from the Richmond-based Sutliff Tobacco Company; sufficient independent sources documenting its composition and character could not be found.

bufflehead-mallard.z: No independent, reliable sources could be found for the blend named Mallard under the Bufflehead brand, so a detailed entry could not be prepared.

pcca-new-millennium.z: A McClelland-made blend tied to PCCA's millennium anniversary series; not enough source material describing its composition could be found.

gawith-hoggarth-co-exclusive-black-bourb.z: Exclusive Black Bourbon is an aromatic blend in Gawith Hoggarth's Exclusive series. Virginia joins a black-Cavendish-forward body; the cut is a coarse, large-piece ribbon. The Cavendish's candy-like sweetness softens the bourbon topping's lightly tart edge. On the smoke, woody barrel and sweet-sugar notes stand out, with the leaf taste staying in the background. Nicotine is moderate and the smoke cool; this makes it suitable for those new to aromatic tobaccos and for anyone seeking a mild all-day blend. In recent years the brand has begun packaging this series under abbreviated names (such as PR, KBC).
gawith-hoggarth-co-exclusive-black-bourb.o: Leaves a sweet bourbon-barrel and caramelized-sugar aroma.

sutliff-tobacco-company-rl-4.z: RL-4 is one of the unflavored blends in Sutliff's bulk line. Latakia and Perique are added to a burley base and offered ribbon cut; no flavoring casing is applied. Burley gives a nutty, dry body, Latakia brings smoke, and Perique adds a peppery accent. Nicotine is moderate; it is aimed at smokers wanting smoke and spice while avoiding heavy Latakia bombs.
sutliff-tobacco-company-rl-4.o: Leaves a scent of dry wood smoke with a light pepper note.

pcca-boston-1776.z: For PCCA's blend called Boston 1776, no independent sources such as the maker's own materials or a reliable product record could be found, so no definitive information can be given about the blend's composition and character.

just-for-him-treebeard.z: Treebeard is one of the aromatic entries in Just For Him's Middle-earth Pipeweed series, named after Tolkien's tree-shepherd, Treebeard. The blend is built on Virginia and a sweetness-boosting dark Cavendish; it carries a pronounced but not overwhelming vanilla casing. True to the series' general character, the flavoring is kept light enough not to bury the tobacco taste. Suited to those seeking a soft, sweet smoke and to newcomers to aromatics.

mac-baren-modern-virginia-loose-cut.z: Modern Virginia Loose Cut is the same blend presented unpressed, as loose cut. Its composition is the same as the flake version: roughly seventy percent two separate Virginia types, twenty percent black Cavendish made from Virginia leaf, and ten percent Burley. The Burley balances the blend's sweetness and cools the burn; the blend carries a light top note reminiscent of ripe fruit. Being loose cut, it needs no packing preparation and lights faster than the slice version; on the other hand, rather than the concentrated taste pressing gives, a plainer, lighter smoke results. Hay, raisin, and fig-leaning tones are determining here too. Nicotine level is measured. Suited to those wanting a Virginia blend smokable all day that needs no preparation.
mac-baren-modern-virginia-loose-cut.o: Leaves a lightly sweet aroma reminiscent of dry hay and raisin.

petersen-sorensen-black-mixture.z: This is a mixture sold under the Petersen & Sorensen name; the profile is left incomplete, as no sufficient independent sources describing its composition and character could be found.
petersen-sorensen-black-mixture.o: Leaves an aroma typical of dark-leaf mixtures.

1776-tobacco-co-vermont-maple.z: 1776 Tobacco Co.'s maple-themed aromatic blend; no adequate source documenting its composition and character could be reached.

connoisseur-irish-whiskey-aromatic.z: No independent, reliable sourcing could be found regarding the Connoisseur blend Irish Whiskey Aromatic.

mcgahey-the-tobacconist-holt-vanilla.z: Holt Vanilla is listed as McGahey The Tobacconist's vanilla-flavored house blend; sufficient sources regarding its leaf composition and cut could not be found.

mac-baren-cherry-choice.z: Cherry Choice is a loose-cut aromatic in Mac Baren's Choice series. The blend's base consists of golden Virginia and the brand's modern Cavendish, softened with Burley; a sour-cherry-and-rum-character flavoring is applied over it. The taste follows the brand's classic intense Cavendish line and sits close to Original Choice. Nicotine proportion is low. Since it burns quickly, smoking it unhurried, at a slow pace, in a well-rested pipe reduces tongue bite and moisture issues.
mac-baren-cherry-choice.o: Leaves a sweet, liqueur-like aroma mixing sour cherry and rum.

ken-byron-ventures-mr-christians-holiday.z: Holiday Road is a blend combining twelve separate Virginias with a measured fruit-brandy casing, over which distinctly fruity Perique is added. The maker describes the blend as designed for the holiday season but not season-locked, built from long-rested leaf as a Virginia/Perique mixture. Records indicate the first batch shipped in December 2018. Using so many Virginias multiplies the sweet, tangy, and breadlike layers; the Perique adds dark plum-and-fig fruit and a light peppery spice on top. Rather than laying down an aromatic veil, the brandy casing extends the existing fruitiness. Aimed at smokers who know the Virginia/Perique structure and want a medium-bodied blend with high flavor intensity.
ken-byron-ventures-mr-christians-holiday.o: Leaves a tobacco aroma with a fruity sweetness leaning toward plum and fig.

dan-tobacco-sweet-vanilla-honeydew.z: Sweet Vanilla Honeydew, also known as SVH for short, is an aromatic blend prepared by flavoring select light-colored Virginia leaves with vanilla and honey. The cut is ready rubbed, meaning previously pressed leaf already rubbed out; it can be packed directly. The topping is pronounced, and the vanilla taste lasts to the bottom of the bowl; toward the finish, Virginia's own sweetness comes forward. Fullness is light. It suits those seeking a strongly topped aromatic with a scent that fills the room, and newcomers to the pipe.
dan-tobacco-sweet-vanilla-honeydew.o: Leaves a scent of vanilla custard and honey.

orlik-tobacco-company-a-s-wattsons-origi.z: Records describe it as a semi-aromatic blend aimed at the Scandinavian market, built around toasted burley with Virginia and black cavendish; not enough source material confirming its composition could be found.
orlik-tobacco-company-a-s-wattsons-origi.o: No description could be found in the records.

compagnia-toscana-sigari-petrocelli.z: Petrocelli is one of the products from Compagnia Toscana Sigari, a maker of Tuscan-style cheroot cigars. It is a half-length cheroot with 100 percent hand rolling and long-filler construction, in which fire-cured Kentucky leaf grown in the Tiber Valley is used both for the wrapper and the filler. It is prepared at the company's production facility in Sansepolcro and was released to market in 2017. According to available records, the blend is a version of the same maker's short cigar Mastro Tornabuoni, aged for twelve months instead of six; the name Petrocelli is noted as having been given for the Turkish market. The cigar is 78 mm long and 13 mm in diameter; since it comes out of the box quite dry, it is expected to be rested at roughly 75 percent relative humidity before smoking.
compagnia-toscana-sigari-petrocelli.o: Leaves an intense leaf aroma evoking cocoa, earth, licorice root, red pepper, and leather.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-clan-limi.z: A limited-run version of the Clan brand whose name references a three-year aging; no independent source on the blend's content could be found.
scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-clan-limi.o: No detailed description of the room note could be found in the records.

hearth-home-anniversary-kake.z: Anniversary Kake is one of the most talked-about Virginia-Perique works within Russ Ouellette's Hearth & Home series. It is made as a pressed cake; the slices come oily and sticky, meant to be rubbed out by hand. The tin aroma carries a tart intensity from fermentation together with a rum note reminiscent of naval tradition. The blend sits at the dark end of the Virginia-Perique family; the Perique ratio is kept noticeably high, giving flavors of dried plum, fig, and black pepper. Thanks to the pressed structure, it burns cool and long. Both nicotine and flavor intensity are high. Suited to experienced smokers — not those coming from mild blends — who want a lightly flavored, heavy, and hearty Virginia-Perique.
hearth-home-anniversary-kake.o: Leaves a dark tobacco aroma mixed with fermented dried fruit and rum.

peretti-coffee-blend.z: This is a shop blend L.J. Peretti lists in its Cavendish group that, judging by its name, is coffee-flavored; the record is incomplete since the proportion of base leaves and flavor details have not been published.

pfeifen-huber-scottish.z: Scottish is an unflavored blend that Pfeifen Huber offers within its English line. It contains broken Virginia and bright Virginia leaf alongside black Cavendish, Latakia, and Turkish Oriental tobacco, with no added flavoring. The Latakia is kept in modest proportion, leaving a smoky character that is noticeable but never dominant. The smoke is light-bodied, spicy, and dry; the Oriental's spice and the Virginia's sweetness play off each other, while the Cavendish rounds out the body. Nicotine strength is low, making it suitable for long sittings. It suits smokers trying a Latakia blend for the first time as well as those looking for a mild English mixture.
pfeifen-huber-scottish.o: Leaves a faint campfire-smoke aroma with dry spice.

peter-heinrichs-latakia-flake.z: Peter Heinrichs Latakia Flake is a pressed slice tobacco prepared from Cyprus Latakia, American dark-fired Kentucky, and African-origin Virginia leaf. Per the maker's account, Kentucky and Virginia are put through a double fermentation to bring out their natural sweetness, and only then combined with Latakia; the mixture is pressed for fourteen days. Before pressing, rose, cinnamon, and coriander oil are added to the blend; these additions leave a fine spice layer over the smoky base. It is a full-bodied slice with high flavor intensity; smoke comes forward on the first draw. It is a record aimed at smokers interested in heavy-bodied flakes with a pronounced Latakia proportion who are used to rubbing out slices.
peter-heinrichs-latakia-flake.o: A trace of cinnamon and floral spice runs through a heavy incense aroma.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-sail-auth.z: Sail is a brand rooted in the Dutch pipe-tobacco tradition, now under the Scandinavian Tobacco Group umbrella; no sufficient primary source describing this version's composition could be found.

pcca-virginian.z: A blend within the USA series PCCA had McClelland produce, apparently Virginia-forward judging by its name; not enough source material confirming its composition could be found.

elephant-castle-isle-of-skye.z: No sufficient independent sourcing could be reached to document the composition and character of Isle of Skye, a pipe tobacco from Elephant & Castle.

larus-brother-company-inc-blend-11-aroma.z: Cited as one of the aromatic records of Richmond-based Larus & Brother Company; no source could be found for the blend's contents.

hermit-tobacco-works-co-holiday-blend-20.z: Holiday Blend 2006 is part of Hermit Tobacco Works Co.'s annual holiday series; records suggest the blends from this period leaned heavily Virginia, but there is not enough sourcing to detail this blend.

john-middleton-inc-kentucky-club-contine.z: One of the blends from John Middleton, a company founded in Philadelphia in 1856 that has made pipe tobacco since the 1950s; the entry is left incomplete because not enough sources could be found to document the blend's contents and character.
john-middleton-inc-kentucky-club-contine.o: No source could be found on the room note.

peretti-english-no-220.z: English No. 220 is described as a fuller-bodied version of Peretti's English 110 blend. It is built on the same Virginia, Oriental, and Latakia framework; the difference is a darker, fuller smoke obtained by raising the Latakia and Oriental proportion. It is an unflavored English blend; sweetness comes only from the Virginia. It is aimed at smokers accustomed to heavy Latakia who are seeking a full smoke for the evening pipe. Per the maker's account, production paused for a period due to a disruption in the supply of ingredients.
peretti-english-no-220.o: Leaves an intense aroma of smoke, tar, and dry spice.

paul-olsen-summer-flake.z: One of the Paul Olsen house's aromatics offered in flake form; no independent source documenting its composition could be found.

japan-tobacco-momoyama-2.z: No reliable source documenting the content and character of Japan Tobacco's Momoyama 2 blend could be found.

sutliff-tobacco-company-crumble-cake-lim.z: Phantom Privateer is the sixth limited edition in Sutliff's barrel-aged Crumble Kake series. Real perique grown and processed in Louisiana's St. James parish is added to red Virginia and black cavendish leaves; the blend is rested in a rum barrel for roughly eighty days before being pressed and sliced. The sweet, spicy depth from the barrel combines with perique's peppery fruitiness; cavendish forms a soft base. The crumbly cake-form cut is broken apart by hand before packing the bowl. Being a limited edition, it is not in continuous production.
sutliff-tobacco-company-crumble-cake-lim.o: Leaves a sweet, lightly spicy scent from the rum barrel.

tewksbury-company-nosferatu.z: Nosferatu, a pipe tobacco from Tewksbury & Company; no sufficient primary source documenting the content and character of this blend could be found in the records.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-clan-raw-.z: Apparently released under the Clan name; no independent source describing its content and character could be found, so no further detail is given.
scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-clan-raw-.o: No detailed description of the room note could be found in the records.

golden-blend-tobacco-co-zimmys-mix.z: Zimmy's Mix is described as a lightly flavored mixture bringing together dark black Cavendish with golden-yellow Virginias and a small amount of Kentucky Burley. Beyond this composition, no other verifiable sourcing on the blend has been found.
golden-blend-tobacco-co-zimmys-mix.o: Leaves a sweet, lightly nutty aroma.

pcca-port-of-dumfries.z: A blend within the USA series PCCA had McClelland produce; not enough source material describing its composition could be found.

nording-pointer-hunter-2025.z: Pointer is the straight Virginia member of Nørding's Hunter (Hunting) series, named after hunting dog breeds. The line was blended for the Danish-origin brand's name by American manufacturer Cornell & Diehl. It contains no other leaf type; only flame-cured red and light-yellow Virginia leaves are used. It is ribbon cut. Part of the blend is prepared with toasted leaf and part with untoasted leaf, balanced together. The baked sweetness from red Virginia and the tart, herbal sharpness from light Virginia run intertwined; a citrus-leaning top note and a full mouthfeel are reported. In nicotine terms it stays below medium, making it the kind smokable all day. It suits those wanting to get to know unflavored Virginia's natural sugar in a straightforward form, and newcomers to the type.
nording-pointer-hunter-2025.o: Leaves a lightly citrusy tobacco scent at the sweetness of baked dough and hay.

payless-pipes-custom-blends-no-230.z: No. 230 is referred to as an English-style mixture within Payless Pipes' numbered line of custom blends from this American retailer; no independent source describing its composition could be found.
payless-pipes-custom-blends-no-230.o: No source could be found to describe the room note.

wilke-pipe-tobacco-wilke-no-531.z: Wilke No. 531 is a blend the maker revived from its old ledgers. Its composition consists of Virginia, Burley, and a modest amount of Perique; it contains no Latakia. The brand states that the blend's number comes from founder Edwin Wilke's birthday. With no smoky component present, the character rests entirely on Virginia's bready sweetness, Burley's dry body, and Perique's dark, fruity spice. Since the Perique ratio is kept low, its peppery bite doesn't come to the fore, instead mainly deepening Virginia's sweetness. Its additive-free structure and moderate nicotine heft make it suitable for all-day smoking. It suits smokers seeking Latakia-free, leaf-forward blends who want an option that adds Burley body to the Virginia-Perique pattern.
wilke-pipe-tobacco-wilke-no-531.o: Leaves a scent of dry hay, bread crust, and a hint of plum.

scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-sail-blac.z: Sail is a Dutch-origin tobacco brand; the line's blends are prepared by combining burley, cavendish, and Virginia leaf, with some varieties also containing a small amount of latakia. The black-packaged variety sits in the series' dark, cavendish-forward wing. It is ribbon cut; on the flavor side, cavendish sweetness and burley's nutty foundation appear together. It stays measured in nicotine. Suited to those seeking Continental European-style daily aromatics with pronounced sweetness but a non-smothering casing.
scandinavian-tobacco-group-stg-sail-blac.o: Leaves a sweet scent evoking lightly toasted sugar.

mosi-italico-ammezzato.z: Italico Ammezzato is the half-length cheroot product from the Ambasciator Italico series that the Moderno Opificio del Sigaro Italiano (MOSI) company launched in 2014; it has been sold in Turkey under the shortened name Italico Ammezzato. It is machine-rolled at the facility in Orsago, undergoing a single fermentation and six months of aging. The filler is mainly Italian fire-cured Kentucky tobacco grown in Veneto; the wrapper leaf is Tennessee Kentucky. It is about 78 mm long and 14 mm in diameter. Cocoa, coffee, and hazelnut associations lead in the aroma; the burnt, tangy depth expected from fire curing is kept restrained. Despite its tight roll it burns evenly and slowly, giving a single unbroken ash. In the smoke, a lightly sweet taste runs alongside a moderate Kentucky intensity, with a measured bitterness appearing toward the end; a light nutty trace lingers in the mouth at the finish. It is a directly smoked tobacco product, not a pipe tobacco.
mosi-italico-ammezzato.o: Leaves a fire-cured tobacco aroma with cocoa, coffee, and hazelnut associations.

tinder-box-chartwell.z: Tinder Box is the name of an American tobacconist chain founded in 1928 that sells blends prepared for its own shops under its own name; Chartwell is one of these house blends, though no sufficient independent source describing its composition and character has been found.

mullins-westley-ltd-classic-english.z: Reportedly an English-style blend with a measured amount of Latakia, sold under its own name by the Mullins & Westley tobacconist in London's Covent Garden; no independent source confirming its composition could be found.

cornell-diehl-old-joe-krantz-red-label.z: Old Joe Krantz Red Label is the Latakia version of the Burley series of the same name. Red Virginia, Cyprus Latakia, and Perique are added on top of a dark, cube-cut Burley base; black Cavendish rounds out the blend's body. The result is a medium-bodied, lightly spiced English mixture. Suited to smokers wanting Latakia smoke without giving up Burley character; since the Latakia proportion isn't decisive, it may read as light to those looking for intense Balkan mixtures. Strength, flavor, and room note sit in the medium band. Available in 2-ounce and 8-ounce tins as well as in bulk.
cornell-diehl-old-joe-krantz-red-label.o: A subtle wood smoke and spice trace mingles with a nutty tobacco scent.

mac-baren-original-flake.z: No verifiable information from the maker or reliable retailers could be found for a Mac Baren blend sold under this name; the record is limited to the available data.

sterling-tobacco-co-country-club.z: Country Club is an aromatic blend from Sterling Tobacco Company built entirely from ribbon-cut leaves. Per the maker's description, light and dark cavendish are mixed with bright Virginia and red Virginia; a heavy flavoring is applied to the blend. The fully ribbon cut ensures easy packing and even burning. The cavendish portion carries the sweetness and softness, while the Virginia portion carries a background dried-fruit taste. Nicotine is low and flavoring intensity is high; the room note is pronouncedly sweet. A structure designed for smokers new to aromatic blends or seeking a soft mixture for all-day smoking.
sterling-tobacco-co-country-club.o: Leaves an intense, confection-like sweet scent.

planta-danish-black-vanilla.z: Danish Black Vanilla is a ribbon-cut aromatic built on a black-Cavendish-heavy body with Burley and Virginia added. The blend's one defining flavoring is vanilla, and this casing is applied quite intensely; it stays dominant from the tin note through to the end of the smoke. Nicotine is very light, while flavor sits at above-medium intensity thanks to the sweetness from the casing. It is aimed at smokers looking for an intensely aromatic smoke; even those used to lightly cased aromatics may find the flavoring heavy. It is a blend Planta has offered in 100-gram tins and 40-gram pouches, part of its catalogue for many years.
planta-danish-black-vanilla.o: An intense vanilla and sugary-sweet aroma fills the room.

boswell-pipes-tobacco-rum-river.z: Rum River is, as its name suggests, a Boswell aromatic flavored with rum aroma. The pouch content consists of medium-brown and black cavendish leaves; the cut is neat and even. The manufacturer describes the blend through a tropical flavor impression. The flavor casing stays at a sweet line reminiscent of rum cake and leaves a light vanilla tone behind it. Nicotine and flavor body are at a low level, so it stays limited for smokers seeking the leaf's own taste up front; aimed at those who prefer scented, soft aromatics.
boswell-pipes-tobacco-rum-river.o: Leaves a rum cake and light vanilla aroma.

chacom-royale.z: No sufficient independent source could be found regarding this blend bearing the name of French pipe manufacturer Chacom.

dunhill-a-30000.z: A discontinued mixture referred to by its code number under the Dunhill name, for which no verifiable source on its composition could be found.

comptons-of-galashiels-regimental-mixtur.z: No independent, reliable sourcing could be found regarding the Compton's of Galashiels pipe tobacco named Regimental Mixture, so the blend's content, cut, and character could not be recorded.

watch-city-cigar-bi-polar-express.z: Bi-Polar Express is Watch City Cigar's limited-run 2024 Christmas blend, created together with tobacco writer Jim Amash. The composition's defining leaves are Rustica and dark-fired Kentucky, joined by dark Burley and Virginia, topped with a chocolate, rum, and hazelnut casing.
watch-city-cigar-bi-polar-express.o: A smoky, grassy, lightly incense-like scent appears beneath the cocoa-and-hazelnut sweetness.

b-b-tobacconists-llc-sams-gap.z: A tobacconist blend noted as aromatic; no source documenting its composition could be found, leaving the profile blank.

sutliff-tobacco-company-chocolate-mousse.z: Sutliff B30 Chocolate Mousse is a ribbon-cut bulk aromatic where black cavendish is given a cocoa flavor. Per the maker's description, the tobacco is very dark in color, the flavor line is soft, and a thin trace of vanilla accompanies the cocoa. The blend offers a single-minded, direct sweet profile; nicotine is low. As it can come out of the tin fairly moist, airing it before packing changes the burn balance. Aimed at those seeking cocoa-centered aromatics and a pronounced room note.
sutliff-tobacco-company-chocolate-mousse.o: Leaves a scent of warm cocoa and vanilla.

hu-tobacco-nyala.z: No sufficient independent source could be found for the Nyala blend under the HU Tobacco name, so its content and character could not be recorded.

pipe-republic-botany-bay.z: No reliable sources on Pipe Republic's blend Botany Bay could be found, so its content, cut, and character could not be recorded.

georgetown-tobacco-no-1261.z: No.1261 is one of the house blends sold loose at Georgetown Tobacco's shop in Washington. According to the maker's description, it's a straightforward cube-cut mixture made from selected Burley leaf; it's kept light enough for all-day smoking and designed not to bite the tongue. Because it's Burley-based, its flavor line runs dry, nutty, and bready rather than sweet; since sugar content is low, it burns slowly and cool. A convenient everyday blend for smokers who don't want the heavy topping of aromatic mixtures but also want to avoid Virginia's sharp tartness, as well as for newcomers.
georgetown-tobacco-no-1261.o: Leaves a dry-hay and lightly nutty bread aroma.

charles-fairmorn-black-bayou-mist.z: No sufficient independent sources could be found regarding this blend released under the Charles Fairmorn name.

peterson-my-mixture-965.z: My Mixture 965 is a ribbon-cut English blend built from Cyprus Latakia, Macedonian-origin Oriental leaf, Virginia, and brown Cavendish. Records indicate it originated in the Dunhill catalog in 1965; after Dunhill stopped producing pipe tobacco, it was continued under the Peterson name with its original recipe and tin artwork. Latakia lays down a smoky, cool backbone; the Oriental leaf adds sweetness and spice, Virginia natural sugar, and Cavendish a creamy softness. The body is full and flavor intensity high; nutty notes appear through the smoke. It suits smokers wanting to get to know classic English blends who don't shy away from smoky tobaccos.
peterson-my-mixture-965.o: Fills the room with a wood-fire smoke and dry spice aroma.

newminster-no-2-smooth-rum.z: Newminster No. 2 Smooth Rum is the rum-flavored member of the Danish-made Newminster bulk tobacco line. Built on Virginia leaf with black Cavendish, the blend is thick ribbon cut, with some portions showing a broken-flake appearance. The rum's sweetness is prominent in the pouch aroma, and the moisture level is ready to smoke. In the smoke, sweetness leads, with the tobacco's own taste forming a soft base under the rum. Nicotine is light to medium, placing it among the aromatics smokable throughout the day. Suitable for smokers who enjoy flavored tobaccos and are looking for a rum note.
newminster-no-2-smooth-rum.o: Leaves a sweet rum aroma in the room, reminiscent of lightly burnt sugar.

the-briary-chart-topper.z: One of the house blends from The Briary, a pipe shop that has operated in Birmingham, Alabama since 1974; no independent source describing the blend's composition and character could be found.

watch-city-cigar-grail-mixture.z: This is a house blend from Watch City Cigar described as English-style, for which no sufficient source could be found.
watch-city-cigar-grail-mixture.o: Records note it leaves a smoky scent typical of Latakia-containing English blends.

rattray-professional-mixture.z: Professional Mixture is a medium-bodied English blend. Latakia has a pronounced share, joined by a good amount of Oriental tobacco and the brand's Virginia leaf, including stoved black Virginia among them. The ribbon cut makes packing easy. It is a cool-burning mixture; the combination of Oriental leaf and Latakia builds a spicy, smoky flavor line, while the stoved Virginia leaves a dark sweetness underneath. It suits smokers looking for a classic English blend with a high Latakia share but a body that isn't fully harsh.
rattray-professional-mixture.o: Leaves a smoky wood-smoke and spicy dry-tobacco aroma.

f-j-burrus-s-a-windsail-platinum.z: F.J. Burrus S.A. is a tobacco company with Swiss origins; no verifiable source could be found regarding the composition and character of this blend.

calume-calume-kiowa-cut.z: The Calume line is, per records, a pipe tobacco range introduced to the German market at the end of 2008, taking its name from the Native American peace pipe (calumet). Kiowa-Cut is the line's wide, long-cut member; bright Virginia is combined with black, flavored Cavendish. It is sold in 50-gram pouches and 100-gram tins. The defining feature of the blend is a pine-resin flavoring evoking the forest; Virginia's sweetness is softened by the lightly cased, toasted Cavendish. With balanced moisture it fills easily, burns cool, and keeps burning without biting the tongue. Nicotine is low. Aimed at smokers seeking a distinctive but not heavy aroma outside the classic fruit-vanilla mold.
calume-calume-kiowa-cut.o: Leaves a resinous pine-needle and lightly sweet forest aroma.

cornell-diehl-old-joe-krantz-blue-label.z: Old Joe Krantz Blue Label is the unflavored member of Cornell & Diehl's Burley-focused blend family. Dark Burley and cube-cut white Burley are used together, with Virginia balancing the sweetness. The cube-cut leaf produces a slow-burning, thick-smoking bowl; the blend offers a medium-bodied structure. Suited to smokers looking for classic American-style Burley blends — that is, unflavored, nutty-tart tobacco taste. It can also serve as an entry point for those moving into Burley for the first time. Offered in 2-ounce and 8-ounce tins as well as in bulk.
cornell-diehl-old-joe-krantz-blue-label.o: Leaves a plain tobacco scent reminiscent of dry walnut and toasted bread.

d-r-tobacco-rimboche-a-b.z: No reliable sources sufficient to establish the composition and character of D & R Tobacco's Rimboché A.B. blend were found.

iwan-ries-kings-oriental.z: This is a blend that appears in Iwan Ries catalogs; no independent source describing its content and character could be found, so the profile is left incomplete.
iwan-ries-kings-oriental.o: No room note described in the records could be found.

gawith-hoggarth-co-kendal-gold-menthol-a.z: Referred to as a menthol-and-mint-flavored version within the Kendal Gold shag series; no reliable sourcing giving details specific to this version's composition and character could be found.
gawith-hoggarth-co-kendal-gold-menthol-a.o: Leaves a cool menthol and mint aroma.

mcclelland-2012-holiday-spirit.z: 2012 Holiday Spirit is that year's release of the Holiday Spirit series McClelland put out in limited numbers each year for the holiday season. The series' recipe is built on nutty Burley, tangy Virginia, and black Cavendish; dark rum, walnut, and cocoa are used as flavoring. The aroma stands out in the tin with a chocolate-and-praline association, and the rum's sweetness carries through the smoke. Nicotine is low, the smoke mild. Aimed at smokers wanting a sweet aromatic blend tied to a particular time of year. The series ended entirely when the brand stopped production in 2018.
mcclelland-2012-holiday-spirit.o: Leaves an aroma of chocolate, sugared walnut, and rum.

just-for-him-the-mellow-monk.z: No reliable sources — neither the maker's own description nor an independent review — could be found for Just For Him's The Mellow Monk, so the profile is left incomplete; per catalog records, the blend is classified as "Burley Based."

dan-tobacco-tordenskjold-virginia-slices.z: Tordenskjold Virginia Slices is a pressed blend that brings together select Virginia grades with Louisiana Perique. The mixture is aged for twelve weeks under light pressure fermentation, then cut into thin slices; it belongs to a series named for Danish naval history. The smoke is cool and even, with the sweetness of golden Virginias coming through clearly, while the Perique adds a peppery spice and a touch of fruity depth. Strength stays medium. Being a flake, it calls for some preparation before packing. Well suited to smokers who enjoy a straightforward Virginia/Perique construction and are considering cellaring a tin.
dan-tobacco-tordenskjold-virginia-slices.o: Leaves a room note of baked-bread sweetness mingled with a peppery spice.

sutliff-tobacco-company-tropical-cavendi.z: 13 Tropic Cavendish is a fruit-cased blend among Sutliff's bulk aromatics. The base is built from golden Virginia and burley leaf and flavored with the brand's own tropical fruit essence. The cut is ribbon. Strength is light, and aroma and taste intensity are described as light to medium, so the casing comes through without overpowering the tobacco. It suits smokers looking for a fruit character outside the usual vanilla and cherry line, who enjoy light-smoking aromatics.
sutliff-tobacco-company-tropical-cavendi.o: Leaves a scent of ripe tropical fruit with a light floral sweetness.

lane-limited-mountain-leaf.z: Not enough independent sources could be found documenting the contents and character of American blender Lane Limited's blend called Mountain Leaf.

gawith-hoggarth-co-kendal-black-cherry.z: Kendal Black Cherry is a straightforward aromatic where cherry essence is applied to double-fermented, sweetened black Cavendish. The ribbon cut packs easily and burns at a low temperature. On the flavor palette, the fruit essence leads; the leaf's own character stays in the background, and nicotine is low. Suited to those new to aromatic tobacco and to anyone seeking a sweet, distinctly scented everyday blend. Because of the Cavendish density it can arrive moist, so airing before smoking is common practice.
gawith-hoggarth-co-kendal-black-cherry.o: Leaves a sweet, fruity aroma reminiscent of ripe cherry and burnt sugar.

schurch-torina-sob.z: No accessible source documenting the content and character of the Schürch-signed Torina (SOB) blend could be found.

cornell-diehl-boker-or-morning-light.z: Morning Light (Boker Or) is a member of Cornell & Diehl's series carrying Hebrew names; the name means "morning light." The ribbon-cut blend's backbone is built from light but full-bodied Oriental leaves. Over this comes raisin-like perique, soft stoved red Virginia, and a small amount of sweetened black cavendish. Though the manufacturer places the blend in the Virginia family, its character is defined by the Oriental leaf's spicy, dry-grass side; perique adds spice, and cavendish a measured sweetness. It suits those looking for a medium-strength, Latakia-free Oriental blend to smoke at the start of the day.
cornell-diehl-boker-or-morning-light.o: Leaves a spicy, lightly smoky Oriental-leaf aroma with a raisin-like sweetness.

gawith-hoggarth-co-perique.z: This entry is not a blend but the unflavored Perique leaf sold in Gawith, Hoggarth & Co.'s single-leaf series. Perique is produced by fermenting harvested Louisiana leaf under pressure in its own juices; the result is a very intense leaf carrying both a plum-fig sweetness and a peppery sharpness. It isn't meant to be smoked on its own; its traditional use is being added in small proportions to Virginia-based mixtures to give them spice, body, and coolness. It's a component ingredient for smokers building their own blends; because of its high nicotine and intense taste, it's used in moderation.
gawith-hoggarth-co-perique.o: Leaves an aroma carrying a vinegary sharpness with dried plum and pepper.

sentimiento-nacional-argeus.z: A blend under the Sentimiento Nacional name; no sufficient source describing its content and character could be found.

dan-tobacco-bulldog-golden-flake.z: A pipe tobacco under the German maker Dan Tobacco Manufaktur; no reliable source on the blend's composition or character was found, so no further detail is given.

vincenzo-silver.z: Vincenzo Silver is an aromatic mixture built from Cavendish, Virginia and Burley leaf, sweetened with vanilla and almond notes. The leaf is cut to varying widths, aimed at giving a more even burn in the bowl. Sold in 50-gram tins. Sweet vanilla and nutty notes come forward on the smoke, with the Burley laying a dry base beneath that sweetness. Sources describe it as medium in nicotine. It appeals to smokers after an everyday smoke with pronounced but not overwhelming flavoring.
vincenzo-silver.o: Leaves a sweet aroma reminiscent of vanilla marzipan.

robert-mcconnell-piccadilly-circus.z: Piccadilly Circus is a traditional English blend with Latakia and Oriental leaf added to a Virginia base, presented as a ribbon cut. The maker's description notes the smoke is cool and moderate, yet carries a distinct body from the Latakia. Accounts suggest the blend favors a salty-spicy character over sweetness. It suits smokers who enjoy unflavored English blends and prefer to keep the smokiness at a moderate level; it is reported to light easily and burn evenly without harsh tongue bite. The Robert McConnell name belongs to an old English tobacco house, now produced in Germany by Kohlhase & Kopp.
robert-mcconnell-piccadilly-circus.o: Leaves a spicy, rice-and-herb undertone woven into the smoky Latakia aroma.

peter-heinrichs-no-164.z: Peter Heinrichs No. 164 is a blend built by combining Virginia leaves from select growing regions with Burley, some black Cavendish, and Latakia. The maker describes the blend as having an English mixture character with an aromatic side as well; it is noted for its slow burn and cool smoke. Virginia's sweetness and Burley's dry earthy taste form the base, black Cavendish softens the finish, and Latakia adds the smoky layer. Nicotine sits in the medium band, and flavor intensity is pronounced. It is a suitable record for smokers seeking a mild English mixture before moving on to heavier Latakia blends.
peter-heinrichs-no-164.o: Leaves a sweet Cavendish trace underneath a smoky wood aroma.

house-of-windsor-spiced-rum-t419.z: This is a blend among House of Windsor's T-series bulk aromatics, flavored, as the name suggests, with spiced rum; no verifiable source describing its content could be found.

sutliff-tobacco-company-american-dream.z: Sutliff's aromatic mixture called American Dream; since sufficient sources describing its composition and character could not be found, this record is kept limited.
sutliff-tobacco-company-american-dream.o: Not described in detail in available records.

pipesandcigars-com-scottys-old-red.z: Old Red is a blend built entirely from Virginia leaf. It combines long-aged, mahogany-red Virginia with dark Virginia stoved to near-black. The red leaf is put through a special process that brings its tart sweetness forward. It is ribbon cut, medium-bodied, and burns cooler than most Virginia blends. Its taste is sweet and tangy, carrying no flavoring. It suits smokers looking for unflavored Virginia character and the depth that dark and light leaf give together. It is sold in pipesandcigars.com's bulk Scotty's line.
pipesandcigars-com-scottys-old-red.o: Leaves a dry hay and cooked-fruit aroma.

pipesandcigars-com-perique-blend-b-41.z: Perique Blend B-41 is one of the house blends sold under its own name by the US-based retailer pipesandcigars.com; no sufficient independent sources documenting its content and character could be found.

captain-black-royal.z: Captain Black Royal is the brand's member sold in a dark-colored package and is a typical example of what is called a "drugstore blend" in America — mass-produced aromatic tobacco. It contains black Cavendish together with golden Cavendish; the two leaf tones give the blend a speckled appearance. The cut is ribbon. The casing combines caramel, cane sugar, licorice, vanilla and alcohol tones; its intensity is medium but the components do not separate individually. It gives a cool smoke, lights very easily and keeps burning. Nicotine is low and tobacco flavor stays in the background. Smoke volume is high and leaves dark, oily tar in the bowl. Aimed at smokers not seeking a heavy tobacco character but wanting a blend with plenty of smoke and a sweet room note.
captain-black-royal.o: Leaves a synthetic caramel and sugary-snack aroma.

f-k-black-bayou-mist.z: Black Bayou Mist is a full-bodied, bulk-sold English blend from F & K, founded in St. Louis in 1926. Its composition includes matured Virginia leaves, Oriental leaves, Louisiana-sourced Perique, and dark fire-cured Kentucky, with a notable amount of Latakia added on top. The cut is ribbon. Using Perique and Kentucky together gives the blend a peppery, earthy depth not seen in English blends relying on Latakia alone; nicotine load is on the high side for this reason too. The smoke is heavy, smoky, and spicy. It suits smokers accustomed to full-bodied English blends who want a dark tobacco for the end of the day. F & K is an independent brand that has its blends prepared by contract producers.
f-k-black-bayou-mist.o: Leaves a heavy campfire-smoke aroma with a peppery, dried-fruit-leaning note behind it.

ken-byron-ventures-mr-christians-fallen-.z: Mr. Christian's Fallen Cherry is a blend Ken Byron Ventures releases in small batches; without access to the maker's own description or two independent sources, its contents and character details aren't specified here.

rivertown-tobacco-works-maple-cask.z: Maple Cask is a ribbon-cut American aromatic that combines Cavendish leaf's soft texture with white Burley's dry, nutty character. The casing is built around maple syrup, accompanied by a touch of rum that evokes a barrel. Burley's relatively flat, non-tart base works as a balancing element that keeps the flavoring from weighing too heavily on the tongue. Nicotine is light-to-medium and flavor medium. It offers a structure in the classic American bulk aromatic style, easy to light and smokable without over-heating the tobacco; it suits those looking for a sweet but not one-dimensional aromatic, and tobacconists who want a maple note in their house blends.
rivertown-tobacco-works-maple-cask.o: A sugary, alcohol-tinged rum tone mixes into the sweet aroma of maple syrup.

iwan-ries-ko-ko-mixture.z: Records indicate this is a Burley-based Iwan Ries blend; no independent source verifying its composition could be found, so the profile is left incomplete.
iwan-ries-ko-ko-mixture.o: No room note described in the records could be found.

tuckett-tobacco-co-wakefield-english-mix.z: No sufficient source has been found for the Wakefield English Mixture bearing the Tuckett Tobacco Co. name.
tuckett-tobacco-co-wakefield-english-mix.o: No reliable source describing the room note has been found.

porter-house-double-mixture.z: Porter House Double Mixture is a pipe tobacco blend for which there is not enough independent source material.
porter-house-double-mixture.o: Not enough records could be found on the room note.

jacks-tobacco-11th-anniversary.z: This is a blend under the Jack's Tobacco name; no accessible source describing its content and character could be found, so the profile is left incomplete.
jacks-tobacco-11th-anniversary.o: No reliable information about the room note could be found.

motzek-vp-plug-no-3.z: VP Plug No. 3 is a plug blend from the Kiel-based TAK workshop, built on virginia and perique and rounded out with a pinch of kentucky. The tightly pressed block is prepared by slicing it with a sharp knife and cutting it into cubes or fine shreds. There is no flavoring; the taste is earthy and direct, with perique's spice sitting over Virginia's sweetness.
motzek-vp-plug-no-3.o: Leaves a plain, earthy, lightly tangy tobacco aroma.

tewksbury-company-chicago.z: According to records, this blend was part of the lineup of Tewksbury & Company, an American blender that ceased operations following the 2009 tobacco regulation; no source documenting its content and character could be found.

lane-limited-midnight-special.z: Not enough independent sources could be found documenting the contents and character of American blender Lane Limited's blend called Midnight Special.

kohlhase-kopp-und-co-kg-stormy-north-202.z: Stormy North is an aromatic from Kohlhase & Kopp's Small Batch line, released in limited numbers in 2024. Its body, made of black cavendish, Virginia and Virginia flake pieces, is presented as a ribbon cut. On the casing side, tonka bean and candy sweetness come forward, accompanied by creamy chocolate and amaretto notes. It was distributed in 50-gram tins. The blend follows the heavy, creamy sweetness of Danish-style aromatics; due to the black cavendish density, it stays measured in nicotine. Being a limited run, it is not in continued production. Suited to smokers seeking sweet, distinctly cased and light-bodied blends.
kohlhase-kopp-und-co-kg-stormy-north-202.o: Leaves a sweet room note toward creamy chocolate, tonka bean and candy.

clan-shaw-cherry-tree.z: No sufficient independent sources documenting the content and character of Clan Shaw's Cherry Tree blend could be found.

ken-byron-ventures-samsun-delilah-2020.z: Samsun & Delilah is a limited-edition blend named after the Samsun variety of Turkish Oriental tobacco; the 2020 release is among the first pressings in this line. The structure rests on a trio of Virginia, Samsun Oriental, and black Cavendish. The Cavendish leaf is cut coarser and darker than the other components, giving the blend a distinctly mottled appearance. On the smoke, the dry, herbal, lightly spiced character of the Oriental leaf stands out alongside the breadlike sweetness of the Virginia, while the Cavendish binds the two together with a dark, cocoa-leaning sweetness. On the retrohale there's a light red-pepper warmth and a sweetness reminiscent of stone fruit. Nicotine is moderate. Suited to those wanting an Oriental-forward blend that's nearly unflavored but carries a sweet edge.
ken-byron-ventures-samsun-delilah-2020.o: Leaves a sweet, cocoa-leaning tobacco aroma with a touch of dry hay.

mcgahey-the-tobacconist-haytor-cut-plug.z: Haytor Cut Plug is obtained by combining bright and fire-cured Virginia leaves with burley and pressing the mixture. The tobacco, pressed into block form, is prepared to be rubbed out by hand after slicing; this gives the smoker control over how coarse or fine to make it. According to the maker's description it carries a medium-to-full body and a barely perceptible aromatic touch. Virginia's sugar and burley's dry, nutty base come forward; after pressing, the taste is concentrated and dense. Suitable for smokers who want a slow smoke and are accustomed to plug and flake cuts.
mcgahey-the-tobacconist-haytor-cut-plug.o: A light sweet trace mixes into the woody, bready aroma of fire-cured leaf.

a-c-petersen-blend-120.z: One of the numbered blends from the A & C Petersen factory founded in Horsens, Denmark; no adequate source documenting its content and character could be found.

the-country-squire-tobacconist-by-the-fi.z: By The Fire is The Country Squire's aromatic blend, presented with a smoky vanilla-cherry profile. Fitting the fireside imagery its name suggests, a smoky base sits underneath the sweet top note; the blend also contains spice from perique. On the smoke, vanilla and cherry are noticeable but restrained; the heavy sugar effect common in aromatics is balanced here by smoke and spice. The burn is cool and even. It suits those looking for a middle ground between an aromatic and an English blend. Reportedly, the blend has been pulled from sale for periods when one of its components could not be sourced, so its availability varies.
the-country-squire-tobacconist-by-the-fi.o: Leaves a scent of wood smoke beneath vanilla and cherry sweetness.

consolidated-306-black-cherry.z: No independent, reliable sourcing could be found regarding the Consolidated blend 306: Black Cherry.

cornell-diehl-christmas-blend-2013-wont-.z: This limited-production release, the 2013 edition of Cornell & Diehl's yearly holiday blend series, could not have its content and character verified, as it does not appear in the catalog.

cornell-diehl-warped-cloud-hopper.z: Cloud Hopper is a joint effort between Kyle Gellis, founder of cigar maker Warped, and Jeremy Reeves, head blender at Cornell & Diehl; it's named after Warped's cigar series of the same name and is one of two Warped pipe tobaccos introduced in 2019. The blend's backbone is AA-grade Dominican Criollo cigar leaf, joined by traditional Italian air-cured leaf, yellow and red Virginias, and Perique. After pressing, the mixture is cut into broken flake. It's an unflavored blend; its profile is described as carrying earth, spice, and citrus notes, along with hints of cream and coffee. Thanks to the texture the cigar leaf brings, it offers a smoke with a pronounced tobacco character despite having no Latakia. Aimed at smokers looking for blends that bridge cigars and pipes, accustomed to preparing broken flake.
cornell-diehl-warped-cloud-hopper.o: Leaves a cigar-like scent, earth-and-spice-forward, with hints of coffee and citrus behind it.

comoys-of-london-cumberland.z: No independent, reliable sourcing could be found regarding the Comoy's of London pipe tobacco named Cumberland, so the blend's content, cut, and character could not be recorded.

gawith-hoggarth-co-no-1-cc-blending.z: No. 1 CC is the plain-Virginia entry in Gawith, Hoggarth & Co.'s coarse-cut single-leaf series. No sauce or topping is applied; the taste comes entirely from the flue-cured leaf itself: bready sweetness, dry hay, and a light citrus sharpness. Like the rest of the series, this product is aimed mainly at smokers building their own blends; it's used to establish a sweet, neutral base in a mixture. Smoked on its own, it gives light-to-medium nicotine and a plain Virginia taste.
gawith-hoggarth-co-no-1-cc-blending.o: Leaves a plain aroma carrying dry hay and light bready sweetness.
